After making up his mind, Fang Heng first used a batch of newly produced iron nuggets to produce iron pickaxes and let the zombie clones distribute the pickaxes among themselves to continue mining.
Then, he called a few more zombie clones and loaded the unrefined iron ore into the truck.
“Tt’s been a long time since I last visited my old friend Vettel.”
Fang Heng activated the military truck and revealed a smile.
Tt was time to fulfil his long-cherished wish and empty his shop!
Fang Heng drove the truck back to the apocalypse merchant camp.
As usual, the NPCs instinctively gathered toward the truck as they looked at the large truck driving into the camp.
Seeing the pile of ores behind the truck, the NPC porters all had the same expression as expected.
One by one, they started to move the iron ore out of the truck
“Fang Heng!
Long time no see!
Vettel came out of the house with two bottles of wine and handed a bottle to Fang Heng
“Let me gues, what good stuff did you bring me this time?
“Stop guessing, it’s iron ore!
Your camp must need these things, right?”
“Of course!
I need them!
You’re my lucky star.”
Vettel glanced at the porters who were moving the iron ore out.
“You brought so much?
He was a little surprised.
“I remember there’s an abandoned mine nearby.
Did you occupy that place?
“You’re right!”

Empty it!

The temperature in the entire mine rose sharply!
After only staying for a few minutes, Fang Heng’s back was already drenched in sweat.
The zombies were still good employees!
They could still work even in such an environment!
With the furmace, the smelting speed of the iron nuggets increased greatly.
Similarly, the consumption rate of coal ore as fuel also increased greatly.
It was estimated that the fuel would be used up in three to four hours.
For the time being, logs could be cut into firewood as raw materials.
However, doing so would consume too much energy and waste too much time.
The small-scale coal mine that they found a while ago had not been fully developed yet, so they could continue to mine...
“There are still many things that need to be dealt with to get everything on the right track.
Fang Heng wiped the sweat off his forehead and sent a few zombies over to split the logs, preparing to use them as backup fuel after the coal ores were used up.
“Take it slow
It lasted until 1 a.m.
By the time all the zombies had completed their third growth, the entire abandoned mine was already filled with zombie clones.
384, no more, no less.
Fang Heng counted the number of zombies and started controlling the zombies to hack” in batches.
He first differentiated a group of vine zombie proliferators.
With the existence of the clones, the proliferators could be resurrected in six hours, so there wouldn’t be any pain when they died.
He changed their tools into small iron hammers and told them to go out and carry out the ‘demolition plan’ that had a slight risk.
Specifically, they would search the entire forest area and demolish all the small shelters that could be seen in the forest area!
This would greatly reduce the chances of players respawning nearby!
The remaining zombie clones split into three groups.
One group continued to mine iron, while the other was responsible for controlling the furnaces to forge iron.
The last group was equipped with iron pickaxes and headed to the former mining site to mine coal.
“That’s more like it..”
After racking his brains, Fang Heng finally finished the zombies’ hack plan.
He made a rough calculation in his heart.
With this efficiency, in two days at most, the zombie clones’ equipment could be changed, officially entering the Iron Age.
So tired..
Yawning, Fang Heng couldn’t hold on any longer and went offline on the spot.
At two o’clock in the morning, the Phoenix Sound Gaming Company was still brightly lit.
“President Li, we’ve checked, and indeed, we can’t find anything wrong with Fang Heng on the books”
Li Ru was extremely frustrated.
Fang Heng’s resignation had caused her to receive quite a bit of criticism in the company.
She tried her best to suppress her anger.
“You can’t find anything?
Are you trying to tell me that I’m wrong?”
“Then let me ask you, where did the wooden planks that Fang Heng submitted to the federation come from?
There has to be a source, right?
Secretary Zhang felt bitter in his heart.
He couldn’t understand this question no matter how much he thought about it.
“We also asked a few new employees who work in Team 12.”
“And then?
What did they say?”
Zhang Linhu?’s expression was very strange.
He stammered, “They said that these wooden planks were randomly picked up in the forest.”

chapters.title: Chapter 119 - Work Studio
paragraphs: “Just picked it up? Do you think I’m a three-year-old kid?”
Li Ru was furious.
She felt that these subordinates were getting more and more useless.
“Do you believe what they said?”
Zhang Linhui felt bitter. He didn’t believe it either, but what could he do?
“I also think it’s strange, but these newcomers were all questioned separately, and the answers they gave were all the same. It doesn’t seem like a premeditated conspiracy.”
“oh right, they also mentioned Fang Heng’s large shelter in the game. It’s said to be a large shelter built on the foundation of the prison, with all the resources inside.”
This is very strange, I didn’t find any record of Fang Heng’s shelter in the work accounts of Team 3 and Team 12.”
Li Ru nodded.
To build a large shelter in the game in such a short time, it would be impossible to do it based on ‘Team 12 alone.
It must be because Qin Shuran had used the company’s resources to provide them with great support be? hind the scenes.
This incident is a breakthrough point. Continue your investigation. What happened after that?
“After that, a few rookies from Team 12 resigned.”
“All of them resigned?
Li Ru was surprised.
“Yes, all of them resigned, including Pei Anan.”
“You can leave first.”
Li Ru’s brows were tightly furrowed.
Perhaps the outcome of Team 12 leaving voluntarily was not bad either.
She had specially approved the ‘investigation’ of Fang Heng.
For this, she needed to explain to the board of directors.
All the people involved had resigned guiltily, so the investigation was forced to be suspended...
Could this reason convince the board of directors?
Li Ru could not help but ponder in her heart.
Dong Dong Dong, President Li!
“Come in.”
The office door was pushed open.
Director Wang from the purchasing department laughed as he pushed the door open and entered.
“President Li, you’re still up so late?”
‘It’s all for the company. Aren’t you the same? What good news is there?”
“Haha, good news!”
Director Wang was in a great mood.

“The federation has placed another big order with us. This order is even better than the previous one. It’s just that the federation hopes that we can complete it as soon as possible. I came to inform you of the good news as soon as I received the news.”
Li Ru rubbed her swollen temples.
“What order?
Director Wang walked over and handed over the order report.

“The order for the wooden planks. I’ve confimed it. There’s no problem. We’ve already accepted it. Hurry up and handle it. Once this order is completed, we’ll have more than half of our sales quota for the second half of the year!”
Wooden planks!
Li Ru glanced at the order and her eyelids twitched.
She had checked Fang Heng’s performance records.
In just three days, Fang Heng had provided a large number of wooden planks to the federation.
Li Ru was now certain of it.
Everything was related to Fang Heng’s shelter in the game
Qin Shuran had secretly helped Fang Heng build such a shelter there!
There must be some way to obtain a large number of wooden planks there.
Li Ru sneered in her heart.
Now that Fang Heng had left his job, her people could smoothly take over the shelter.
She would reap the benefits.
Once she reported this matter to the company’s board of directors, the prison shelter would return to her jurisdiction.
The thought of being able to win against Qjn Shuran made Li Ru’s mood better again.
“Well done. I got the order. I will urge all the game teams to complete it as soon as possible.

The next day, Fang Heng went online and glanced at the game log as usual.
Good!
The efficiency of hacking had been greatly increased!
“n the morning, I’ll continue to transport materials and empty Vettel’s shop.
In the aftermoon, I’ll pick up Qju Yaokang and return to the prison.”
Fang Heng muttered to himself. Just as he left the lounge, a few familiar tigures approached him.
It was the rookies of Phoenix Sound Gaming Company.
“Team leader Fang!”
“How is it? Have you thought it through’ Are you going to stay”
“Yes, I’ve thought it through. Yesterday, I was interrogated by the company like a prisoner for a long time. There’s no point in staying. Well continue to follow team leader Fang from now on.”
Liu Yi reached out and pushed his companion beside him. He whispered, “Idiot, you don’t even know what to say. Call him boss”
“Yes! Boss!”
“Oh... you’re very smart. From now on, you’ll be the team leader.” Fang Heng patted Liu Yfs shoulder. “Do a good job.”
“Yes! Boss!”
Liu Yi continued to suggest.
“Boss, we have a few alumni from the same year. Their internships at the company aren’t going well either. They also want to come here. Are you still recruiting
“Recruiting! Of course, I’m recruiting!”
After leaving Phoenix Sound Gaming Company, Fang Heng immediately had the intention to recruit.
After receiving the rapid growth and talent enhancement plan, his shelter expanded at a much faster rate.
If he were to rely on himself, he would have broken his legs just moving materials in the future.
He had to hire some trustworthy helpers.
First, he had to recruit a group of people, then slowly select those he could trust.
He would not let these people come into contact with the core of the shelter, for the time being, to ensure that the risk was manageable.
“Let them come over for an interview tomorrow. As for the location... well... I’Il tell you later.”
If he wanted to recruit people, he still lacked some start-up funds.. he needed a sum of money.
Fang Heng lowered his head and thought for a moment.
Selling resources!
The fastest and most convenient way.
If the customer was an ordinary player, then he would encounter a lot of troublesome matters.
It was the same logic as opening an online shop, it would be very troublesome.
Fang Heng felt that he didn’t have the energy to deal with it.
Selling resources to the federation was the most efficient and fastest way.
These matters could be handed over to Pei Anan to coordinate.
Yesterday, he and Pei Anan communicated through their mobile phones for a very long time.
The federation still had very strict control over the game, so he would open a gaming work studio at that time.
Pei Anan had experience with specific procedures.
After obtaining the funds, he would have to rent an office building as his working space...
Fang Heng did not have the time and energy to deal with these problems.
Pei Anan would be an employee of the work studio. From now on, she would be responsible for dealing with all kinds of problems outside of gaming.
“Yes! Boss!”
The newcomers were full of energy
One of the newcomers rolled up his sleeves. “Boss, what are we going to do today? Are we still going to pick up logs outside?”

chapters.title: Chapter 120 - Demolition
paragraphs: “No, I have a new task for you today.”
Fang Heng was prepared. He took out a map of the area around the forest from his backpack.
A few rookies gathered around to observe.
“Look, this is the location of the prison we are in.”
Fang Heng pointed at the map and then circled five points on it with a pen.
“These are the small and medium-sized shelters I found nearby.”
I need you to go to these five places together today. Bring gasoline along with you and help me set these places on fire.”
“Burn them?”
The rookies looked at each other.
What was the purpose of burning a shelter?
“Then, boss, what if we meet a player in the shelter?”
“Yeah, if we run into players..”
Fang Heng also began to ponder.
The forest region was naturally short of food in the early stages, so it was not suitable for early development.
If ordinary players were unlucky enough to be born here, they would at most stay for a few days before finding a way to leave and find a more suitable place to live.
In addition, Prisoner Snake had previously damaged and looted the place.
In theory, all the ordinary players near the forest region should have run away
“We can discuss with them and ask them to move out of the forest. We will give them some food and basic materials as compensation.”
From a strategic point of view, during the middle of the game, the large guilds would take the usual action of compensating for the ‘demolition.
The only difference was the amount of compensation.
This was related to the company’s reputation.
For a player guild where Prisoner Snake came from, although they did not violate federal laws, their reputation among the players was extremely bad.
If they wanted to continue developing, it was almost impossible for them to expand in the game.
Fang Heng did not lack food in the shelter now. He could collecta large amount of food and materials in a day.
Paying some ‘demolition compensation’ was like a drop of water in the bucket for him.
“But... what if they still don’t want to move?”
If they still didn’t want to, then they could only force it...
“Sigh!”
Fang Heng sighed and patted the young college student’s shoulder.
Then we can only let them see the dark side of this society..”
Did he even need to ask?
If they met a black-hearted lion who opened his mouth, of course, they wouldd use zombies to demolish their homes!
This was the cruel reality of the apocalypse.
Fang Heng felt that he had done it with a clear conscience.

“How about this: If you meet any players, try to come into contact with them and convince them to ‘relocate’. The compensation will be based on the standard set by the federation. If you all can’t reach an agreement, then put it aside for now and wait for me to settle it”
So much?
The few rookies looked at each other in disnmay.
The compensation standard for demolishing and relocation in the federation had always been extremely generous. Very few companies with a consCience could reach this level.
“Do you still have any questions
“No.”
The few rookies nodded their heads to show that they had no objections. They ran over to Liao Bufan’s place to receive gasoline barrels and other supplies, preparing to carry out the demolition plan.
Fang Heng rubbed his neck.
Next, it was time to continue completing the plan of emptying the apocalypse merchant camp.
“Enough, enough, Fang Heng. It’s enough.”
“We don’t need any more iron ore here.”
Vettel wiped the sweat from his forehead and handed Fang Heng a bottle of cold beer.
The 50 furnaces in the apocalypse camp operated 24 hours a day.
The entire apocalypse camp was now like a big furnace.
“Moreover, we really can’t store any more materials here. We need some time to digest them.”
Vettel smiled bitterly.
He didn’t expect that there would come a day when he would be troubled by receiving too many materials.
There was nothing more troublesome than this.
As he spoke, Vettel pointed at the iron ore and coal piled up into a few hills in the apocalypse merchant camp.
“Did you know that the iron ore and coal you provided are enough to upgrade my camp to Level 3? Even if it’s other resources, we can’t store them here for the time being”
With the appearance of a bug like Fang Heng, Vettel felt that he needed to upgrade the warehouse of the apocalypse camp first.
“You can come back after our camp has completed the expansion of the warehouse.”
Really... It has reached the upper limit again..
Fang Heng stroked his chin.
It seemed that it would be a little difficult to empty Vettel’s shop.
In the morning, Fang Heng had transported iron ore and coal back and forth several tinmes.
In total, Fang Heng had earned 15,700 survival points from Vettel.
“Vettel, good lord! I just heard from my uncle that you expanded the Level 3 warehouse without upgrading it. Are you expanding”
Seeing the girl walking into the entrance of the apocalypse camp, Vettel’s face revealed a gentle smile.
“Look who’s here, Qjao Ling! I was wondering why my left eyelid kept twitching today. Tonight, you will stay here. I’ll get the chef to prepare your favourite garlic crayfish!”
As Vettel spoke, he glanced at Fang Heng beside him. “And you, Fang Heng, don’t even think about running away. Last time, you stood me up, so you have to stay here tonight too! We have to get drunk.”
A cheerful and enthusiastic girl about seventeen or eighteen years old walked in from outside the apocalypse camp.
She had clean short hair, and her big eyes revealeda mischievous look.
“Hi, Fang Heng. This is the first time we’ve met. I’ve long heard of your name.”
Qjao Ling walked forward and waved at Fang Heng, revealing a smile.
“Hello, I’m Qjao Ling from the Dark Knights.”
She looked Fang Heng up and down.
“Hello, I’m Fang Heng.”
“Qiao Ling is David’s daughter. You can’t tell, right? That boor.” Vettel sighed and asked Qjao Ling, “Did you run into any trouble today?”
“No, Dad went on a mission and couldn’t leave. It was Sister Katarina who asked me to look for Fang Heng”
Fang Heng was a little surprised.
“You came to look for me?”
“Yes, it’s related to the mission of collecting the samples of Erita.”
“We analyzed the samples of Erita in detail and found something”
“Come, come, come. Let’s talk inside”
Vettel led everyone into the small room, closed the wooden door and gave everyone a bottle of cold beer.
Qiao Ling sat beside the counter.
“According to the analysis of our Dark Knights Research Team, we believe that the Meteorite Company has completed the preliminary biological weapon project.”
“Based on the information we’ve received recently, zombies that have been modified have appeared all over the world. They can accept some orders”
“There are even rumours of zombie creatures that can use high strength weapons.”
Vettel’s expression was grave.
“What does Meteorite Company want to do?”
Tm not sure, but recently, we’ve investigated something strange.”
On the day the biochemical crisis broke out, there were several biochemical virus leaks all over the world at the same time.”
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows.
“Are you trying to say that the apocalypse event was not a coincidence?”
“Yes, it’s just a guess. We have suspected it internally before, and the timing of the incident at Prison No. 507 has also confirmed this speculation.”
“According to the confirmation, there are a total of four biochemical virus leaks in the country, and they happened to occur on the same day.”
Fang Heng nodded.
Such a coincidence was beyond logic.
“What do you need me to do”
“We will organize a team to go to Pine City as soon as possible. We hope you can become a member of the team then.”

sentences.text: “No, I have a new task for you today.”
Fang Heng was prepared.
He took out a map of the area around the forest from his backpack.
A few rookies gathered around to observe.
“Look, this is the location of the prison we are in.”
Fang Heng pointed at the map and then circled five points on it with a pen.
“These are the small and medium-sized shelters I found nearby.”
I need you to go to these five places together today.
Bring gasoline along with you and help me set these places on fire.”
“Burn them?”
The rookies looked at each other.
What was the purpose of burning a shelter?
“Then, boss, what if we meet a player in the shelter?”
“Yeah, if we run into players..”
Fang Heng also began to ponder.
The forest region was naturally short of food in the early stages, so it was not suitable for early development.
If ordinary players were unlucky enough to be born here, they would at most stay for a few days before finding a way to leave and find a more suitable place to live.
In addition, Prisoner Snake had previously damaged and looted the place.
In theory, all the ordinary players near the forest region should have run away
“We can discuss with them and ask them to move out of the forest.
We will give them some food and basic materials as compensation.”
From a strategic point of view, during the middle of the game, the large guilds would take the usual action of compensating for the ‘demolition.
The only difference was the amount of compensation.
This was related to the company’s reputation.
For a player guild where Prisoner Snake came from, although they did not violate federal laws, their reputation among the players was extremely bad.
If they wanted to continue developing, it was almost impossible for them to expand in the game.
Fang Heng did not lack food in the shelter now.
He could collecta large amount of food and materials in a day.
Paying some ‘demolition compensation’ was like a drop of water in the bucket for him.
“But... what if they still don’t want to move?”
If they still didn’t want to, then they could only force it...
“Sigh!”
Fang Heng sighed and patted the young college student’s shoulder.
Then we can only let them see the dark side of this society..”
Did he even need to ask?
If they met a black-hearted lion who opened his mouth, of course, they wouldd use zombies to demolish their homes!
This was the cruel reality of the apocalypse.
Fang Heng felt that he had done it with a clear conscience.
“How about this: If you meet any players, try to come into contact with them and convince them to ‘relocate’.
The compensation will be based on the standard set by the federation.
If you all can’t reach an agreement, then put it aside for now and wait for me to settle it”
So much?
The few rookies looked at each other in disnmay.
The compensation standard for demolishing and relocation in the federation had always been extremely generous.
Very few companies with a consCience could reach this level.
“Do you still have any questions
“No.”
The few rookies nodded their heads to show that they had no objections.
They ran over to Liao Bufan’s place to receive gasoline barrels and other supplies, preparing to carry out the demolition plan.
Fang Heng rubbed his neck.
Next, it was time to continue completing the plan of emptying the apocalypse merchant camp.
“Enough, enough, Fang Heng.
It’s enough.”
“We don’t need any more iron ore here.”
Vettel wiped the sweat from his forehead and handed Fang Heng a bottle of cold beer.
The 50 furnaces in the apocalypse camp operated 24 hours a day.
The entire apocalypse camp was now like a big furnace.
“Moreover, we really can’t store any more materials here.
We need some time to digest them.”
Vettel smiled bitterly.
He didn’t expect that there would come a day when he would be troubled by receiving too many materials.
There was nothing more troublesome than this.
As he spoke, Vettel pointed at the iron ore and coal piled up into a few hills in the apocalypse merchant camp.
“Did you know that the iron ore and coal you provided are enough to upgrade my camp to Level 3?
Even if it’s other resources, we can’t store them here for the time being”
With the appearance of a bug like Fang Heng, Vettel felt that he needed to upgrade the warehouse of the apocalypse camp first.
“You can come back after our camp has completed the expansion of the warehouse.”
Really...
It has reached the upper limit again..
Fang Heng stroked his chin.
It seemed that it would be a little difficult to empty Vettel’s shop.
In the morning, Fang Heng had transported iron ore and coal back and forth several tinmes.
In total, Fang Heng had earned 15,700 survival points from Vettel.
“Vettel, good lord!
I just heard from my uncle that you expanded the Level 3 warehouse without upgrading it.
Are you expanding”
Seeing the girl walking into the entrance of the apocalypse camp, Vettel’s face revealed a gentle smile.
“Look who’s here, Qjao Ling!
I was wondering why my left eyelid kept twitching today.
Tonight, you will stay here.
I’ll get the chef to prepare your favourite garlic crayfish!”
As Vettel spoke, he glanced at Fang Heng beside him.
“And you, Fang Heng, don’t even think about running away.
Last time, you stood me up, so you have to stay here tonight too!
We have to get drunk.”
A cheerful and enthusiastic girl about seventeen or eighteen years old walked in from outside the apocalypse camp.
She had clean short hair, and her big eyes revealeda mischievous look.
“Hi, Fang Heng.
This is the first time we’ve met.
I’ve long heard of your name.”
Qjao Ling walked forward and waved at Fang Heng, revealing a smile.
“Hello, I’m Qjao Ling from the Dark Knights.”
She looked Fang Heng up and down.
“Hello, I’m Fang Heng.”
“Qiao Ling is David’s daughter.
You can’t tell, right?
That boor.” Vettel sighed and asked Qjao Ling, “Did you run into any trouble today?”
“No, Dad went on a mission and couldn’t leave.
It was Sister Katarina who asked me to look for Fang Heng”
Fang Heng was a little surprised.
“You came to look for me?”
“Yes, it’s related to the mission of collecting the samples of Erita.”
“We analyzed the samples of Erita in detail and found something”
“Come, come, come.
Let’s talk inside”
Vettel led everyone into the small room, closed the wooden door and gave everyone a bottle of cold beer.
Qiao Ling sat beside the counter.
“According to the analysis of our Dark Knights Research Team, we believe that the Meteorite Company has completed the preliminary biological weapon project.”
“Based on the information we’ve received recently, zombies that have been modified have appeared all over the world.
They can accept some orders”
“There are even rumours of zombie creatures that can use high strength weapons.”
Vettel’s expression was grave.
“What does Meteorite Company want to do?”
Tm not sure, but recently, we’ve investigated something strange.”
On the day the biochemical crisis broke out, there were several biochemical virus leaks all over the world at the same time.”
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows.
“Are you trying to say that the apocalypse event was not a coincidence?”
“Yes, it’s just a guess.
We have suspected it internally before, and the timing of the incident at Prison No.
507 has also confirmed this speculation.”
“According to the confirmation, there are a total of four biochemical virus leaks in the country, and they happened to occur on the same day.”
Fang Heng nodded.
Such a coincidence was beyond logic.
“What do you need me to do”
“We will organize a team to go to Pine City as soon as possible.
We hope you can become a member of the team then.”

chapters.title: Chapter 121 Block and Dodge
paragraphs: Vetter had a good impression of Pine City. He put down the beer in his mouth.
"If I remember correctly, Pine City is one of the headquarters of Meteorite Company?" "Yes, it houses the largest branch of Meteorite Company."
"In Pine City, more than 30% of the citizens are employees of Meteorite Company."
"Most importantly, we have investigated that Pine City is the first place in the world to have a biochemical virus leak, but the authorities have not made any reports about this.
"It seems that Meteorite Company deliberately covered it up."
Fang Heng lowered his head and pondered.

"Uncle Qiu Si concluded that the biochemical crisis that broke out in Pine City was an accident. All the subsequent biochemical crises that happened in various places were to attract the public's attention and cover up the incident that happened in Pine City
"However, in the end, perhaps even Meteorite Company did not expect that the leakage of the biochemical virus had completely gone out of control and led to the start of the apocalypse."
"We think that we might be able to find some information related to the biological research project there."
"The Dark Knights will organize a group of people to go to Pine City to investigate. As the journey is far, we will use a helicopter to go there."
"In addition, it will take some time to gather people. The specific operation will take about five days. Can you participate in the operation this time? Fang Heng?"
[Hint: You have triggered the fifth stage mission-explore Pine City.]
Mission name: Explore Pine City.
Mission difficulty: SSS.
Mission description: The Dark Knights have invited you. You will take a helicopter to Pine City in five days to explore all the incidents related to the zombie crisis in Pine City.
Current mission requirement: Enter Pine City and try to trigger the next phase of the mission.
After thinking for a while, Fang Heng nodded and said, "Okay, I accept."
It was obvious that this mission was related to Meteorite Company's biological weapon project.
It even involved the game's worldview storyline!
The mission reward was generous!
He could not miss it!
"That's great!"
Qiao Ling was very happy.
"This mission is extremely difficult. The team is still in the process of recruiting members. I will contact you one day in advance."
"Okay"
Fang Heng agreed.
The mission was in five days.
During these five days, he could develop the shelter in peace and bring it into a virtuous cycle.
Fang Heng pondered and turned his gaze to Vettel.
He would start by emptying Vettel's shop!
Although he had completed all the missions related to materials collection issued by the apocalypse camp but weren't there other missions that he could do?
Vettel noticed Fang Heng's undisguised gaze and looked at him in confusion.
"Fang Heng? Is there anything on your mind?"
"Nothing, Vettel. I am leaving soon to complete the mission and I might not be able to drink your free beer.
Fang Heng laughed and spread out his hands.
"I will take advantage of the time I have these few days and check out any missions that are left in the camp. I'll try my best to help you settle some of them."
"Hahaha! Fang Heng, you're my good friend. You still want to help me with the missions. Tonight's meal must be on me. Don't fight with me."
Fang Heng opened the mission interface.
In the early stages of the game, due to the small number of players in the vicinity, there were still a large number of missions piled up in Vettel's camp, which were still in an incomplete state.
Fang Heng took a glance and then used the filtering function.
He screened all missions within 15 kilometres of the prison as the centre.
The filtered mission content-clearing zombies, killing zombies, area exploration, area clearing...
Then he selected those with a time limit of 48 hours or more.
And finally...
Accepted them in batches!
[Hint: You have accepted the mission-killing ordinary zombies.]
[Hint: You have accepted the mission-exploring area.]
[Hint: You have accepted the mission-clearing zombie crowd.]
[Hint: You have accepted the mission-clearing all zombies in the area.]
[Ilint: You have accepted the mission-clear the water truck.]
[Hint: You have accepted the mission-clear the abandoned warehouse.]
[Hint: You have accepted the mission-kill the wandering zombies.]
[Hint: You have accepted the mission...]
[Hint: You need to submit a total of 13,100 survival points as a deposit. If the mission fails, the deposit will not be refunded.]
Since Vettel's camp did not lack resources, then he would switch to completing missions to earn survival points.
There was always a way to empty Vettel's shop!
Fang Heng glanced at the mission panel that was filled to the brim.
For ordinary players, they could not accept missions in large numbers.
However, Fang Heng's King of Gods' game space had a very high hidden score.
In addition, the favorability between him and Vettel had already reached an extremely high level, so he only needed to pay a deposit of more than 10,000.
"Oh right, Vettel, do you have any new goods recently? Can you let me take a look again?"
"Hahaha, what a coincidence. A batch of good things just came in the day before yesterday. This is my most prized treasure, I wouldn't give it to anyone."
There were?
Fang Heng opened the trading panel to inspect.
In terms of weapons, high-level weapons were needed, but Fang Heng couldn't use them so he directly skipped them.
He needed to keep some small explosives at home...
Two modified motorcycles had also been refreshed, so he could consider buying them all. In the future, he could ask newbies like Liu Yi to help transport ores...
Bullets and rare items, no harm having more so he bought them all.
Eh?!
Skill book!!
Fang Heng's eyes lit up when he flipped to the end.
[Item: Apocalypse survival-willpower training]
Type: Skill book (player has not mastered this skill).
Description: After learning, you can master the skill-willpower training. Each level will increase the player's basic willpower by 0.2 points. This skill can be upgraded to Level
20 (skill level does not exceed the current player's level).
[Item: Apocalypse survival-perception training]
Type: Skill book (player has not mastered this skill).
Level: D
Description: After learning this skill, you can master the skill-perception training.
Each level will increase the player basic will attribute by 0.2 points. This skill can be upgraded to Level 20 (skill level does not exceed the current player's level).
Good!
Out of the player's six basic attributes, other than 'intelligence, the other five skill books had already been found.
There was no reason for him not to learn the attributes that he had picked up for free.
Fang Heng continued reading.
[Item: Skill-close-range combat-block.]
Type: Skill book (player has not mastered this skill).
Level: D

Skill description 1: When you received a close-range attack, you can make a block action to increase the success rate of the block judgment. After the judgment is successful, you can reduce all or part of the damage received and reduce the block penalty.
Skill description 2: The higher the level of the skill, the higher the success rate of the block judgment. The higher the damage reduction value, the lower the block penalty.
Skill description: I block! I block! I block!
(This skill can be upgraded to Level 20, the skill level can not exceed the current player's level).
[tem: Skill-close-range combat-dodge.]
Type: Skill book (the player has not mastered this skill).
Level: C+

Chill decorintion 1: When you received a cloce-range attack it is aggior ta maka evasive actions, increasing the success rate of evasive actions and dodging the damage received by this attack (maximum skill can be increased to Level 20). Skill description 2: The higher the skill level, the easier it is to make evasive actions in battle, increasing the success rate of evasive actions.
Skill description: In theory, the correct roll position can avoid all damage. (This skill can be upgraded to Level 20, the skill level can not exceed the current player's level).

chapters.title: Chapter 122 - Not a Single One Left
paragraphs: Damn it, Vettel has a C+ skill book for sale!
Fang Heng looked at Vettel in surprise.
Block and dodge skill books were very useful!
For players, even if they did not learn from the dodge and block skill books, they could still make dodge and block moves.
But after learning the skill, players could obtain an additional success rate bonus.
Needless to say, these two books had to be bought!
“Vettel, I want all of these skill books.”
“Welcome, welcome. I have to say, you always had a unique preference.”

[Hint: You have spent 52,000 survival points to purchase apocalypse survival -willpower training, apocalypse survival-perception training, skills-close-range combat-block, skills-close-range combat-dodge.]
(Hint: Your friendship with Vettel has increased.]
Fang Heng patted the skill books on his head one after another.
‘Well, he had spent half of the survival points he had just obtained.
“Tm still short of survival points...”
In the afternoon, it was almost four o’clock.
A group of five people hurriedly ran around the periphery of the forest area.
“Team leader, we’re almost there. According to the coordinates, we’ll reach the coordinates of the target prison in half an hour.”
“Okay, let’s speed up.”
Dai Zhe nodded.
He was very anxious.
After learning about the prison-related incident, the board of directors of Phoenix Sound Gaming Company gave their approval very quickly.
Prison No. 507 was handed over to Team 7 to manage on their behalf.
The company’s resources could be left idle for nothing.
Not to mention that the marketing department had taken the order in advance.
They also wanted to delay the federation’s order? They didn’t want to cooperate anymore? The company didn’t want to continue the business?
Phoenix Sound Gaming Company needed to complete the mission of transporting the wooden planks to the federation as soon as possible.
Under normal circumstances, after receiving the approval from the board of directors, if Team 7 wanted to officially accept the prison, they still needed to go through some internal procedures.
But Dai Zhe didn’t want to wait a minute!
He took the board of directors approval and Li Ru’s appointment letter in advance and directly led the team into District 8.
He urgently wanted to obtain the prison as soon as possible! He wanted to find Fang Heng as soon as possible!
The prison was only secondary.
Dai Zhe still had great fantasies about the S-level talent enhancement plan mission.
He was certain that Fang Heng couldn’t complete the S-level talent enhancement plan mission in the new server.
Not only Fang Heng, no one else could do it!
Not even the federation!
Unlocking the sealed ball was too difficult! It was impossible to do it within the new server!
Dai Zhe thought that Gu Yijie was in cahoots with President Qin, so he lied to him.
So the sealed ball was still in Fang Heng’s hands!
Fang Heng should still be in the prison shelter.
Find him!
Force him to hand over the sealed ball!
If not, kill him!
If he killed him, he’ll get the sealed ball!
He had to be quick!
If this dragged on, if Fang Heng completed the mission, it’ll be troublesome!
Dai Zhe’s eyes flashed with malice.
To transfer the server and personally lead the team, Dai Zhe had gambled everything!
He had used the 100 King of Gods’ points he had accumulated over the years to buy a recasting pill in the King of Gods’ space, suppressing his character’s level back to Level 1.
Forcefully fulfilling the transition conditions!
However, the negative effects of doing so were extremely great!
Other than forcefully pushing his character’s level back to Level 1, all the skills he had learned through the skill books would be completely forgotten!
It was equivalent to the time he had spent in the game for the past few years, wiping out all the improvements he had made to his character!
Dai Zhe felt that all of this was worth it.
As long as he could obtain the S-level talent enhancement plan!
If everything went smoothly, he could even obtain a prison in Server 8 for free!
“Lsee it! The prison!”
‘When he saw a corner of the prison exposed in front of him, Dai Zhe revealed an excited expression.
The prison was several times bigger than he had imagined!
“Let’s go and take a look.”
Dai Zhe led a group of players towards the prison.
“Leader, look over there. There are sentry towers over there.”
There were so many sentry towers?
Dai Zhe was also shocked.
There were more than ten sentry towers built in a row on the inner side of the barbed wire fence surrounding the prison.
It was very obvious that other than the two sentry towers in the corner, most of the other sentry towers were made of wood.
They were all built by players.
“President Qin invested a lot!”
Dai Zhe said fiercely, a hint of greed flashing in his eyes.
If he could get the sealed ball and the prison together this time, it would not be a loss.
After all, his character had not learned many skill books in District 5.
Dai Zhe looked up at the sentry tower.
The guards above were NPCs?
‘When the Dark Knights soldiers saw the intruders, they immediately waved their hands to stop the suspicious people from approaching.
“Warning, this is private territory. Please do not approach.”
Dai Zhe was suspicious. He walked forward step by step and stopped some distance away from the sentry tower.
“Lam the leader of Team 7 of the Phoenix Sound Gaming Company. Who is the person in charge of your prison? Let him speak to me. I have something important to discuss with him.”
The elite mercenary of the Dark Knights looked at the person below.
“Stand here. Don’t move. I will contact him.”
After a few minutes, the mercenary poked his head out of the sentry tower and shouted towards the outside.
“Tell me why you are here.”
Dai Zhe narrowed his eyes and continued to shout at the mercenary.
“Who is your person in charge? Fang Heng is inside, right? Tell them to come out and see me. I am here on behalf of the Phoenix Sound Gaming Company!”
The mercenary was unmoved. He coldly repeated, “Tell me why you’re here.”
“Tsk!”
Dai Zhe was helpless. He held the Phoenix Sound Gaming Company appointment letter and the board of directors’ approval that Li Ru had signed in his hand and waved it high in the air.

“I’ve received the company’s appointment and am here to take over the prison. This is the company’s appointment letter and the board of directors’ approval. Quickly get your person in charge out! Otherwise, you’ll have to bear the consequences!”
Hearing this, a chubby head popped out from the sentry tower.
“Bullsh*t! Take over the f*cking prison! How thick-skinned can you be? Why don’t I know that this prison belongs to your company?”
“Who are you?”
Liao Bufan raised the pistol in his hand. “Fang Heng is the only boss here. Don’t waste my time. Get lost!”
Fang Heng?!
He was indeed here!
Dai Zhe clenched his fists and continued to shout in the direction of the sentry tower.
“I knew Fang Heng was hiding here! He has caused a great loss to the company. Do you think you can solve it by resigning? Tell him to get out! I have something to say to him!”
“You’re not from Phoenix Sound Gaming Company. Don’t interfere with our internal work.”
“And don’t try to protect Fang Heng. Otherwise, even you...”
“F*ck! Why aren’t you going away? You’re still trying to be absurd, aren’t you?”
Liao Bufan had heard about the unreasonable treatment Fang Heng received in Phoenix Sound Gaming Company from a few rookies from the company. He was already very unhappy with their people.
If it weren’t for Fang Heng, how could he be so happy in the game?
Eating and drinking every day?
He might even be gnawing on tree roots somewhere.
This clamouring made Liao Bufan even more annoyed.
“If you don’t leave, I’ll help you!”
Liao Bufan waved his hand.
“Kill them all! Don’t let any of them escape!”

sentences.text: Damn it, Vettel has a C+ skill book for sale!
Fang Heng looked at Vettel in surprise.
Block and dodge skill books were very useful!
For players, even if they did not learn from the dodge and block skill books, they could still make dodge and block moves.
But after learning the skill, players could obtain an additional success rate bonus.
Needless to say, these two books had to be bought!
“Vettel, I want all of these skill books.”
“Welcome, welcome.
I have to say, you always had a unique preference.”

[Hint: You have spent 52,000 survival points to purchase apocalypse survival -willpower training, apocalypse survival-perception training, skills-close-range combat-block, skills-close-range combat-dodge.]
(Hint: Your friendship with Vettel has increased.]
Fang Heng patted the skill books on his head one after another.
‘Well, he had spent half of the survival points he had just obtained.
“Tm still short of survival points...”
In the afternoon, it was almost four o’clock.
A group of five people hurriedly ran around the periphery of the forest area.
“Team leader, we’re almost there.
According to the coordinates, we’ll reach the coordinates of the target prison in half an hour.”
“Okay, let’s speed up.”
Dai Zhe nodded.
He was very anxious.
After learning about the prison-related incident, the board of directors of Phoenix Sound Gaming Company gave their approval very quickly.
Prison No.
507 was handed over to Team 7 to manage on their behalf.
The company’s resources could be left idle for nothing.
Not to mention that the marketing department had taken the order in advance.
They also wanted to delay the federation’s order?
They didn’t want to cooperate anymore?
The company didn’t want to continue the business?
Phoenix Sound Gaming Company needed to complete the mission of transporting the wooden planks to the federation as soon as possible.
Under normal circumstances, after receiving the approval from the board of directors, if Team 7 wanted to officially accept the prison, they still needed to go through some internal procedures.
But Dai Zhe didn’t want to wait a minute!
He took the board of directors approval and Li Ru’s appointment letter in advance and directly led the team into District 8.
He urgently wanted to obtain the prison as soon as possible!
He wanted to find Fang Heng as soon as possible!
The prison was only secondary.
Dai Zhe still had great fantasies about the S-level talent enhancement plan mission.
He was certain that Fang Heng couldn’t complete the S-level talent enhancement plan mission in the new server.
Not only Fang Heng, no one else could do it!
Not even the federation!
Unlocking the sealed ball was too difficult!
It was impossible to do it within the new server!
Dai Zhe thought that Gu Yijie was in cahoots with President Qin, so he lied to him.
So the sealed ball was still in Fang Heng’s hands!
Fang Heng should still be in the prison shelter.
Find him!
Force him to hand over the sealed ball!
If not, kill him!
If he killed him, he’ll get the sealed ball!
He had to be quick!
If this dragged on, if Fang Heng completed the mission, it’ll be troublesome!
Dai Zhe’s eyes flashed with malice.
To transfer the server and personally lead the team, Dai Zhe had gambled everything!
He had used the 100 King of Gods’ points he had accumulated over the years to buy a recasting pill in the King of Gods’ space, suppressing his character’s level back to Level 1.
Forcefully fulfilling the transition conditions!
However, the negative effects of doing so were extremely great!
Other than forcefully pushing his character’s level back to Level 1, all the skills he had learned through the skill books would be completely forgotten!
It was equivalent to the time he had spent in the game for the past few years, wiping out all the improvements he had made to his character!
Dai Zhe felt that all of this was worth it.
As long as he could obtain the S-level talent enhancement plan!
If everything went smoothly, he could even obtain a prison in Server 8 for free!
“Lsee it!
The prison!”
‘When he saw a corner of the prison exposed in front of him, Dai Zhe revealed an excited expression.
The prison was several times bigger than he had imagined!
“Let’s go and take a look.”
Dai Zhe led a group of players towards the prison.
“Leader, look over there.
There are sentry towers over there.”
There were so many sentry towers?
Dai Zhe was also shocked.
There were more than ten sentry towers built in a row on the inner side of the barbed wire fence surrounding the prison.
It was very obvious that other than the two sentry towers in the corner, most of the other sentry towers were made of wood.
They were all built by players.
“President Qin invested a lot!”
Dai Zhe said fiercely, a hint of greed flashing in his eyes.
If he could get the sealed ball and the prison together this time, it would not be a loss.
After all, his character had not learned many skill books in District 5.
Dai Zhe looked up at the sentry tower.
The guards above were NPCs?
‘When the Dark Knights soldiers saw the intruders, they immediately waved their hands to stop the suspicious people from approaching.
“Warning, this is private territory.
Please do not approach.”
Dai Zhe was suspicious.
He walked forward step by step and stopped some distance away from the sentry tower.
“Lam the leader of Team 7 of the Phoenix Sound Gaming Company.
Who is the person in charge of your prison?
Let him speak to me.
I have something important to discuss with him.”
The elite mercenary of the Dark Knights looked at the person below.
“Stand here.
Don’t move.
I will contact him.”
After a few minutes, the mercenary poked his head out of the sentry tower and shouted towards the outside.
“Tell me why you are here.”
Dai Zhe narrowed his eyes and continued to shout at the mercenary.
“Who is your person in charge?
Fang Heng is inside, right?
Tell them to come out and see me.
I am here on behalf of the Phoenix Sound Gaming Company!”
The mercenary was unmoved.
He coldly repeated, “Tell me why you’re here.”
“Tsk!”
Dai Zhe was helpless.
He held the Phoenix Sound Gaming Company appointment letter and the board of directors’ approval that Li Ru had signed in his hand and waved it high in the air.
“I’ve received the company’s appointment and am here to take over the prison.
This is the company’s appointment letter and the board of directors’ approval.
Quickly get your person in charge out!
Otherwise, you’ll have to bear the consequences!”
Hearing this, a chubby head popped out from the sentry tower.
“Bullsh*t!
Take over the f*cking prison!
How thick-skinned can you be?
Why don’t I know that this prison belongs to your company?”
“Who are you?”
Liao Bufan raised the pistol in his hand.
“Fang Heng is the only boss here.
Don’t waste my time.
Get lost!”
Fang Heng?!
He was indeed here!
Dai Zhe clenched his fists and continued to shout in the direction of the sentry tower.
“I knew Fang Heng was hiding here!
He has caused a great loss to the company.
Do you think you can solve it by resigning?
Tell him to get out!
I have something to say to him!”
“You’re not from Phoenix Sound Gaming Company.
Don’t interfere with our internal work.”
“And don’t try to protect Fang Heng.
Otherwise, even you...”
“F*ck!
Why aren’t you going away?
You’re still trying to be absurd, aren’t you?”
Liao Bufan had heard about the unreasonable treatment Fang Heng received in Phoenix Sound Gaming Company from a few rookies from the company.
He was already very unhappy with their people.
If it weren’t for Fang Heng, how could he be so happy in the game?
Eating and drinking every day?
He might even be gnawing on tree roots somewhere.
This clamouring made Liao Bufan even more annoyed.
“If you don’t leave, I’ll help you!”
Liao Bufan waved his hand.
“Kill them all!
Don’t let any of them escape!”

chapters.title: Chapter 123 - Scientific Research
paragraphs: What was that?
Asniper rifle?!
Seeing the black muzzle poking out from the sentry tower, Dai Zhe felt an extremely strong sense of unease.
“Bang! Bang Bang!!”
Before he could say a word, Dai Zhe’s vision went black.
After a few gunshots, Dai Zhe and the remaining players who had come all the way here were all shot in the head.
“Tsk! Trash! Who do you think you are? I’ll kill you every time I see you!”
Liao Bufan spat disdainfully.
Ever since the shelter had recruited a new batch of players, Liao Bufan had temporarily become the prison’s head of security and logistics supervisor.
He faithfully carried out Fang Heng’s prison strategy.
‘When the prison guards encountered hostile people, once they started fighting, they would try to kill all of them, leaving no one alive to avoid future trouble.
“They dare to attack and clamour with such little strength. I admire their courage.”
Looking at the circle of players corpses with their heads blown off outside, Liao Bufan curled his lips in disdain.
He then looked at the top-tier NPCs beside him with some envy.
It would be great if he could also use a sniper rifle...
Prison No. 3, secret research room on the second basement.
Fang Heng raised his head and looked at the ceiling.
Eh? There seemed to be gunshots outside?
“Fang Heng, you didn’t lie to me, but unfortunately, a large part of the research equipment here is severely damaged.”
[Hint: Your friendship with Qiu Yaokang has greatly increased. ]
[Hint: Qiu Yaokang’s loyalty has increased to 93.]
Qiu Yaokang bent down.
He focused his attention on the Licker in the cultivation pod, his eyes filled with excitement.
Li Bo did not dare to enter the room. He was watching the scene in the next room through the surveillance camera.
Fang Heng was silent for a moment as he read the message in the game log.
What a good guy.

He had worked so hard to help Qiu Yaokang do so many things in the past, but his favorability had only increased by a small margin. Now that he gave him a lab that he picked up, his favorability actually increased by a large margin?
While observing the cultivation pod, Qiu Yaokang asked, “Do you want me to continue studying the evolution and transformation of Lickers?”
Fang Heng nodded and pointed at the two zombie clones standing by the side.
“Yes, see if you can find a way to transform them into Lickers.”
Qiu Yaokang wasn’t afraid of zombies at all.
He stood up and walked closer to Fang Heng’s zombie clones to examine them carefully.
Not long after, he even started touching the zombie clone’s body.
Then, Qiu Yaokang fell into deep thought.
‘When he was escorting Qiu Yaokang back to the prison, Fang Heng had already told him about his talent ability, including how the zombie clone was transformed into a vine zombie.
Qiu Yaokang thought for at least 10 minutes.
“Theoretically, it’s possible,” he said
‘It’s possible!’
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up.
However, Qiu Yaokang’s words poured a bucket of cold water on him.
“But it will take a long time. You have to make up your mind that you won’t have any breakthrough in one or two years.”
“One or two years without any breakthrough? That long?”
“What else? There are only two researchers here, Li Bo and me.”
Qiu Yaokang’s face was cold. He looked up at the monitor in the corner and started to complain.
“No, to be precise, I’m the only researcher.”
“Li Bo’s guts can’t even be compared to the pet cat of my neighbour next door. He can’t even be considered as a qualified assistant. I will have to handle everything personally.”
“It’s already good enough for such a difficult research to have a breakthrough in one to two years.”
Li Bo was a person who was at Level S...
He was not qualified to be an assistant? It couldn’t be to that extent...
Fang Heng raised his head and glanced at the camera in the corner.
He felt that Li Bo had been badly hacked this time.
Fortunately, the microphone switch wasn’t turned on, so Li Bo couldn’t hear it.
“That time when I first encountered the corpse vine, why did the zombie clone evolve into a vine zombie so quickly?”
Fang Heng was puzzled. He suggested, “With the same idea, can we inject the T-virus directly into the zombie clone?”
“No! There are three reasons.”
Qiu Yaokang turned around.
“First, luck.”
“The target of the corpse vine is an inanimate dead body, and your zombie clone is also a dead body. That time, you were lucky.”
“But, it’s different this time. The Licker was evolved from a living body, so the two are very different.”
Fang Heng said, “Eh...”
“Secondly, the corpse vine you found in the secret research room is the product of Meteorite Company’s special modification.”
“With Meteorite Company’s super high-level research ability and three years of careful research and cultivation, the modified corpse vine is now suitable to act as a parasite.”
Qiu Yaokang stretched out a finger as he spoke, his face full of confidence.

“If you can provide me with the same resources as the Meteorite Company, I only need a month to develop a specific research plan, and I’ll officially enter the live clinical experiment within five weeks.”
“The question is, can you do it? Can you give me so many resources?”
“Tsk... the boss is pretending again...”
Fang Heng smiled bitterly in his heart.
He had no choice. He really couldn’t do it.
Scientists in the real world were unable to assist in research in the game.
This was the setting of the King of Gods’ game.
In the Zombie Apocalypse, it was not easy to find a living NPC, and it was even more difficult to recruit a scientist.
“The third point is also the biggest dilemma we have encountered so far.”
“There’s another dilemma?”
“Yes, that’s very strange. I just did a check, and I didn’t find any modified T-virus for the Lickers’ live experiments.”
“What? No modified T-virus?”
Fang Heng frowned and paused.
He immediately pressed the microphone switch on the experiment table.
“Li Bo, can you find the T-virus in the laboratory?”
“Yes, Dr Qiu has also communicated with me about this matter. I also feel that this matter is very strange.”
Li Bo’s voice was transmitted through the loudspeaker in the corner of the laboratory.

“remember that a few days before the outbreak of the biochemical crisis incident, there was a batch of modified T-virus for living experiments sent to the laboratory. At that time, it was signed by my colleague. Moreover, we always have a backup of the modified virus.”
“But now, we can’t find it even if we want to. We can’t find the backup either.”
“There’s something strange...”
Fang Heng whispered and lowered his head to think.
Combined with the intelligence he received from the Dark Knights not long ago, it seemed that the outbreak of the biochemical virus was created by the Meteorite Company?
The Meteorite Company did not want the modified T-virus used to study Lickers to leak out, so they had already recalled the modified T-virus before creating the leakage of the biochemical virus?
Qiu Yaokang turned around and looked at Fang Heng seriously.
“So, Fang Heng, do you still want to continue your research?”
Before he could answer, Fang Heng saw rows of game notifications on his retina.
[Hint: Player’s current shelter rating: Level 17.]

chapters.title: Chapter 124 - Research Direction
paragraphs: “Research?”
Aseries of notifications suddenly popped up, startling Fang Heng.
He read the notifications again in detail.
This was the first time Fang Heng had heard of such a thing.
‘The official player forums set up by the federation had never shown any relevant information.
“It’s probably the hidden special settings of the game again.”
That made sense.
Thinking about it carefully, it would be great if ordinary players could live peacefully in the game.
Even if they built a shelter, they would not spend a lot of money to build a research laboratory, let alone recruit rare researchers.
Fang Heng felt that only a super-large organization like the federation had the capital to research the shelter’s research layout.
While he was thinking, Fang Heng opened up the shelter’s detailed list and began to search.
“So many...”
The rows and rows of refreshing lists surprised Fang Heng.
‘There was such an operation?!
[Basic scientific research direction]
Basic scientific research direction 1: Material architecture enhancement (Level 0).
Basic scientific research direction 2: Zombie vulnerability analysis (Level 0).
Basic scientific research direction 3: Tool efficiency improvement (Level 0).
Basic scientific research direction 4: High-efficiency weapon development (Level 0).
Basic scientific research direction 5: T-virus research (Level 0).
[Special research direction]
Special research direction 1: Advanced zombie genetic modification potion research (this research project is provided by $+ researcher Qiu Yaokang).
Current research progress: 33.1% (inherited from researcher Qiu Yaokang).
Special research direction 2: Tier 1 mutated zombie-poisonous zombie poisonous gas research (this research project is provided by S+ researcher Qiu Yaohui).
Current research progress: 56.9% (inherited from researcher Qiu Yaokang).
Special research direction 3: Meteorite Company-biological weapon project in-depth research (this research project is triggered by special item-Erita live sample).
Special research direction 4: Corpse vine and parasitic body research (this research project is triggered by a special item-modified living corpse vine).
Special research direction 5: Licker in-depth research and cultivation (this research project is provided by S- researcher Li Bo).
Current research progress: 3% (inherited from researcher Li Bo).
Special research direction 6: SSS-level talent skill zombie clone-Licker transformation project (this research project is triggered by researcher Qiu Yaokang, Li Bo and player Fang Heng).
“So many...”
Fang Heng carefully read through the research notes.
He had a general idea.
Basic research projects should be aimed at shelters. After the research was completed, the results would most likely have a positive effect on shelters.
As for special research directions, they were all triggered by special characters, special events and special items.
Fang Heng felt that the biggest improvement to his current strength was research direction 6.
Transforming his zombie clone into a Licker!
Greatly improving his combat strength!
Fang Heng opened the details of special research 6 to check.
Research: SSS-level talent skill zombie clone-Licker transformation project.
Research level: SSS.
Research difficulty: SSS (extremely difficult research, almost impossible to complete based on current shelter scientific research ability).

Current research difficulties: Lack of large-scale experimental hardware conditions, lack of researchers, lack of T-virus infection samples, lack of pre-Licker related research, lack of high-level materials, lack of pre-T-virus related research.
Estimated completion time: 7-8 years.
(Description: Solving the current difficulties can greatly improve research efficiency and shorten research time.)
7-8 years?
That’s a little too long!
Fang Heng was a little speechless for a moment.
“Fang Heng, you’ve seen the current situation. It’s undoubtedly a waste of time to directly study the Licker modification.”
Qiu Yaokang gave his opinion.
“I think that this research project can only be started after we find the modified T-virus sample used to infect the Licker. Only then will there be a need for research.”
“alright, you’re right.”
Fang Heng gave up.
He would need to slow down the Licker modification project.
Thinking back, he would head to Pine City in five days. That was one of the branches of the Meteorite Company.
Maybe he could find the modified T-virus sample there.
“Oh right, I remember you wanted to research poisonous zombies, right?”
“Yes, it’s very important for us humans to survive the apocalypse.”
Qiu Yaokang nodded, showing some worry on his face. “I’m worried about the situation in the infected zone.”

“During this period, we’ll start with the research on the poisonous zombies. I’ll start rebuilding and repairing the laboratory. If you have any problems, come to me. You can ask Liao Bufan for basic materials. The shelter will try its best to meet your needs.”
“Okay.”
Qiu Yaokang nodded. He looked as if this should be the way it was.
[Hint: You have chosen the current research direction of the shelter’s experimental team: Tier 1 mutated zombie-research on the poisonous zombie poisonous gas.]
[Hint: Your friendship with Qiu Yaokang has slightly increased.)
[Hint: Qiu Yaokang’s loyalty has increased to 95.]

“The biggest problem now is that many of the equipment left behind by the Meteorite Company in the secret laboratory has been seriously damaged, which has greatly reduced our research efficiency. These equipment need manual maintenance.”
“It would be best if you can find me an outstanding maintenance mechanic.”
“But given the current conditions of the apocalypse outside, I reckon that you won’t be able to find him in a short period...”
Fang Heng nodded and thought to himself, as expected of an $+ NPC.
He had thought through the problem very thoroughly and knew that it was useless to ask for something that he couldn’t do.
Qiu Yaokang took out a rusty wrench from his pocket.
“Ineed you to provide me with some skill books related to the maintenance of experimental props and mechanical maintenance books that I can barely use.”
Fang Heng: ???
Qiu Yaokang explained, “What I mean is, I can try to learn the maintenance of experimental instruments on my own.”
This...
Fang Heng could not help but open his mouth.
What a guy!
Fang Heng was impressed!
An S+ level boss was amazing. To pursue scientific research, he even started to learn mechanical maintenance skills on his own...
“Alright, I’ll go to the shop and ask Vettel. He might have some related skill books for sale there.”
The price of skill books related to mechanical maintenance was not high.
However, they were relatively rare. If the apocalypse merchant camp did not sell them, he could only look for them on the players’ forums.
Ever since the server transfer function had begun, the trading channel between players had gradually opened, and many good items had appeared.
“Tl be waiting for your good news.”
“Right, I don’t need this thing.”
Qiu Yaokang took out a book from his backpack and threw it to Fang Heng.
“What’s this?”
Fang Heng took the book.
“Skill book?!”

sentences.text: “Research?”
Aseries of notifications suddenly popped up, startling Fang Heng.
He read the notifications again in detail.
This was the first time Fang Heng had heard of such a thing.
‘The official player forums set up by the federation had never shown any relevant information.
“It’s probably the hidden special settings of the game again.”
That made sense.
Thinking about it carefully, it would be great if ordinary players could live peacefully in the game.
Even if they built a shelter, they would not spend a lot of money to build a research laboratory, let alone recruit rare researchers.
Fang Heng felt that only a super-large organization like the federation had the capital to research the shelter’s research layout.
While he was thinking, Fang Heng opened up the shelter’s detailed list and began to search.
“So many...”
The rows and rows of refreshing lists surprised Fang Heng.
‘There was such an operation?!
[Basic scientific research direction]
Basic scientific research direction 1: Material architecture enhancement (Level 0).
Basic scientific research direction 2: Zombie vulnerability analysis (Level 0).
Basic scientific research direction 3: Tool efficiency improvement (Level 0).
Basic scientific research direction 4: High-efficiency weapon development (Level 0).
Basic scientific research direction 5: T-virus research (Level 0).
[Special research direction]
Special research direction 1: Advanced zombie genetic modification potion research (this research project is provided by $+ researcher Qiu Yaokang).
Current research progress: 33.1% (inherited from researcher Qiu Yaokang).
Special research direction 2: Tier 1 mutated zombie-poisonous zombie poisonous gas research (this research project is provided by S+ researcher Qiu Yaohui).
Current research progress: 56.9% (inherited from researcher Qiu Yaokang).
Special research direction 3: Meteorite Company-biological weapon project in-depth research (this research project is triggered by special item-Erita live sample).
Special research direction 4: Corpse vine and parasitic body research (this research project is triggered by a special item-modified living corpse vine).
Special research direction 5: Licker in-depth research and cultivation (this research project is provided by S- researcher Li Bo).
Current research progress: 3% (inherited from researcher Li Bo).
Special research direction 6: SSS-level talent skill zombie clone-Licker transformation project (this research project is triggered by researcher Qiu Yaokang, Li Bo and player Fang Heng).
“So many...”
Fang Heng carefully read through the research notes.
He had a general idea.
Basic research projects should be aimed at shelters.
After the research was completed, the results would most likely have a positive effect on shelters.
As for special research directions, they were all triggered by special characters, special events and special items.
Fang Heng felt that the biggest improvement to his current strength was research direction 6.
Transforming his zombie clone into a Licker!
Greatly improving his combat strength!
Fang Heng opened the details of special research 6 to check.
Research: SSS-level talent skill zombie clone-Licker transformation project.
Research level: SSS.
Research difficulty: SSS (extremely difficult research, almost impossible to complete based on current shelter scientific research ability).

Current research difficulties: Lack of large-scale experimental hardware conditions, lack of researchers, lack of T-virus infection samples, lack of pre-Licker related research, lack of high-level materials, lack of pre-T-virus related research.
Estimated completion time: 7-8 years.
(Description: Solving the current difficulties can greatly improve research efficiency and shorten research time.)
7-8 years?
That’s a little too long!

It’s undoubtedly a waste of time to directly study the Licker modification.”
Qiu Yaokang gave his opinion.
“I think that this research project can only be started after we find the modified T-virus sample used to infect the Licker.
Only then will there be a need for research.”
“alright, you’re right.”
Fang Heng gave up.
He would need to slow down the Licker modification project.
Thinking back, he would head to Pine City in five days.
That was one of the branches of the Meteorite Company.
Maybe he could find the modified T-virus sample there.
“Oh right, I remember you wanted to research poisonous zombies, right?”
“Yes, it’s very important for us humans to survive the apocalypse.”
Qiu Yaokang nodded, showing some worry on his face.
“I’m worried about the situation in the infected zone.”
“During this period, we’ll start with the research on the poisonous zombies.
I’ll start rebuilding and repairing the laboratory.
If you have any problems, come to me.
You can ask Liao Bufan for basic materials.
The shelter will try its best to meet your needs.”
“Okay.”
Qiu Yaokang nodded.
He looked as if this should be the way it was.

[Hint: Your friendship with Qiu Yaokang has slightly increased.)
[Hint: Qiu Yaokang’s loyalty has increased to 95.]
“The biggest problem now is that many of the equipment left behind by the Meteorite Company in the secret laboratory has been seriously damaged, which has greatly reduced our research efficiency.

This...

chapters.title: Chapter 125 - Redemption
paragraphs: Fang Heng hurriedly went offline.
He had made an appointment with Pei Anan last night to select a location for the newly opened work studio today.
Opening his phone, he saw that he had received the two million yuan transfer from Chen Yu.
The federation was still very efficient.
Last night, he discussed with Chen Yu and exchanged a batch of wooden planks for cash. The other party readily agreed and sent the deposit over early in the morning.
Fang Heng sent a message to Chen Yu, indicating that he had received the money.
Fang Heng: Received! Happy working with you!
Chen Yu: I saw what happened online. Do you need us to intervene?
Online? What happened?
Fang Heng was stunned. He quickly logged into the forum to check.
“Former professional player, Fang Heng, is suspected of embezzling the company’s finances.”
“He did such a thing after embezzling company property.”
“Former professional player, Fang Heng, the fallen history of a successful person.”
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes.
Phoenix Sound Gaming Company came up with such a dirty trick?
Fang Heng continued to flip through the pages.
‘What surprised him a little was that the public opinions were not swayed by Phoenix Sound Gaming Company.
Someone on the internet immediately released a clarification statement.
In the statement, not only did it show the relevant contract signed between Fang Heng and Phoenix Sound Gaming Company, but it also showed the certificate issued by the federation.
Following that, the internet was once again filled with spectators waiting to see a show.
A group of people clamoured for Phoenix Sound Gaming Company to give them concrete evidence of Fang Heng embezzling the company’s finances.
They demanded the company to show them the certificate of ownership of Prison No. 507.
“It’s probably because Pei Anan got someone to do it and spent quite a bit of money.”
Fang Heng muttered softly and closed the forum.
The statement was reasonable and logical and retorted the accusations one by one. One look and one could tell that she was a veteran. Moreover, the online platforms were mostly filled with trolls.
“I didn’t expect her to be so good at it...”
Just as he was thinking about it, Pei Anan called.
Fang Heng took the call.
“Fang Heng, Phoenix Sound Gaming Company and the others are bullying us too much!”
“I’ve already found a friend to post a clarification post, but my friend said that Phoenix Sound Gaming Company might have a counterattack. She told us to be careful.”
“Thank you, well done.”
If it was in the past, Fang Heng would not care about public opinion outside of the game.
However, things were different now.
After he decided on the work studio, he would sell the materials in the name of the work studio in the future.
In addition, in the future, he would have to collect rent from the outside world in the game.
If his reputation wasn’t good, then he might not be able to rent it out and it would affect his business!
It would be better to get the big shots of the federation to lend a hand.
At the very most, he could sell them a sum of materials as compensation.
The work studio was newly established, and the two million in the capital was not enough. At this stage, other than selling materials, there were no other profit points.
Fang Heng stroked his chin and thought for a while, then sent a message to Chen Yu, asking him to help deal with the underlings of Phoenix Sound Gaming Company.
“Oh right, have you chosen the company’s address?”
“Yes, yes. According to what you said, we rented the first floor of the commercial building, and the address is on Hongmei Road... I’ll send you a link, you can go over and take a look?”
At Phoenix Sound Gaming Company.
“No? What do you mean by no?”
Li Ru raised her head, her gaze aggressive.
Zhang Linhui’s eyes were bloodshot, and his face was full of fatigue.
“There’s no information.”
To be honest, from last night until now, the entire department had worked with him to search for an entire day’s worth of information in the company.
But there was no information related to Prison No. 507.
He couldn’t just come up with something out of thin air!
“We’ve been searching for an entire day, but we didn’t find any reports or information related to the prison base in the company.”
Zhang Linhui shook his head and sighed.
“We don’t know who’s in charge of the prison at all. Now we can confirm that he’s not someone from the company.”
“president Li, do you think that the prison is the Qin family’s investment project? So they didn’t go through the company’s account?”
Li Ru didn’t say a word.
‘The uneasiness in her heart grew stronger.
For a moment, the atmosphere in the office became extremely stagnant.
This was the most reasonable guess at the moment.
This was difficult!
Secretary Zhang looked at his phone and revealed a surprised expression. He almost subconsciously looked up at Dai Zhe.
Li Ru caught this small expression.
“What’s wrong now? Speak!”
Zhang Linhui put down his phone.
“President Li, it’s regarding the matter on the internet.”

“The federation has come forward to clarify that Prison No. 507 has always been under Fang Heng’s control and the materials they obtained were all provided by Fang Heng. It has nothing to do with Phoenix Sound Gaming Company.”
Zhang Linhui carefully looked at Dai Zhe.
“Our side has been unable to produce the corresponding evidence regarding the ownership of Prison No. 507 for a long time. More and more people on the internet are starting to question our company.”
“The matter of Fang Heng being forced to resign has also been exposed by others. This matter has a great impact on our company’s reputation.”
‘The federation had personally come down?
Li Ru was a little dumbfounded.
Her first reaction was disbelief.
“president Li, the board of directors is starting to pay attention to this matter. If this continues and it causes the company’s stock price to fluctuate, I’m afraid...”
Li Ru turned her head to look at Dai Zhe who was beside her.
“It’s all your fault! Who told you to post on the internet? Go and delete the post now! You’ll be responsible for all the consequences of this incident!”
Li Ru gritted her teeth.
“Inform the marketing department to reduce the impact of this matter. Buy the troll army to reduce the heat. Act quickly!”
Dai Zhe stood to the side.
His expression was frighteningly gloomy.
‘The article that accused Fang Heng was posted on the internet by him.
He couldn’t take it anymore.
He used a private account. He didn’t expect that once he posted it, it would be crazily shared by all the major media outlets.
But this wasn’t important.
Dai Zhe had already realized it.
All of this was a trap!
He had been schemed against by someone behind his back!
‘Was there any meaning in deleting the post now? It was obvious that the prison had already fallen into Fang Heng’s hands!
“President Li, this is not the time to pursue the matter. There is still a storm on the internet, we can always settle it with some money.”

Zhang Linhui said carefully, “But what about that big deal from the federation? Without Prison No. 507, how should we deal with that wooden plank order from the federation? The marketing department is pressing us very hard.”
Li Ru gripped the pen in her hand tightly.
So ruthless!
Everything was set up by Qin Shuran!
Qin Shuran wanted to bury her in hell!
Zhang Linhui also felt that the atmosphere in the room was not right, so he suggested in a low voice.
“Why don’t we lower our heads to President Qin? Let’s make a phone call and ask President Qin what’s going on in Prison No. 5072′′
“Or, why don’t we try to invite Fang Heng back?”
“After all, it’s the property of Phoenix Sound Gaming Company. President Qin wouldn’t just stand by and do nothing, would she?”
“Secretary Zhang, I’d like to talk to President Li alone.”
Dai Zhe chased Zhang Linhui out of the office and stared at Li Ru.
“What else do you want to say? If you weren’t so impatient this time, we wouldn’t have been so passive if we waited until everything was clear before taking action!”
“There’s no point in talking about this anymore. Let me ask you, do you want to lower your head to Qin Shuran now? Do you expect her to let you off?”
pal”
‘The pen that Li Ru was holding tightly in her hand bounced off the table.
“Don’t even think about it!”
“Alright, I still have a way to redeem myself.”
“What way?”
Dai Zhe’s eyes were cold.
“Do whatever it takes to take down Prison No. 507. As long as Prison No. 507 is in our hands, there’s still room for redemption!”
“I don’t agree.”
“What?”
“My answer is no.” Li Ru stared at Dai Zhe. “As for what you should do next, that’s your problem.”
“Tsk!”
Dai Zhe gritted his teeth..
