chapters.title: Chapter 126 - Remote Mission
paragraphs: Translator: Nyoi-Bo StudioEditor: Nyoi-Bo Studio
‘The office building that Pei Anan rented was near Fang Heng’s rental apartment.
Fang Heng hung up the phone and ran over to take a look.
The environment around the office building could only be considered above average in all aspects.
‘The advantage was that the office building had a lot of space.
‘There was enough space in the office building to provide each employee with a separate lounge.
He wasn’t afraid of working overtime at night anymore!
This was it!
Fang Heng didn’t have the time to look at a few more. He signed the contract on the spot, paid the deposit for half a year in advance and ordered 20 of the latest game cabins.
If everything went smoothly, he could start work tomorrow!
The federally registered work studio wasn’t troublesome.
Fang Heng didn’t want to waste time. He directly signed a few entrustment contracts. Next, he only needed to entrust an agency to handle the work studio license.
He would be able to complete the registration within three days and officially open the work studio to the public.
After he was done with the formalities, Fang Heng hurried back to the rental apartment.
“Bang!”
Closing the door, Fang Heng let out a deep breath.
On the way back, he specially circled twice.
His perception was as high as 20 points, four times that of an ordinary person!
Fang Heng was very sure that he had not been followed during this trip.
Unless the other party was much stronger than him.
In that case, no matter how careful he was, it would be useless.
Fang Heng was slightly relieved.
If someone wanted to harm him, he would have done it long ago. He would not have waited until now.
The necessary vigilance was still maintained.
But for now, the focus was still on the development of the game.
After making up his mind, Fang Heng returned to the rental house and entered the game cabin.
‘When he entered the game again, it was already four o’clock in the afternoon.
Fang Heng returned to the basement shelter of the prison and lit a bonfire.
In the morning, he received a lot of missions from Vettel.
It was time to start clearing the missions!
Fang Heng immediately recalled the zombies who were carrying out the ‘demolition’ mission.
He roughly divided the zombie crowd into four groups and began to remotely control the zombies to complete the missions.
First, he assigned them according to the missions he received.
‘The first type was area protection.
The mission required players to clean up the zombies in an area and stay there for some time to ensure that the zombies that appeared later were killed.
That was easy!
Fang Heng controlled the zombies to go to the target location and arranged for them to clean up the zombies and stay there for a period to complete the mission.
The second type of mission was to clear the buildings.
The mission goal was mostly to clear the zombies in the designated buildings.
This was also simple!
He could remotely control the zombie clones directly to complete the mission.
As for the last type which was the area exploration mission, it was more troublesome.
This type of mission required the player to personally arrive at the target location and conduct a search.
Under normal circumstances, there would be a small number of zombies in the vicinity of the target area, and the mission would only be completed if the player cleared the zombies.
He could first send the zombie clones to the mission location to conduct a search and clear the area. By that time, he could ride a motorcycle to the mission location to complete the mission.
Fang Heng assigned the four teams of zombies to complete the missions.
As the zombies were unable to follow instructions in batches, Fang Heng could only complete the missions one by one and hack in batches.
Taking advantage of the time when the zombies were working, Fang Heng found a survival radio that he had not used for a long time from his backpack.
He quickly edited a message and posted it.
“Looking for mechanical maintenance skill books! Exchange for food or resources! The prices are good! Come quickly!”
Blackthorn mercenary group.
A veteran mercenary group that occupied the fifth and sixth positions in the federation’s top ten mercenary groups ranking all year round.
‘They had a good reputation and were strong.
‘The competition in the mercenary world had always been fierce.
Blackthorn was different from other mercenary groups. They took a different path. Their main business was the three primary games in the King of Gods’ game.
Among them, Team 7 led by Black Tiger ensured that all members were elites below Level 5.
They strictly carried out the card level plan.
This way, they could complete many missions that other mercenary groups could not accept.
Two hours ago, the Black Tiger team received the mission to seize the prison shelter.
‘The team of 20 people immediately changed their uniforms and entered District 8.
After they completed a round of supplies at the Server 8 supply point, they quickly headed toward the prison.
“Boss, I heard that this time it’s a fat sheep.”
The leader of Team 7 of the Blackthorn mercenary group, Black Tiger, nodded.
“Yes, the difficulty of this mission is rated $-level. The employer requested that the operation be kept confidential.”
“S-level? Is there a need to set it so high?”

‘They were equipped with tactical uniforms, bulletproof vests, pistols and machetes.
‘The entire team was even equipped with a flashbang and two small explosive packs.
Such a combat level was extremely terrifying in the early stages of the game!
“The target of this mission is the prison. It is estimated that we will reach the target location before sunset.”
Halfway through the team’s journey, the player who was leading the way suddenly stopped and made a stealth gesture.
The team immediately hid in the bushes.
Black Tiger sensed that something was wrong. He moved to the front of the team and asked, “What’s wrong?”
Cheng Bin, who was in charge of scouting, pointed at a spot not far away.
“Captain, look over there. Something is wrong.”
Black Tiger looked at a spot not far away.
He saw a shocking scene.
A group of zombies attacked another group of defenseless zombies with wooden spears in their hands...
Could the zombies use wooden spears as weapons?
They were even attacking one another?
“What’s going on?”
It was the first time the players saw such a strange thing. They looked at each other.
‘Were the zombies becoming silly from hunger?
Why were they eating their kind?
But how did they use weapons?
Evolved? Did they know how to use their brains?
It was strange. Why were there so many zombies?
A large group of zombies gathered in front of them. There were about 40 to 50 of them.
After the zombies killed their kind, they blocked the intersection.
‘What was the meaning of this?
Were they marking their territory?
‘This was a rare situation in the early stages of the game.
The players who were hiding in the bushes and secretly observing were all dumbfounded.

Black Tiger frowned.

Once the mercenary group received the mission, they set off to enter Server 8 in a hurry.
According to the plan, they would arrive at the prison before sunset.
But now, this group of zombies was blocking the intersection...
If they took a detour, the sun would set when they arrived at the prison and their combat power would be greatly reduced.
“We can’t wait any longer! Follow me!”
Black Tiger drew out his iron blade and made a tactical gesture to the back, indicating that the players were ready to attack.
All the players in the elite team had mastered the sword mastery skill and the basic strength training skill, and they would practice tactical positioning every day.
‘They were all experienced players.
Black Tiger analyzed the combat power of both sides, and he was confident that he would be able to deal with these zombies!

The Black Tiger roared and dashed out from the bushes.
He strode in front and took the lead to charge at the zombies.
The zombies were attracted by the noise made by Black Tiger and turned their heads in unison.
Black Tiger strode forward, raised his machete and slashed down on the shoulders of the zombies.

Black Tiger frowned.
Why did this slash feel wrong?
‘Why was the zombie so hard?

chapters.title: Chapter 127 - Escape
paragraphs: Translator: Nyoi-Bo StudioEditor: Nyoi-Bo Studio
“Chi! Chi Chi!!”
Several vine-like objects darted out of the wounds that were cut by the machete and quickly climbed up along the machete.
“What!?”
Black Tiger was shocked. He exerted force on his wrist and struggled to escape.
Such a special attack...
It was a vine zombie?!
However, there was a big difference between them and the vine zombies. They looked like ordinary zombies.
They were even more ‘fleshier’ than the vine zombies!
“Not good! Retreat!!!”
Black Tiger immediately shouted.
However, he was already a few seconds late. Most of the team members had already rushed toward the zombies.
The team members immediately encountered trouble.
Many players had already been entangled by the vines that came out from the vine zombies.
They were going to suffer!
Black Tiger no longer hesitated. He took out a blue flashbang and smashed it at his feet.
‘The ear-piercing ringing sound accompanied by a strong flash exploded in the zombie crowd.
‘The sound waves and strong light had a great restraining effect on the zombies.
All the zombies instantly stopped attacking.
“Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!”
The vines quickly retracted.
‘The small party of players also subconsciously lowered their heads to avoid the dazzling light.
“Quick! Follow me!”
“Run!”
Black Tiger shouted.
‘Taking advantage of the fact that the zombies were in a dizzy and blind state, Black Tiger quickly led the players through the zombie crowd and gradually moved away from the zombies.
In just a few seconds, the small party had suffered casualties!
Leaving the zombie horde, Black Tiger panted heavily.
His heart was bleeding!
The losses were too heavy!
Not to mention that everyone only had three chances to be reborn, just one flashbang alone cost 80 King of Gods’ points!
What puzzled him, even more, was why there were Tier 2 zombies in this godforsaken place?
Moreover, they were the so-called natural enemies of close-combat players among the Tier 2 zombies, the vine zombies!
If he hadn’t decisively used the flashbang, their entire team would have been wiped out!
“Damn it!”
Escaping from the pursuit of the zombie crowd, Black Tiger cursed and vented his anger.
“Phoenix Sound Gaming Company, that bunch of trash! They didn’t even provide such important information! When we go back, I’ll make them suffer!”
“Leader, it’s getting dark. Let’s finish the mission first!”
“Okay.”
Black Tiger took a deep breath and tried to control his emotions.
For now, the priority was to finish the mission.
It was going to be dark soon. The only thing they could do now was to take down the prison shelter as soon as possible!
“Let’s rest for five minutes to replenish our strength.”
Everyone quickly took out some food from their backpacks to replenish their strength and continued to rush towards the prison.
“Eh?
In the underground shelter of the prison, Fang Heng, who was grilling meat on a barbecue grill, was slightly surprised.
Rows of messages were refreshed in the game log.
[Hint: Your zombie (proliferator) has been attacked by a player.]
[Hint: Your zombie (proliferator) has attempted to dodge an attack, but failed. You have received dodge-experience point +1.]
[Hint: Your zombie (proliferator) kills a player. You have received skill: Butcher’s teaching-bleeding experience point +1. You have received skill: dodging experience point +1.]
(Hint: Your zombie...]
Did they encounter a player?
It was a rare situation.
‘There were not many players in the forest.

Fang Heng curled his lips. Due to the small number of players, the information that he had just released through the survival radio about purchasing a skill book had also sunk like a stone into the sea.
These people could only be considered unlucky to have encountered a group of zombie clones.
However...
[Hint: Your zombie group has been affected by the flashbang and has entered a blind state.}
[Hint: The player has escaped the battle area.]
[Hint: Your zombie group is no longer chasing after them. You are currently executing the original mission-guards are on standby.]

[Hint: In this battle, your zombie group has killed two players. You have received skill: blocking experience points +334, skill: dodging experience points +277 and skill: Butcher’s teaching-bleeding experience point +1.]
[Hint: Your blocking skill has been upgraded to Level 2 and your dodging skill has been upgraded to Level 2.]
“These people have flashbangs?”
Fang Heng was a little surprised.
He carefully looked at the game log and found another strange thing.
During the previous hack mission, the Butcher’s teaching skill had not gained any experience points.
After all, the Butcher’s teaching skill-bleeding effect only worked on players. Hence, it made sense that the experience points could only be gained by fighting against players.
However, why did the two skills, blocking and dodging, also gain so many experience points?
Previously, they had killed quite a few zombies during the mission. Among them, there were even Tier 1 mutated zombies.
However, these two skills did not gain any experience points!
Was it because ordinary zombies would not take the initiative to attack?
That was not right. Basic mutated zombies would also take the initiative to attack.
Or could it be that these two skills could only gain experience points by fighting against players?
This was a bit of a trap.
Fang Heng lowered his head, thinking about where to find some ignorant players to gain experience points.
After all, he was going to the dangerous Pine City in five days. The dodging and blocking skills on hand could effectively increase his combat power.
It was best to farm them in advance.

[Hint: Your zombie group has completed the mission to clear the camp. You have killed 229 ordinary zombies and one mutated zombie. You have received a total of 411 survival points, evolution crystal fragment*34.]
[Hint: You have completed the mission of clearing the abandoned camp. Please look for Vettel to collect your reward in time.]
[Hint: Your zombie group has completed the mission of searching the abandoned tourist camp...]
Seeing that the zombie group had completed the missions, Fang Heng continued to control them to head to the next mission location and grind experience points.
‘An hour later, outside the prison.
Black Tiger was standing on a hill in the distance.
He was looking at the prison with his binoculars.
It was actually...
‘An elite mercenary NPC of the Dark Knights?!
How was this possible?
Could it be a shelter built by both the NPC and the players?!
Cold sweat dripped down Black Tiger’s face.
This prison was too scary!
The trees around the prison were all artificially cleared by the players.
Anyone who tried to approach the prison would be easily discovered by the sentry tower guards!
Yes, there were sentry towers!
A row of densely packed sentry towers had been built in the inner part of the prison.
In addition, there were Dark Knight elites on the sentry towers!
Their people couldn’t break into this prison!
“Is Phoenix Sound Gaming Company crazy? Did they offend such a powerful enemy? Are they not afraid of death?”
Black Tiger cursed silently.
Even if Phoenix Sound was not afraid, they were still afraid!
He was glad that he kept his vigilance and had done a thorough investigation before attacking the prison.
Otherwise...
If they forcefully attacked the camp, he could not think of a second answer other than getting wiped out!
‘There were at least two Dark Knights’ NPCs guarding the sentry tower.
This was the prison’s ostensible defensive strength.
‘There was no need for two. They only needed an elite holding a sniper rifle to wipe out their entire group!
“Damn it! Phoenix Sound! Deliberately messing with our mercenary group?”
Having been tricked to come all the way here, Black Tiger was extremely furious.
He almost led his brothers to their deaths!
‘The other brothers in the team were also sweating profusely.
They didn’t die at the hands of zombies just now, and now they almost died at the hands of the Dark Knights.
Today, they had been hovering between life and death several times.
“Leader, what should we do?”
“Retreat! While the sky is still dark, go find a place to stay for one night. Tomorrow, we’ll change clothes and leave!”
Black Tiger gritted his teeth.
‘When he returned, he would seek an explanation from Phoenix Sound Gaming Company!
How could the difficulty of this mission only be S-level?
This mission was impossible to complete!

chapters.title: Chapter 128 - Zombie-ghost Claw
paragraphs: [Hint: Your mission has been completed-explore the outskirts of the forest. Please look for Vettel to receive your reward.]
[Hint: Your mission has been completed-explore the unknown region. Please...]
Fang Heng was driving a motorcycle as he sped through the forest.
The mission notifications kept ringing in his ears.
It was awesome!
Last night, Fang Heng had spent a whole night completing missions in the game!
He only went offline to rest for two hours after he had cleared all the missions!
The efficiency of the hack was amazing!
‘At dawn, Fang Heng drove his motorcycle to the mission target locations to complete the exploration missions.
Fang Heng only drove back to the apocalypse merchant camp after he had completed all 103 missions that he received from Vettel yesterday.
[Hint: You have completed mission*103. You have obtained a total of 13,900 survival points.]
[Hint: Your friendship with Vettel has increased significantly.]
“Fang Heng, how did you do it?”
Vettel had a thick stack of mission sheets in his hand.
He was a little confused.
In one day, he had completed more than 100 missions.
Fang Heng alone had cleared more than half of the camp’s missions.
He was simply a humanoid mission machine!
“Ican only say that this has something to do with my talent.”
Vettel nodded and stopped asking, “Alright, what else can I help you with?”
“Lalso need a skill book related to mechanical repair, you don’t seem to have it here?”
“Indeed, to be honest, you’ve already looked through my inventory.”
Vettel shrugged helplessly.
“Is that so...”
Fang Heng felt that this problem was a little tricky.
Repairing the damaged experimental equipment could greatly increase the speed of research.
He required this.
“Why not log off and post a post on the forum to receive skill books, or go to the black market to look for it?” Fang Heng thought to himself.
“But we’re friends.”
Vettel winked at Fang Heng.
“I know a hardware store not far from here.”
“The owner of that store and J are friends. Unfortunately, I haven’t heard from him since the apocalypse. I think he’s dead.”
“There should be a skill book in the hardware store that you’re looking for.”
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows.
“By the way, I heard that someone recently saw a special mutated zombie in the hardware store. You have to be careful when you go there.”
[Hint: You have found the relevant information about the hardware store.]
[Hint: You have obtained the specific coordinates of the hardware store.]
“Of course. Thank you so much, Vettel!”
Fang Heng looked at the location marked on the map.
The hardware store was outside the forest area. It would take about one and a half hours to drive the truck from here.
He would log off and sleep after completing the mission!
Fang Heng was still very excited after a whole night.
After saying goodbye to Vettel, he drank another bottle of coffee and drove the military truck to the hardware store.
According to Vettel, there might be mutated zombies in the hardware store.
To be safe, Fang Heng took a detour back to the abandoned iron mine.
The production of iron nuggets in the abandoned iron mine was on the right track.
23 furnaces were running 24 hours a day, and the iron nuggets were produced continuously.
It was estimated that all the zombie equipment upgrades could be completed within 2 days.
Fang Heng selected some zombie clones that had completed the equipment upgrades and stacked them behind the truck.
There were more than 50 of them.
Theoretically, the truck could carry more zombies.
After all, the vine zombies could be easily hung outside the truck.
However, Fang Heng didn’t do that.
This would cause the truck to flip!
An hour and a half later.
Fang Heng parked the truck in front of the hardware store.
The entire building of the hardware store had been reinforced.
Several layers of wood had been added to the outer windows.
Eh?
Players had already come?
Fang Heng frowned.
He noticed that the entrance of the hardware store had been vandalized.
He had to go in and check the situation!
Jumping out of the truck, Fang Heng controlled the vine zombies to enter the hardware store to check.
The vine zombies stumbled into the hardware store.
Fang Heng followed behind them, holding a shotgun in one hand.
‘As soon as he stepped into the room, Fang Heng keenly sensed danger and shifted his gaze to the comer.
The sense of danger came from there!
Because the light was too dim, Fang Heng could only see a dark shadow at the end of the corner.
It was a zombie!
The zombie in the corner smelled the scent of a living person and stood up shakily.
Then, the room was filled with the whimpering sounds of zombies.
Fang Heng quickly scanned his surroundings.
The interior of the hardware store was very narrow, and his vision was poor.
It was not suitable for battle!
He had to lure the zombies outside and kill them one by one!
After coming up with the battle plan, Fang Heng immediately stepped back while guiding the zombie clones out of the hardware store.
The zombies had low intelligence.
They were attracted by Fang Heng’s smell and staggered toward him.
Under Fang Heng’s control, the zombie clones formed a circle and stood outside the hardware store with iron spears in their hands.
Fang Heng stared at the door.
“They are coming!”
Fang Heng was surprised to see the zombies coming out of the hardware store.
“G-virus mutation!?”
‘It’s a Tier 2 mutated zombie-ghost claw!”
The effect of the G-virus caused the entire right hand of the ghost claw zombie to mutate.
Starting from the arm, the entire right hand of the ghost claw zombie turned black as if it was burnt.
The interlocking muscles on the arm were bulging, constantly twisting and squirming.
The five fingers had also mutated into sharp claws.
Its right arm was the most powerful weapon of the ghost claw zombies. At close range, it could pierce through a layer of steel!
The ghost claw zombies were extremely strong at destroying buildings!
Fang Heng didn’t want to get too close to such a dangerous zombie, so he hid far away.
The vine zombies had no consciousness, so they were fearless. They raised their spears and stabbed at the ghost claw zombies!
The ghost claw zombies that were attacked immediately waved their claws to counterattack.
“Chil!”
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows.
The ghost claw zombie’s black right arm pierced through the vine zombie’s body!
It made a hole in its body!
However, the vine zombie had a lot of HP and it had a strong vitality!
The thin vines quickly spread out from the wound that was pierced by the ghost claw and tried to lock the right arm of the ghost claw.
Unfortunately, the ghost claw on the right arm of the ghost claw zombie was terrifyingly strong!
“chil”
With a slight force, the ghost claw zombie easily broke free from the vines.
There were a total of five ghost claw zombies!
Fang Heng’s face was solemn.
It was a little troublesome.
The ghost claw zombie’s super strong ghost claw attack was just enough to counter the high defensive ability of the vine zombies!
He couldn’t use brute force!
Fang Heng immediately controlled the vine zombies to retreat, keeping a short distance from the ghost claw zombies.
In terms of difficulty, dealing with the ghost claw zombies was much easier than dealing with the Lickers!

After the popularity of firearms, normal players only needed to be a little more careful, pulling the ghost claw zombies into an open space, carefully controlling the distance like flying kites, and continuously dealing long-range damage to grind it to death.
Just like killing the vine zombies!
Fang Heng thought for a moment.
Hehe, got it!
He thought of an even better solution!

chapters.title: Chapter 129 - Bring Them Home
paragraphs: Fang Heng hid in the distance.
He controlled more than 50 vine zombies to continuously extend vines from their bodies.
The vines quickly extended towards the ghost claw of the ghost claw zombie, trying to entangle it.
The ghost claw zombie’s movement speed was slow. It was entangled by the vines, so it had no choice but to use the ghost claw on its right arm to break free from the vines.
However, just as it broke free, another vine wrapped around it.
Suppression by numbers!!!
The five ghost claw zombies were trapped by the vines of more than 50 vine zombies, unable to move!
At this time, Fang Heng maintained a safe distance.
He took out his pistol, aimed at the ghost claw zombie’s head, and started shooting.
“Bang!”
“Bang Bang!”
(Hint: Your attack missed.]
[Hint: You’ve hit a Tier 2 mutated zombie-ghost claw’s vital point. Your gun mastery skill experience points +5.]
[Hint: You’ve hit a Tier 2 mutated zombie-ghost claw’s vital point. Your gun mastery skill experience points +5.]
In the game, it was extremely difficult to obtain the experience points for gun mastery.
It was related to the difficulty of shooting and the strength of the target.
There would be an increase in experience points only when the player hit a vital part of the enemy or killed it.
In the early stages, due to the influence of the game, the attributes of the players were low, the level of their gun skills was low and the hit rate of their guns was even lower!
If they wanted to increase the level of their gun mastery, they would have to use a large number of bullets!
Fang Heng had been in the game for so long, but he was only at Level 3 gun mastery.
“Tl take this opportunity to practice my marksmanship. The sooner I reach Level 10, the sooner I’ll be able to use my sniper rifle.”
Seeing the ghost claw zombies being entangled by the vine zombies, Fang Heng didn’t panic anymore.
After all, his opponent was a Tier 2 mutated zombie. It was a rare opportunity!
How could he not take the opportunity to practice his marksmanship?
Fang Heng held his breath and focused. After aiming at the ghost claw zombie’s head, he began practising his marksmanship.
“Bang!”
“Bang! Bang!”
[Hint: You’ve hit the vital point of Tier 2 mutated zombie-ghost claw. Mutated zombie-ghost claw has died. Your gun mastery skill experience points +25.]
[Hint: Your gun mastery skill has been upgraded to Level 5.]
Fang Heng spent a full 20 minutes to level up his gun skill to Level 5.
Originally there were five ghost claw zombies, now there was only one left struggling.
It had long been entangled by the vines that spread out from the bodies of the remaining 50-odd vine zombies, leaving only its head exposed.
It was still trying to struggle.
Fang Heng was standing 30 meters away from it while he was shooting.

He had no choice. Shooting at such a close distance could ensure his accuracy, but the difficulty of shooting would become very low. Even if he shot the zombie’s head, he wouldn’t gain any experience points.
Fang Heng continued aiming at the zombie’s head and kept pressing the trigger.
His critical hit rate was about one-third.
Compared to when he was at Level 3, his accuracy had improved a lot.
While shooting, Fang Heng suddenly had a new idea.
He put down his gun and lowered his head to think.
He remembered that he had helped Qiu Yaokang bring a poisonous zombie back to the shelter to do research yesterday.
Similarly, live Lickers were also being studied in the shelter’s research room.
Following this train of thought.
Then...
Could he bring a live ghost claw zombie back to the shelter to do research?
Imagine if he could transform his zombie clone into a ghost claw zombie...
Fang Heng quickly thought about it.
“No, this thing is too stupid.”
“Lickers are better.”
But that didn’t hinder the research.
He could bring it back for research and capitalize on the strengths of the ghost claw zombie for research.
“Who cares!”
It was rare to meet a Tier 2 mutated zombie, so he decided to kidnap one first!
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes. He felt that this idea was pretty good!
He put away his gun and controlled the remaining vine zombies to surround the ghost claw zombie. The vines wrapped the ghost claw zombie up to ten layers.
“There should be no problem now, right?”
Fang Heng muttered to himself. He controlled the vine zombies to drag the entangled ghost claw zombie back to the back of the truck.
After clearing the zombies, it was time to loot.
Fang Heng turned around and looked at the hardware store.
Apart from the five mutated zombies, there were no ordinary zombies in the entire store.
Fang Heng felt that there might have been players who had explored the hardware store before and helped clear the ordinary zombies.
Unfortunately, they couldn’t do anything to the Tier 2 mutated zombies, so they could only leave quietly.
Fang Heng stood at the entrance and controlled the remaining zombies to enter the hardware store to search for materials.
After a short while, the zombies walked out of the store one by one and threw all the materials in front of Fang Heng.

[Hint: Your zombie group found a crowbar, mechanical maintenance manual*3, wrench*5, tire*3, jack*1, forged steel*2, simple maintenance bag*2, pliers*3, steel wire, mechanical assembly, blueprint-barbed wire...]
Ha! He got a skill book!
What a great harvest!
Fang Heng picked up the loot and looked at it.
(Mechanical maintenance manual]
Type: Skill book.

Skill description: After learning, you can master the skill-mechanical maintenance. Maintenance requires specific tools and consumable materials (maintenance success rate is related to the current skill level and the character’s basic attributes).
[Blueprint-barbed wire]
‘Type: Blueprint.
Description: After use, you can master the construction of barbed wire.

Barbed wire: Upgrades the normal barbed wire and increases the durability of the barbed wire by 20%. When the barbed wire receives close-range damage, it will reflect 20% of the damage received (ineffective against players, ineffective against large zombies).
Blueprint learning condition: Basic construction (Level 10).
Good stuff!
The harvest this time was simply too good to be true!
There were a total of three maintenance manuals. In addition to giving Qiu Yaokang one, he could also learn one and help out.
Fang Heng believed that with the help of his zombie clones, he could quickly level up his skills in a short period.
Unfortunately, as a player, Fang Heng’s skills could not exceed a character’s level. Currently, he could only upgrade to Level 13.
Qiu Yaokang was different. In theory, he could increase the level of his skills infinitely.
In addition, the barbed wire modification blueprint was also a good thing. It could act as a defense weapon for the shelter!
Other than the damage it dealt, it also had a hidden effect.
Against spider zombies!
Spider zombies that tried to climb the barbed wire would lose a lot of HP. It was very effective!
“Eh? There’s another skill book that I missed?”
Fang Heng found a skill book at the bottom of the materials.
[Eliot’s mechanical lecture notes-detailed explanation of mechanical disassembly and assembly]
Type: Skill book.

Skill description 1: After reading, learn the skill-mechanical disassembly. After learning the skill, players can use tools such as wrenches to disassemble mechanical objects. After disassembling, players can obtain parts of mechanical parts and components.
Skill description 2: Disassembling will consume additional vitality points.
(The number and level of the parts obtained from disassembling are related to the skill level).
Amazing! A skill book about disassembling!
Fang Heng was pleasantly surprised.
The skill of mechanical disassembly was very widely used!
In the old server, it was even hyped up by black merchants to the price of a B+ level skill book!
There was even a market for it!
Without the skill, ordinary players could only use a small stone hammer to disassemble the machinery.
After disassembling, they would usually get some scrap metal.
After learning the mechanical disassembly skill, it would be different.
He could use a wrench to disassemble higher-level parts and components.
Mechanical disassembly?!
Wasn’t this what his demolition operation needed right now?!
Fang Heng patted the three skill books on his head.
[Hint: You’ve learned skills: mechanical maintenance and mechanical disassembly; you’ve mastered blueprint: barbed wire.]
Next, he could control the zombie clones to disassemble machinery!
But before that, Fang Heng still needed to provide a wrench for each zombie clone.
Fang Heng thought and immediately gave the order to the zombie clones who were smelting iron in the abandoned mine..

chapters.title: Chapter 130 - G-virus
paragraphs: Back in the shelter, Fang Heng controlled the vine zombies to drag the ghost claw zombie, which was entangled with layers of vines, into the research room.
In the research room, Qiu Yaokang was checking the analysis report of the damaged equipment.
‘The extent of the damage was more serious than he had expected.
Without the relevant skills, it was very difficult to repair it.
Overall, the advantages outweighed the disadvantages.
After all, he had gained a laboratory for free. As long as he could repair it, his overall research speed could be greatly increased!
“Bang!”
Qiu Yaokang slightly frowned. He turned around and looked at Fang Heng, who had barged into the laboratory, with a displeased expression.
“Where’s your protective suit?”
“It’s an emergency. Next time!”
Fang Heng walked into the room casually, then signalled the vine zombies behind him to drag the ghost claw zombie into the lab.
“What’s this?”
“Hehe, good stuff, I caught a ghost claw zombie! It’s alive!”
Fang Heng smiled.
“Tier 2 ghost claw zombie? Are you talking about the G-virus carrier?”
Qiu Yaokang’s spirits were lifted!
He didn’t care about the protective suit anymore and walked toward the ghost claw zombie regardless of the danger.
“Be careful. It’s dangerous.”
Qiu Yaokang stopped in front of the ghost claw zombie and observed it closely.
He spent a long time looking at it.
He found that the ghost claw zombie was wrapped with more than ten layers of vines.
He couldn’t even see it clearly, so he couldn’t study it at all.
Qiu Yaokang turned his head and pointed at the cultivation pod beside him.
“Is there a way to put it into the cultivation pod and observe it? As long as it’s soaked in a special liquid, it will fall into a dormant state like the Lickers.”
Fang Heng thought for a moment.
“We can try. You can open the hatch from the top of the cultivation pod.”
“Wait a moment.”

“The hardware store, in the outer area of the forest. It’s a little far from here and it’s near an abandoned town over there.”
Qiu Yaokang frowned again.
Fang Heng was confused.
“What’s wrong?”
“Something’s wrong.”

“The G-virus is a special virus developed based on the T-virus. Not only can it change the genetic factors of living organisms, but it can also cause the genes of infected organisms to evolve and mutate.”
Qiu Yaokang looked at the ghost claw zombie.

“The origin of this biochemical virus leak is the T-virus. In theory, the mutation of the G-virus is the secret research of Meteorite Company. I think it’s a little strange that the ghost claw zombie appeared in that place.”
“There seems to be a problem.”

He didn’t search carefully when he entered the hardware store. He only instructed the zombie crowd to go in and search the place and make sure that the room was not locked.

“Pine City houses Meteorite Company’s largest research laboratory. I heard from a friend that after the disaster broke out, the virus content in the air around that area has increased significantly.”

chapters.title: Chapter 131 - One Mistake
paragraphs: “You can leave now. Don’t stay here and affect my research progress.”
[Hint: Qiu Yaokang’s favorability has slightly decreased. His loyalty has decreased to 98.]
“Hey, don’t be like that. It was just one mistake.”
“My zombie can help you. Trust me one more time!”
Qiu Yaokang’s eyelids twitched as he started pushing Fang Heng out of the lab.
“Fang Heng, I’m going to carry out my research. I need some peace. Please leave this place. If there’s nothing else, don’t disturb me.”
“Don’t, don’t be angry. It was just a mistake.”
“Give me another chance. Trust me, I’ll come back tomorrow. It’s too inefficient for you to repair it by yourself. I promise I can do it.”
Fang Heng forcefully blocked the door and refused to leave.
“alright, do you have any basic machinery? The ones that are easier to fix? Let me practice first.”
Qiu Yaokang stopped and pointed at a few blood analyzers.
“I don’t need those three machines for the time being.”
“alright, I’ll take them away first. I promise I’ll give you a surprise tomorrow.”
While speaking, Fang Heng controlled the vine zombies to carry away the blood analyzers that were piled up in the corner.
Qiu Yaokang closed the lab door and started to repair the cultivation pod.
Half an hour later, the repair of the hatch of the cultivation pod was completed. Qiu Yaokang rubbed his temples.
Repairing machinery was very exhausting.
In addition, after the repair reached a certain stage, high-level precision devices would be needed.
He didn’t know if there were any in the warehouse.
Qiu Yaokang left the lab and went to the underground warehouse.
In the entire shelter, except for Fang Heng, Qiu Yaokang was the only one who had access to the warehouse in the first basement.
He pushed open the door of the warehouse.
Qiu Yaokang paused.
He saw that in the middle of the warehouse were three blood sample analyzers that had been removed from the lab.
Seven zombies were repairing the analyzers, and long channelling bars appeared on their heads.
Qiu Yaokang had a look of disbelief on his face.
‘The zombie clones could perform high-precision movements like mechanical maintenance?
He thought that the zombie clone was strong enough, but he didn’t expect it to be even stronger.
“Eh?
Qiu Yaokang noticed something again.
Ina corner of the warehouse, another vine zombie suddenly made a move.
It held an iron rod in its hand and slowly walked forward. It raised the iron rod and knocked on the blood sample analyzer a few times.
“Bang! Bang Bang!”
After knocking on the three sample analyzers one after another, it slowly walked back to its original spot.
It seemed that nothing had happened.
What was it doing?
Qiu Yaokang was in a daze for a moment.
Looking at the zombies who continued to repair the equipment regardless of the situation, Qiu Yaokang became enlightened.
He narrowed his eyes and murmured to himself.
“Isee. The zombie clone also has some kind of learning ability.”
“What a terrifying skill.”
“Thope this ability can help us change this world.”
[Hint: Your zombie has completed the repair. Your mechanical experience points +4.]
[Hint: Your zombie has caused damage to the blood sample analyzer...]
(Hint: Your skill-mechanical maintenance has been upgraded to Level 6.]
In the newly built canteen on the second floor of the prison.
Fang Heng had not slept for the whole night. He went offline and rested for more than five hours before returning here to look for food.
While eating, he checked the game log.
“Not bad, the maintenance skill has been upgraded to Level 6.”
Fang Heng muttered softly.
He was very satisfied with the assembly line in the warehouse to gain skill experience points before he went offline!
‘The zombies destroyed the equipment every 30 minutes in a cycle.
‘As long as there were enough materials, the seven zombies could continuously repair the sample analyzer for one night.
If they continued to hack for another night, they would probably be able to level up their mechanical maintenance skills to Level 10!
Ha! Tomorrow, he would be able to face Qiu Yaokang!
“Boss, you’re here. I’ve been looking for you for a long time.”
Fang Heng raised his head.
He saw Liao Bufan walking towards him with Liu Yi and the others.
Liu Yi and the others followed behind Liao Bufan, looking dejected.
“What’s wrong? Every one of you?”
Fang Heng felt strange.
Could it be that they were in trouble?
“Fang Heng, we’ve been played!”
“Sit down and talk slowly.”
Liao Bufan moved a stool and sat down. He gestured at Liu Yi and said, “Come, sit down and tell the boss in detail.”
Liu Yi and the others sat down as well.
“According to the boss’ request, we have been in contact with the players in the nearby shelters over the past two days.”
“Most of the players were satisfied with the conditions that we provided. They left quickly after taking the materials.”
“Only one of them gave us trouble.”
Fang Heng was confused. “What trouble? They are not willing to move?”
“There are two that don’t want to move, but they are not the most troublesome ones.”
Liu Yi took out a hand-drawn map and drew a circle on it.
“This place has a shelter built by players. The shelter is built by the system. Roughly, about 15 players are living in it.”
“At first, they agreed to the conditions of moving and accepted our materials.”
“But when we went over today, we found that they had no intention of leaving.”
“Largued with them, and they began to act like hoodlums.”
“They said that the materials we gave them were not enough for them to relocate. They hoped that we would give them more.”
Fang Heng’s expression darkened.
It was obvious that the other party had no intention of moving away.
They had cheated them of their money!
“Fang Heng, we have to teach them a hard lesson. Otherwise, if others follow suit, our prison’s expansion plan will be in big trouble.”
“Okay.”
Fang Heng had the same thought.
‘The shelter was currently in a state of rapid expansion.
Such a matter had to be dealt with quickly.
The longer it dragged on, the more troublesome it would be!
Liu Yi shrunk his neck. “Boss, I was so angry that I argued with them a few times. They claimed to be from Captain Company. They even said that we could go and find trouble with them anytime.”
Captain Company?
Fang Heng recalled for a moment.
In his impression, it was a multinational company that belonged to an established family based overseas.
It seemed that Captain Company had already thought of ‘swallowing’ this batch of materials.
There was no fear in them.
“So confident? Then I won’t stand on ceremony...”
Wasn’t it just a multinational company?
Fang Heng didn’t care.

It just so happened that during the day, he was still thinking about finding players to level up his blocking and dodging skills. It seemed that an opportunity had been delivered to his doorstep at night.
After making up his mind, Fang Heng raised his head and said, “Thank you for your hard work. Rest early tonight and take a day off tomorrow. Leave the shelter issue to me.”
The rookies looked at each other.
Could the boss really handle it?
After all, it was a multinational company, and the shelter had been built. There were also all kinds of fortifications...
“Hey, what’s with the expressions on your faces? Are you all not happy that the boss has given you a day off? Why aren’t you thanking him?”

Liao Bufan looked at the rookies who were worried about personal gains and losses and waved his hand. “The boss said that he would definitely handle it. Go back and rest for a day.. Go online the day after tomorrow and wait for the good news!”

chapters.title: Chapter 132 - Helping to Gain Experience
paragraphs: ‘When night fell, Fang Heng hid in the basement of the shelter.
He activated long-range zombie control!
The current strength of ordinary players could not withstand so many Tier 2 vine zombies.
Not to mention at night!
He directly used the simplest and most brutal method.
“Forceful demolition!”
“Directly smash their shelter!”
“At the same time, try out the new iron spear!”
Fang Heng rubbed his hands.
He was a little excited.
Except for the necessary hack positions, Fang Heng controlled more than 100 vine zombies to gather in a group, equipped them with weapons and tools, and headed to the shelter aggressively.
The player’s shelter, at the foot of the mountain.
The small shelter was based on the original system building.
Sixteen players occupied the place.
After the sun had set, everyone sat around the bonfire.
“They did send us a batch of food. I didn’t think there would be such a fool.”
Anter laughed disdainfully.
The short-haired girl, Mira, on the other hand, felt uneasy.
“Anter, it’s better to be careful. I’ve been to the prison shelter once before. If they can take it down, they have some strength.”
“Moreover, they can provide us with sufficient materials and ‘compensation’. This means that their shelter does not lack food.”
“So what if they are strong?”
Anter saw that Mira opposed his decision and instinctively started to defend himself. “Don’t tell me they still dare to attack our camp?”
“When we first met, I asked them. They don’t belong to any gaming company.”
“The company will send someone over in a few months. By then, the prison will be ours.”
Anter was a little unhappy. He looked at Mira.
“What? You have already finished the food. Are you afraid now?”
Mira said, “It’s not that I’m afraid. Please discuss it with us before you make such a decision next time.”
A dark and skinny player interrupted their argument.
“Shh! Don’t speak! Listen.”
‘The shelter instantly became quiet.
“What’s that noise outside?”
A dull, cracking sound.
Not good!
It was the sound of the outer buildings of the shelter being attacked!
“There are zombies!”
Everyone immediately became alert and raised their weapons to leave.
‘When they opened the wooden door, the players’ expressions changed.
It was a zombie crowd!
They didn’t know when it started, but there was a circle of zombies outside the shelter!
‘The sky was too dark. At first glance, there were about seventy zombies.
How could there be so many zombies!?
Anter subconsciously looked up at the moon.
The blood moon was still early!
‘Then why did so many zombies suddenly attack the shelter?!
They were in big trouble!
Acircle of spiked fences and traps was set around the shelter.
Because of this, the zombies were blocked outside.
But what made the players feel strange was that this group of zombies was different from ordinary zombies!
‘The zombies were waving their spears, trying to attack the spiked fences and traps outside the shelter!
“Let’s dash out! We can’t let them break through the defenses of the shelter, or we’ll die!”
Mira was the first to react. She pulled out her sword.
‘Once the wooden stakes and spiked traps were destroyed, the next target would be the shelter!
“Get rid of them!”
The players didn’t have time to think. They followed Mira and rushed forward, trying to destroy the wave of zombies.
Mira, who was at the front, pulled her long sword and slashed at the zombies at the front.
The long sword cut the zombie’s neck.
“Chi! Chi! Chi!”
Fine vines shot out from the cut and wrapped around the long sword. They quickly spread along the blade!
“It’s a Tier 2 vine zombie!”
Mira’s heart skipped a beat. She threw away the long sword in her hand and jumped backwards.
“Be careful! Don’t get close to them! !”
What the hell! It was a Tier 2 mutated zombie?!
Anter was shocked. He hurriedly took out his pistol and fired a few shots at the vine zombie.
After being shot, the zombie showed a slightly stiff reaction.
Guns had little effect on the vine zombie, which had more than 1000 HP.
After firing all the bullets in one clip, the vine zombie paused and continued to attack the wooden stake.
“Tier 2 vine zombie, coupled with the vine entanglement skill at close range!”
“Don’t get close to them! Switch to bows and arrows!”
“Switch to incendiary arrows!”
Mira shouted and ordered the players to defend, their minds stretched to the limit.
The players could no longer think about why the shelter was surrounded by so many Tier 2 zombies.
In desperation, they all unleashed their greatest potential, looking for the possibility of survival.
“Follow me. Don’t let them attack the wooden stakes. The vine zombies are very slow. Let’s go out and attack them! Pull them away!”
“Every five minutes, go back to the shelter to rest! Remove the dark fear DEBUFF! Don’t stay out too long at night!”
“Why are the incendiary arrows ineffective against them?!”
“Quick! Two more people, work with me on the wooden stakes!”
“Don’t try to kill them! Their HP is too high, they can’t be killed! Lure them! Lure them out to the periphery of the shelter!”
The players shouted, using bows and arrows to attract the attention of the zombies.
Fang Heng sat in front of the bonfire in the basement.
To reward himself for working overtime and playing games tonight, he opened another bag of Oreo cookies.
He thought that this was a sure-fire demolition.
But here came the interesting part.
“Oh? Kite flying!?”
This group of people had something! They were much better than Prisoner Snake and the others.
Fang Heng saw the game notification and jumped up.

(Hint: Your zombie has received a long-range attack. It attempted to dodge but failed. Your skill-dodging experience point +1.]

(Hint: Your skill-blocking has been upgraded to Level 4.]
(Hint: Your zombi
‘The experience points gained from blocking and dodging skills soared!
‘The combat power of this group of people was beyond Fang Heng’s expectations.
They had built defensive facilities around their shelter, and they also had pistols as their weapons.
After twenty rounds, they had run out of bullets.
Fang Heng lowered his head and had another idea.
According to the original plan, he could manually control the zombies.
He only needed to send a group of vine zombies to attack the shelter and interfere with the kiting plan.
But...
Fang Heng hesitated.
Wasn’t it a bit of a waste?
It wasn’t easy to find a group of combat-capable players who could farm skill levels.
If he killed them all at once, wouldn’t he have nothing to play with?
Let’s be greedy!
After all, the ones he sent out this time were all proliferators. They could be reborn in six hours.
Fang Heng hesitated for a moment and decided to seize the opportunity to be greedy.
He reduced the number of zombies by nearly half and let them hide in the darkness to help reduce the pressure on the enemy.
The remaining 50 zombies continued to use this group of players to farm for skill experience points!
He would wait until the skill was maximised before completely killing them!
Fang Heng braced himself and gulped down a bottle of coffee.
He kept his eyes on the game log at all times.
He had to master a certain degree. If he accidentally used too much strength, he would kill all of them, and then there would be nothing left to play.
“I still have to control the damage output. It’s tiriny

chapters.title: Chapter 133 - An Unexpected Discovery
paragraphs: After a night of fear, the next morning...
Mira logged into the game.
Last night, the zombie attack didn’t end until 2:00 a.m.
Everyone was exhausted.
In the end, they almost ran out of ammunition!
Just a little bit more, and the shelter they worked so hard to build would fall.
Fortunately, they held on.
But they also paid the price with the lives of two members.
Mira didn’t sleep well. She returned to the game immediately after dawn.
The other players were still offline and resting.
‘The two players who stayed behind were also sleeping at their desks.
Mira took out the remaining wooden planks from the shelter and prepared to repair the spike traps and stakes destroyed by the zombies last night.
She pushed open the door of the shelter.
Mira froze on the spot.
During the day, her vision was unusually clear.
She saw more zombies than last night.
The zombies were standing about 100 meters away from the shelter.
They didn’t do anything, nor did they make any movements. They just stood there in a daze.
‘There were twice as many of them as last night!
A layer of cold sweat appeared on Mira’s forehead.
“Bang!”
She closed the door with a bang and tured back to the room, waking up all the sleeping players.
‘A few minutes later, the players who had received the warning from the King of Gods’ game came online one by one.
‘Their faces were tired and their eyes were sleepy.
They had been fighting for the whole night. How long had they slept?
“The zombies! They didn’t leave last night! They were staying outside the shelter!”
Mira led everyone to the gate of the shelter and pushed it open.
Everyone saw the zombie crowd outside the camp.
The players were silent.
The shelter was filled with despair.
They felt their hearts clench.
After last night’s ‘catastrophe’, most of the defensive structures around the shelter had been destroyed. There weren’t many left!
Not to mention, they didn’t have enough arrows.
If these zombies attacked the shelter again.
They wouldn’t be able to hold on!
“Why are there so many zombies?”
“How should I know?”
“They seem to be gathering their friends nearby. These zombies are targeting us!”
“What are you talking about? How can zombies gather their friends?”
“Should we try to lure them away?”
“Don’t go! What if we anger the zombies and they attack our shelter?”
“Calm down!”
Anter stood up and tried to calm the players down.
“I’ve reported the situation of the shelter to the company. The company has already paid a high price to hire a professional mercenary group to help us deal with the zombies.”
“Hold on for another two hours. The mercenaries will arrive in two hours to help us defend the shelter.”
Anter’s words made the players feel a little more at ease.
With the help of professional mercenaries, they might still be able to defend the shelter.
“Don’t you think this group of zombies is very strange?”
Mira had been deep in thought before, but now she suddenly raised her head, her expression unusually serious.
“Yesterday, I killed a vine zombie. Later, I carefully checked the game log.”
Anter looked unhappy and asked, “Mira, is there something wrong?”
“The game log shows that I didn’t get any evolution crystal fragments or survival points after killing the zombie.”
‘The other players also looked confused.
It was understandable that there were no crystal fragments, but without survival points...
Anter seemed to have caught something.
“Mira, what are you trying to say?”
“Tm wondering if someone is controlling this group of zombies?”
Mira looked worried.
“I think they might be related to the prison players we met yesterday.”
The prison players?
It sounded far-fetched, but after Mira’s analysis, it did make sense.
‘The players all had strange expressions.
Players who could control the zombie crowd?
They all looked at Anter almost at the same time.
If it was the prison players, then it would be troublesome.
Anter had offended the prison group badly yesterday!
‘The zombies were here for revenge!
“Don’t talk nonsense! How could the players have the ability to control the zombie crowd!”
Anter shouted angrily, “Stop thinking about it! This is nonsense anyway!”
“The company has already paid the Blackthorn mercenary group to help us protect the shelter!”
“Now, we need to work together to survive these two hours!”
[Hint: During the time you are offline, your zombie group has completed the production of iron*555 and the mining of iron ore*2615.]
[Hint: While you were offline, your zombies continued to perform mechanical maintenance. You have gained 5399 experience points for mechanical maintenance.
{Hint: Your mechanical maintenance skill has been upgraded to Level 11.]
[Hint: Part of your zombie group is on standby.)
It was past nine o’clock when Fang Heng got up and entered the game.
He was a little sleepy!
Last night, he made use of Captain Company to level up until midnight.
‘When he felt that the players of Captain Company were about to lose their members, Fang Heng ordered the zombies to stop attacking.
He was prepared to give the players some time to catch their breath before he continued to level up.
“Sigh, it’s really tiring to control my strength and tease these players.”
Fang Heng sighed and glanced at the game log.
The results of last night’s battle were gratifying.
Dodging and blocking skills had all been upgraded to Level 7.
“In one night’s time, the Captain Company should have almost finished repairing, right? Their combat strength should have recovered quite a bit...”
“Wait a little longer. Let them make some more arrows and once they are done, we’ll start killing them at noon.”
Fang Heng’s eyes flashed with coldness.
There was still some time, so he went to the hardware store to deal with the follow-up mission of the G-virus.
He would kill them when he returned!
It would take an hour and a half to go to the hardware store from the shelter.
Fang Heng drove the car, which was full of vine zombies.
When he was about to arrive at the hardware store, the car passed by a few players who were walking.
Ever since he entered the game, Fang Heng rarely met other players in the wild.
He subconsciously looked at them a few more times.
Fang Heng saw a familiar figure.
Huh??
‘Through the rearview mirror, Fang Heng suddenly narrowed his eyes and repeatedly confirmed.
It was him!
Old Black!
Fang Heng’s heart pounded rapidly.
Ever since the last Hope Town incident, Fang Heng had never heard of Old Black’s whereabouts.
It was as if Old Black had disappeared from the face of the Earth.
After the incident, Fang Heng had overheard Chen Yu talking about it.
‘The federation believed that Alex’s riot was caused by an anti-federal organization.
‘They had even found out about Chen Yu had notarized the mission with Old Black at the federal notary office.
However, Chen Yu knew what to do. He took the responsibility alone, claiming that he accepted the mission on his own and that he had been under the federation’s scrutiny for a period of time.
Later, Chen Yu revealed that Old Black was also a member of an anti-federal organization..

chapters.title: Chapter 134 - Hiding
paragraphs: “I didn’t expect to meet Old Black here.”
Fang Heng was thinking while driving the truck.
Fang Heng had suspected something when he was exploring the hardware store.
The hardware store showed signs of being explored beforehand.
The direction of this road was to the hardware store.
Was it a coincidence?
Could it be that Old Black and the others were the ones who explored the hardware store in advance?
Fang Heng sped up the truck and drove to the hardware store.
For safety reasons, he hid the truck in the bushes by the roadside, leaving a few vine zombies to guard the truck.
Then, Fang Heng controlled another zombie to stand on the road outside the hardware store.
After making the preparations, Fang Heng led a group of more than twenty vine zombies into the hardware store.
After entering the store, Fang Heng quickly scanned the interior of the hardware store.
Just like yesterday, the zombies inside the hardware store had been cleaned up.
There were no zombies.
The shelves were also cleaned up yesterday.
There was a small warehouse and a small office behind the hardware store.
Fang Heng searched the two areas in detail.
But still, he found nothing.
“Tcan’t find it. Could it be that Qiu Yaokang made a wrong judgment?”
Fang Heng stood in the middle of the room, muttering to himself. He looked around the room, searching for places where items might be hidden.
‘While he was searching, the game log suddenly refreshed.
(Hint: Your zombie has encountered an attack. Your zombie has tried to dodge...Dodge failed! You have gained dodging experience point +1.]
“Here it comes!”
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat.
The zombies outside the hardware store had been attacked!
Fang Heng quickly walked to the door of the hardware store.
He hid his body, turned sideways and carefully observed the situation outside.
“That’s right!”
“I’s Old Black and the others!”
Fang Heng saw Old Black and his other three companions dealing with the vine zombie clones outside the store.
It seemed that their target was the hardware store as well.
Something that could interest Old Black, an anti-federal organization figure, was probably not some ordinary mechanical skill book.
Qiu Yaokang’s judgment was probably right. There should be some hidden items in this hardware store.
“Perfect. I can’t find them anyway. Why don’t I let them explore the place first?”
Fang Heng had an idea.
However, he had to find a place to hide first.
Fang Heng took a few steps back and glanced around the interior of the hardware store again.
‘Where could he hide so many zombies?
Finally, Fang Heng slowly raised his head and looked at the steel beams above the hardware store.
“Got it!”
“Chi... Chi.
The zombie clones all extended long and narrow vines from their bodies.
One end of the vines slowly rose and wrapped around the beams, then pulled the zombies up.
“Chi... Chi...”
‘When the vine zombies climbed onto the upper floor of the shelf and above the steel beam, a few more vines descended from above, wrapping around Fang Heng and slowly lifting him.
Seeing Old Black and the others gradually approaching, Fang Heng also activated his stealth skill.
Not long after, a four-man team cleared the vine zombies along the way and gradually approached the hardware store.
Deng Xin, the team leader with long chestnut hair, observed the hardware store.
She was a little confused.
The zombie that they had just disposed of was abnormal.
Theoretically, there shouldn’t be any vines in this area.
“According to the plan, lure the ghost claw zombies out and use explosives to seriously wound them. Then, we’ll destroy them one by one.”
The other two male team members nodded hard.
Old Black slowly walked to the side and leaned against the streetlight.
“Be careful. I won’t go in with you guys. I will stay outside to prevent any accidents from happening.”
The two companions in Deng Xin’s team nodded and entered the hardware store together.
As the windows of the hardware store were all closed, the interior of the hardware store was unusually dark.
The team members turned on their torches and quickly scanned the area, then immediately shone them at the corners of the hardware store.
“Eh? Where are the zombies?”
The corners that were illuminated by the torches were completely wiped clean.
Deng Xin and the other two members were surprised.
“Strange? Where are the ghost claw zombies from before?”
The team came here two days ago and cleared out the ordinary zombies in the outer area.
However, when they faced the last five ghost claw zombies, they had no choice but to temporarily stop the mission because of their limited ammunition.
Deng Xin flipped over the shelf beside her and said in a deep voice, “Be careful. Someone arrived before us. The hardware store has already been cleared...”
Everyone was surprised.
Which team could deal with five ghost claw zombies at the same time?
The ghost claw zombies were different from the vine zombies. Their ghost claw could block.
Unless they had great willpower, ordinary players would not be able to kill them with bows and arrows!
If they used guns, it would be extremely difficult to get guns in the early stages of the game, not to mention that it would consume a lot of bullets!
They had also spent a lot of effort to get two sets of explosives from their employer. They were planning to use the explosives to kill the ghost claw zombies.
“That’s good too. It saves us a lot of trouble.”
“I wonder if the mission has been triggered.”
“It shouldn’t be a problem. Only we have the password book for the safe. Even if ordinary players are lucky enough to find the secret passage, they don’t have the password.”
Deng Xin used her flashlight to search the surroundings. After confirming that there was no danger in the hardware store, she relaxed a little.
“Mu Zikun, go and check the warehouse and office at the back.”
“Tang Xun, go outside and tell Old Black that the hardware store has been cleaned in advance. Ask him what to do next.”
“Okay!”
Deng Xin finished her task.
She walked forward alone until she reached a row of shelves in the comer.
‘Mu Zikun and Tang Xun soon came back.
“Sister Xin, we’ve checked. There’s no one in the warehouse or the office. The shelves inside have also been searched. We’ve confirmed that someone was here before us.”
“Old Black told us to continue the plan and find the G-virus sample first.”
“Okay.”
Deng Xin nodded.
She noticed that the location of the secret passage had not been moved.
She was lucky!
She had planned to kill all the ghost claw zombies this time, but she didn’t expect that someone would help her in advance.
And it seemed that this forerunner didn’t realize that there was a hidden passage here.
“You two move it away.”
Mu Zikun and Tang Xun walked to the two sides of the shelf.
One pushed, the other pulled.
“Crack...”
The shelf was slowly pushed away, revealing the entrance of the passage behind it.
“Old Black’s intelligence was right. The entrance is behind the shelves.”
Deng Xin was delighted.
With that, they were one step closer to completing their mission.
However, Deng Xin and the other two didn’t notice that Fang Heng was squatting on top of a shelf behind them, coldly watching them.
It wasn’t just Fang Heng.
Ina place that Deng Xin and the others couldn’t see, more than twenty vine zombies were hiding on the top of some shelves and the steel beams!
The room was extremely dark and the cardboard boxes completely covered their bodies.
In addition, Fang Heng and the zombies both could conceal their auras.
Deng Xin’s players easily overlooked the ceiling which was a blind spot.
They didn’t even realize the existence of Fang Heng and the zombie group!

chapters.title: Chapter 135 - Sneak Attack
paragraphs: “G-virus? There’s a secret passage and a safe?”
Listening to their conversation, Fang Heng thought that he was lucky.
Fortunately, he met this group of people who showed him the way. Otherwise, it would have taken him a long time to search the hardware store by himself.
If he didn’t meet Old Black and the others, Fang Heng would probably have asked the zombies to tear down the entire hardware store!
It would take a lot of time and effort to do that, and he didn’t know the password to the hidden safe.
Fang Heng hid in the dark and took out a concave-shaped mask from his backpack.
Putting on the mask, Fang Heng secretly ordered the vine zombies to launch a sneak attack.
Deng Xin and the other two didn’t notice anything strange. They pushed the shelf open with great effort, revealing the hidden door behind the shelf.
Seeing that the passage was opened, Deng Xin was about to say something.
Suddenly, she felt a cold sensation coming from the back of her neck.
“Chi! Chi! Chi!!!”
‘The faint sound made Deng Xin quiver.
She didn’t have time to turn around, her pupils suddenly constricted.
“Chi! Chi! Chi! Chi!!”
In the next moment, Deng Xin felt that her neck was tightly grasped by someone!
She subconsciously reached out to touch her throat.
“Shoosh!”
“Dong! !”
Deng Xin’s throat was tightly wrapped by the vines, and she was lifted into the air!
In the process, her body crashed into a shelf at the side with a loud thump.
“What!!”
Everything happened in a flash.
‘Mu Zikun and Tang Xun heard the sound, and as soon as they turned their heads, their expressions changed drastically!
The vines hanging from the sky grabbed onto Deng Xin’s neck, pulling her up and hanging her in the air.
Vines?!
Where did they come from?
Their hearts pounded violently and they immediately looked up.
Five or six vine zombies were clinging to the steel beam with their vines!
Deng Xin struggled with all her might. She frantically took out her machete and stabbed upwards, trying to save herself.
“Hold on!”
Mu Zikun was the first to regain his senses. He rushed forward to help.
Just as he was about to go forward, he seemed to have tripped on something and stumbled as he rushed forward.
Mu Zikun let out a blood-curdling scream.
‘The world spun around him.
He was dragged up into the air by the vines wrapped around his feet.
‘Mu Zikun’s mind was buzzing.
It was not easy for him to get used to the world upside-down. He quickly looked around and tried to escape.
Mu Zikun’s heart sank.
It’s over!
‘Tang Xun was in the same predicament as him. His feet were tightly wrapped by the vines and he was hanging upside down in the air.
“Chi! Chi! Chi!”
More and more vines were wrapped around Mu Zikun and Tang Xun until their hands and feet were all tightly bounded!
On the other side, Deng Xin was wrapped by the vines to the point of suffocation. She felt her vision becoming increasingly blurry.
She could no longer hold on to the knife in her hand and it eventually fell to the ground.
Suddenly, the vines around Deng Xin’s neck loosened.
“Bang!”
Deng Xin fell heavily to the ground with a bang.
Barely surviving from the attack, Deng Xin could not help but cover her throat and cough dryly.
“Cough! Cough! Cough! Cough! Cough!”
Deng Xin raised her head and before she could even save her teammates, a black muzzle was placed on her face.
Deng Xin’s face was pale.
Fang Heng used a large-calibre shotgun in front of Deng Xin.
“Come, give me a reason to let you live.”
Deng Xin looked at Fang Heng in horror.
Fang Heng’s entire body was hidden in the shadows.
The cartoonish mask on his face made Deng Xin’s hair stand on end.
“We can give you everything we have. As long as you let us go, we can also give you everything outside of the game.”
“Tsk, tsk, tsk. Don’t play tricks with me.”
“article 66 of the federal emergency evacuation regulations. You can take whatever you want from the King of Gods’ game, but once you are outside of the game, it’s considered extortion.”
Fang Heng curled his lips, cocked his head and asked, “Do you want to live?”
Deng Xin did not want to die. She nodded frantically.
After calming down and thinking about it, Deng Xin finally realized how terrifying this mysterious person in front of her was.
Above her head, the densely packed vine zombies hiding in the darkness were all manipulated by him!
This person was a demon!
He had been hiding here from the start! He was waiting for the team to come knocking on his door.
After briefly weighing the difference in strength between the two sides, Deng Xin immediately lost the will to resist.
She couldn’t win!
All she wanted now was to survive.
“Take out everything in your backpack.”
Deng Xin immediately did as she was told. She emptied all the materials in her backpack and placed them on the ground one by one.
Fang Heng pointed his shotgun at Deng Xin and stared at her coldly.
On the surface, he remained calm, but in his heart, he was excited with what she got.
Good fellow!
She even brought a pistol and a small explosive pack!
Fang Heng thought that this group of people had indeed come prepared. He quickly put all of Deng Xin’s materials back into his backpack.
“Very good. I need to know some things. If we cooperate, I can spare your life.”
Deng Xin quickly nodded. “We will work together!”
“Okay.”
Fang Heng nodded and waved his hand.
“Chi! Chi! Chi!!!”
‘Tang Xun and Mu Zikun, who were both hanging in the air, were immediately dragged into the darkness by the vines.
Deng Xin’s face turned pale.
“What do you want?”
“To prevent collusion, of course. It’s always done like this in the movies.”
Fang Heng shrugged and said in a matter-of-factly tone.
“alright, answer the question honestly. Don’t try to hide anything.”
“Why are you here? Tell me more details. Start from the beginning.”
Deng Xin nodded and started from the beginning.
“We’re a player team. We received a request from the black market. The client hopes that we can help him retrieve something from the hardware store.”

“We accepted the mission four days ago. The day before yesterday, when we were cleaning up the hardware store, we discovered that there were Tier 2 ghost claw zombies in the store. At that time, our team was unable to deal with them.”
“So, our employer prepared explosives and guns for us today. We were going to kill the ghost claw zombies.”
“We didn’t expect that the ghost-claw zombies had been cleared up after coming here. After that, I saw you and those...”
Deng Xin raised her head and looked up at Fang Heng with lingering fear.
Fang Heng used his chin to indicate the secret passage behind her.
“And then? What about that secret passage?”
“Tm not sure about the details. The client only told me the location of the secret passage and that there is a safe under the secret passage.”
Deng Xin thought for a moment, then immediately added.
“The password to open the safe is ‘eavan’. We only need to take out the thing in the safe and give it to the client to complete the mission.”
“What is it?”
“The employer said it’s a G-virus.”
“Who is the employer?”

“I don’t know his specific identity. His ID on the internet is Old Black. He looks about 70 to 80 years old and is 1.6 meters tall. There’s nothing special about him. He’s outside right now and didn’t follow us in.”
“Very good.”
Fang Heng snapped his fingers as he spoke..

chapters.title: Chapter 136 - The Defective G-virus Body
paragraphs: Several vines quickly spread down and once again wrapped around Deng Xin, lifting her into the air.
“Remember, don’t make any noise. If Old Black comes in to investigate, don’t let him find you. Otherwise, you’ll be killed by the vines immediately.”
While speaking, Fang Heng controlled the vine zombie to drag Deng Xin into the darkness. Then, he changed to another person to interrogate.
He took all the equipment from the three of them and checked the information carefully to make sure that their answers were the same.
After doing all this, Fang Heng turned on the flashlight and controlled the two vine zombies to explore the passage behind the cabinet.
Qiu Yaokang’s analysis was right.
The hardware store indeed had the G-virus!
This was a big win!
Fang Heng rubbed his fists.
The G-virus could greatly increase the efficiency of the shelter’s research at this stage!
It was more valuable than the T-virus!
Behind the hidden passage was a staircase that went straight down.
Following the stairs, Fang Heng entered the basement hall.
The interior of the basement was very clean. There were a few sofas, wooden tables and wooden chairs.
The safe was placed in a very conspicuous corner.
In addition, there was a side door next to the basement.
To be safe, Fang Heng carefully controlled the vine zombie to open the side door and check it.
It was a storage room.
There was still a lot of canned food and bottled water left in it.
If ordinary players discovered this, it would be considered a small fortune.
However, Fang Heng was not interested.
He even complained that they were too heavy.
Returning to the safe, Fang Heng immediately entered the password.
{eavan]
Click!
The safe door opened.
A medicine box lay quietly in the safe.
There were a total of 18 bottles, but now there were only two left.
(Hint: You have acquired the defective G-virus*2.]
[Hint: You have completed the mission-Qiu Yaokang’s confusion.]
[Hint: Please look for Qiu Yaokang to receive the mission reward.]
Found it!
But why was it a defective G-virus?
After all this time, it turned out to be a defective product?
Fang Heng was puzzled. He tried to search the basement hall.
He tried to look through the cabinet.
‘There was a postcard from Pine City and an employee ID card.
(Postcard]
“Lucas, a lot of people were wondering why you suddenly chose to resign.”
“Everyone says you don’t like life at the company.”
“Inoticed something after you left.”
“Some of the G-virus that was supposed to be discarded in the experiment didn’t match.”
“I checked the records. You were on duty that day.”
“Uh... I didn’t mean to doubt you.”
“know your daughter is seriously ill.”
“But the G-virus was eliminated.”
“Okay.”
“I just want to tell you that I have concealed this matter.”
“In any case, as your friend, I can only wish you good luck.”
(Hint: You have obtained an item-postcard.]
[Hint: You have obtained an item-employee work permit (Lucas).]
It turned out that the hardware store owner used to be a staff member of the Meteorite Company.
He had stolen the G-virus, which was supposed to be destroyed, from the company to save his daughter’s life.
It matched.
Fang Heng thought about it and roughly sorted out his thoughts. He muttered to himself.
“What a coincidence, it’s from Pine City again...”
‘Was Pine City’s Meteorite Company related to the development of the G-virus?
While he was thinking, Fang Heng put his employee ID card and postcard back into his backpack.
He returned upstairs.
Fang Heng placed Deng Xin, who was suspended in mid-air, down alone.
“Did you find the G-virus?”
Fang Heng didn’t answer. He just said, “Do one last thing for me.”
“Go ahead.”
“Go outside and lure your employer in. After you do this, I’ll let you and your companions leave. I’m a man of my word.”
Tang Xun and Mu Zikun, who were hanging high in the air, heard Fang Heng’s words and immediately looked pleading.

“Lhope you’ll keep your promise.”
