“Bang! Bang!”
Tang Xun and the other two, who were tied up in the air, fell to the ground.
“Now you can scram.”
Deng Xin and the other two quickly left the room as if they had been pardoned.
Old Black frowned.
His eyes flickered as he watched Deng Xin and the other two leave.
He realized that he had been deceived and that the attacker had come for him.
Old Black finally opened his mouth when only he and Fang Heng were left in the hardware store.
He asked in a hoarse voice, “Who are you?”
Fang Heng took off the toy mask that he wore on his face.
“Long time no see. Is it Old Black? Or Old Grey?”
Old Black looked at Fang Heng and was surprised at first, then he laughed.
“So it’s you, Fang Heng. When I received your mission video, I thought you were pretty good.”
“To be honest, I didn’t expect anyone to survive in that kind of environment.”
Old Black did not show any guilt or remorse. He even used the tone of an old friend to tease him.
“But Fang Heng, there are many ways to meet me. Isn’t it inappropriate to use such a method to deceive an old man?”
“How did you know that there was the G-virus in the hardware store? And about Alex, you also knew that Alex was locked in Hope Town Community Hospital, right?”
“Hehe.”
Old Black gradually relaxed. He looked as if he was not afraid of the shotgun in Fang Heng’s hand at all.
He even smiled at Fang Heng.
“Fang Heng, I’ma professional middleman. You can kill me, but it’ll cost you money to get information out of me.”
Fang Heng also sneered.
“Oh? You’re a professional middleman? Aren’t you a member of the anti-federal organization?”
“Of course not, but those people from the federation shouldn’t be so detailed.”
Old Black explained, “There’s still a big difference between me and them. Most importantly, I only work for myself.”
“But speaking of which, there doesn’t seem to be any deep enmity between the two of us, right?”
“Moreover, if I’m not wrong, you’ve already obtained the G-virus. You’ve made a huge profit this time. Why don’t we just let bygones be bygones? What do you think?”
Fang Heng looked coldly at Old Black.
Old Black’s words were at most 30% believable.
Fang Heng did not know how to deal with this kind of thick-skinned people.
“alright, businessman, let bygones be bygones.”
“However, as a morally righteous and good citizen, I can choose to hand over dangerous people like you to the federation. I reckon the federation will give me some rewards...”
Fang Heng looked at Old Black with a faint smile... “How are you going to save your life?”

chapters.title: Chapter 137 - Middleman
paragraphs: “Hmm... young man, you sure learn fast.”
Old Black also chuckled.
“Don’t even think about handing me over to the Federation. I won’t resist, but I have many ways to end my life.”
“How about this, let’s be friends and I can give you a piece of information for free. To be honest, I really lack a friend like you.”
“Recently, I have a lot of work on my hands. I can’t find anyone to complete many of my clients’ missions. It’s very rare to find a player as capable as you.”
As he spoke, Old Black glanced at the vine zombies that were hiding in the room.
In fact, after learning that the FAA jS31Zederation had dealt with the Alex incident, Old Black had also conducted an investigation on Fang Heng.
He was certain that Fang Heng’s strength was not as simple as it seemed.
He was able to survive alone in the dangerous Hope Town and even assisted the Federation in killing Alex.
On Old Black’s customized blacklist, Fang Heng was already an S-level character.
But now.
He was already at SSS-level.
Fang Heng curled his lips and said disdainfully, “Be friends? Complete a mission? Are you referring to helping you do some anti-federal stuff?”
Old Black became a little more serious. “Fang Heng, I’ve checked your information and know that you had a close relationship with the Federation during the Alex Incident.”
“I still want to give you a piece of advice. Don’t be brainwashed by the people from the Federation. They’re not good people. Of course, those anti-federal guys aren’t good people either.”
“Those of us who survived the apocalypse are just middlemen at most, making some money. Don’t listen to anyone and blindly invest.”
“When the time comes, we’ll even lose our lives.”
Fang Heng frowned.
“What do you mean?”
“If you want to know, why don’t you ask the Federation? What’s the apocalypse purge plan that they’re hiding from the public? I believe you’ll definitely be shocked.”
Fang Heng was not easily fooled.
“Why don’t you tell me? If I go and ask the Federation, would they treat me as a member of an anti-federal organization?”
“Hehe, how would you know if you don’t try? I won’t tell you. The value of this information is too high.”
Old Black spread his hands, indicating that he was willing to cooperate.
“Tell me, what do you want to ask? I’ll give you a piece of information for free. Treat it as building a good relationship between us. We’ll have plenty of opportunities to cooperate in the future.”
Fang Heng quickly thought about it.
He felt that there was some truth in Old Black’s words. The Federation might really have some special plans in the King of Gods’ game.
At least for now, killing Old Black was meaningless.
Old Black could be reborn.
Fang Heng felt that he had indeed been very close to the Federation recently, but their relationship had not reached the point where they were close to each other.
Right now, the most important thing to do was to strive for greater benefits.
Then, the thing he lacked the most right now...
Amodified T-virus!
Fang Heng’’s eyes lit up.
After obtaining the modified T-virus, his shelter’s laboratory could begin researching the Licker transformation project.
“Lwant...”
‘As the words came to his mouth, for some reason, the letter he had found in the rental house suddenly appeared in Fang Heng’s mind.
Fang Heng immediately changed his words. “I want to know the relevant information about Ouroboros.”
Old Black’s expression, which had always been calm, changed.
He was clearly shocked. His pupils suddenly constricted, and his expression was extremely serious.
“How do you know?”
Fang Heng’’s heart also jumped violently.
Ouroboros was real!
In fact, he had a little doubt before.
He wondered if this body might have been hallucinating because of a breakup.
Seeing Old Black’s reaction, his previous doubts were completely cleared.
The records left behind by this body were all real!
Fang Heng stared at Old Black.
“The apocalypse is coming, the game is projecting reality, is all of this real?”
After a short shock, Old Black chuckled.
“Yes, it’s true. So, Fang Heng, just like I said, no one in this world can be relied on but yourself.”
“I think our cooperation is even more necessary, isn’t it?”
Fang Heng stared at Old Black, and he suddenly thought of many things.
Why was the game world the safest place?
‘Was this the reason why the previous owner of the body had always stayed in the game to build a shelter?
What kind of crisis was there in the real world?
What was the Federation’s plan?
“Fang Heng, the employer is already waiting for my reply. We don’t have much time to waste. What do you want to know? Otherwise, I’m leaving.”
“Let me think.”
Fang Heng thought quickly.
At the moment, Old Black would not say anything about high-level intelligence. It was better to be practical and solve the most critical problem at hand.
“Ineed to know the relevant information about the Lickers modified T-virus. Most importantly, where can I get the Lickers modified T-virus?”
“Hehe, you have two questions. The first question is too simple, and I refuse to answer it.”
“As for the Lickers modified T-virus, when you go to Pine City, which is where the Meteorite Company’s branch research centre is, you can find it in Building D which is its exact location.”
“By the way, there are many other good things in the research centre besides the Licker modified T-virus that you’re looking for.”
“You know I’m going to Pine City?”
Fang Heng was surprised by Old Black’s intelligence again.
“Hehe, Fang Heng, please don’t doubt my professional level.”
Old Black reached out and slowly pushed away the shotgun that Fang Heng pointed at him.
“This time, a large team is going to Pine City. It won’t be a big problem for us to get the internal list in advance.”
“In order to celebrate the start of our collaboration, why don’t we add each other as friends in advance?”
“Thave a strange premonition that after we enter Pine City, we’ll have a deeper level of cooperation.”
Fang Heng slowly put away his gun, turned on the survival radio and added Old Black as a friend.
Old Black couldn’t be trusted completely.
It was the same for the Federation.
Adding Old Back as a friend was just to use him.
“Hehe, a smart choice. If I have a suitable mission, I will come to you. I promise that for VIP partners, the commission I provide will definitely not be a scam.”
“That better be it.”
After leaving the hardware store, Fang Heng immediately returned to the prison research centre.
He handed Qiu Yaokang the two defective G-viruses and also told him about the postcard he found in the secret passage.

chapters.title: Chapter 138 - Dismantling the Shelter
paragraphs: “Eh? What is this?”
Fang Heng was curious.
“The laboratory maintenance list. The list is the machinery that I need your help to repair. I will think of the rest on my own.”

“By the way, some of the machinery has been marked with a maintenance percentage. Don’t do anything beyond your capabilities. Once the maintenance reaches the target percentage, you can stop. Thank you.”
After saying that, Qiu Yaokang turned his back and began the preliminary preparations for the G-virus analysis experiment.
“Uh... Are you crazy?”
Fang Heng was stunned for amoment.
“Didn’t you say not to touch your precious experimental equipment yesterday?”
He originally wanted to show off his mechanical maintenance skills in front of Qiu Yaokang, and at the same time, save his face from his failure yesterday.
“Go quickly.”
Qiu Yaokang did not even turn his head.
“Ineed to develop a G-virus resistance drug as soon as possible before you enter Pine City to increase your resistance to infection.”
“If [have enough time, I can analyze and research a more effective drug to increase your basic attributes.”
“Don’t waste everyone’s time.”
“Okay! No problem! Boss!”
Fang Heng was cheered up.
Hearing that he could get potions for free, he immediately shut his mouth.
Fang Heng summoned a few vine zombies from the basement.
He rubbed his chin.
“What should we do next?”
Fang Heng started thinking about how to teach the zombie clones to read the list.
Qiu Yaokang, who was analyzing the list, turned to look at them.
He first looked at Fang Heng’s zombie clones, then looked at Fang Heng from top to bottom, as if he wanted to say something but hesitated.
Fang Heng noticed Qiu Yaokang’s oppressive gaze, so he asked helplessly, “What now?”
“Where’s the protective suit?”
“Eh... You mean the zombies?”
Fang Heng silently glanced at the vine zombies behind him.
Qiu Yaokang looked at the empty laboratory.
“Who else is there beside them?”
“alright, Il try...
[Hint: Your zombie has been attacked by a gun. Your zombie has tried to dodge but failed. You have gained dodging experience point +1.]
{Hint: Your zombie has been continuously burned...]
“Eh? These players are quite strong. They took the initiative to attack?”
Fang Heng muttered softly.
“Where did they get the guns?”
He had planned to give the players of Captain Company some more time to prepare more arrows and ammunition.
Otherwise, the zombies would be able to flatten them in one round, which would not be enough to gain experience points.
He didn’t expect these people to take the initiative to attack?
Then, he would fight!

In the laboratory, Fang Heng held the maintenance list provided by Qiu Yaokang in one hand and controlled the zombie clones in protective suits to repair the experimental equipment while remotely controlling the zombie clones to attack and gain experience points.
Ina shelter at the foot of a mountain in the forest area.
The group of zombies in front of them gave Black Tiger, the leader of Team 7 of the Blackthorn mercenary group, an unusual headache.
Recently, things had not been going well!
Two days ago, they had encountered the vine zombies blocking the road.
They had even lost two members.
Today, they encountered them again in the mission!
And this time, they took the initiative to attack the player’s shelter!
“Why is it them again?”
Black Tiger already had a bad feeling.
This group of zombies was very easy to recognize.
That’s right, it was the first time that a zombie with a spear as a weapon was encountered in the game!

Before the mercenary group accepted the mission, the mission had indicated that they would encounter the vine zombies. So this time, the team led by Black Tiger was equipped with the Molotov cocktails that were the most effective against the vine zombies.
However, the actual effect was not good.
The Molotov cocktails could indeed set the zombies on fire for some time.
The vine zombies had flames on their bodies, and they held iron spears in their hands. They still looked lively.
They even had an imposing manner, making the players even more afraid to approach them.
“Captain, the effect of fire attacks on them is still limited.”
“Tactic number two, lure them away!”
With such a large group of zombies, Black Tiger had no choice but to adjust his tactics. He was ready to stall the zombies and drag out the battle line.
Fortunately, this group of zombies still didn’t have high intelligence.
He took advantage of their slow movement speed and slowly attacked them.
However, after fighting for a long time, he had used up more than half of the bullets he brought with him. How come they only managed to kill one zombie?
Black Tiger could not help but ask Anter, the head of the shelter.
“How did you provoke them?”
Faced with this soul torture, the players of Captain Company were depressed.
“We didn’t do anything. They attacked us.”
“Is that so? That’s strange.”
Anter’s face turned dark.
“Don’t think about it. What reason could a bunch of crazy zombies have? They were just attracted by the smell of blood and flesh. Think of a way to get rid of them.”
Black Tiger shook his head secretly.
Anter’s reason was not valid.
Black Tiger put aside these meaningless emotions and thought about how to deal with the situation in front of him.
The vine zombies had high HP and fast recovery speed. It would be a waste of resources to kill them.
They simply didn’t have that many bullets.
They could only think of a way to lure them away, find a cliff or something, lure them there and finish them off.
Unfortunately, they didn’t have the time.
Otherwise, creating a large-scale zombie pit in advance and luring the zombies in would be a good idea.
While they were thinking, Black Tiger heard a loud cry from the team ahead.
“Quick! Retreat!”
“Captain! Something’s wrong with the zombies! Quickly, protect the shelter!”
Black Tiger’s expression changed as he looked in the direction of the team.
The zombies were initially attracted by the players’ wooden arrows and were gradually being taken away from the shelter.
However, all of a sudden, they seemed to have come to their senses and no longer paid attention to the mercenary group’s players.
They all turned their heads and staggered toward the shelter.
“Not good! Quick! Retreat and defend!”
Black Tiger ordered the mercenaries to retreat and defend the shelter.
Seeing this, Anter also broke out in cold sweat. He raised his wooden bow and shouted.
“Quick! Everyone come and help!”
Crazy! These zombies were crazy!
The company had invested so much in the construction of the shelter. If the shelter was destroyed...
The players of Captain Company didn’t dare to think too much for a moment. They all picked up their weapons and joined the defense team.
The zombies held their iron spears and staggered toward the shelter.
They had already been attacked by a wave of zombies last night. The durability of the wooden stakes and spike traps outside the shelter was not high.
Inastate of panic, Anter ordered loudly, “Don’t let them get close to the shelter!”
“Quick! Lure them away! Use incendiary arrows!”
“Lure them! Lead them in a circle!”
Last night’s trick was very effective, but this time, Anter realized that something was wrong.
The zombies were different from last night!
They ignored the players’ wooden arrows and forcefully used iron spears to attack the wooden stakes and spike traps.
No matter how the players tried to lure them, it was useless!
“Bang! Bang! Bang!”
The wooden stakes and spike traps exploded one after another.
The players watched helplessly as the zombie horde broke through the wooden stakes outside the shelter and began to attack the shelter.
However, if they went up to attack at close range...
What was the difference between that and suicide?!
(Hint: Your shelter is under attack by the enemy. Please defeat the enemy and repair the shelter in time!]
The game log appeared in the lower right corner of his retina like a death warning.
Anter could only watch helplessly as he fired wooden arrows at the vine zombies in vain..

chapters.title: Chapter 139 - Fishing
paragraphs: [Hint: Your zombie group has destroyed a player’s shelter. Obtained firewood*2727, nail 11, scrap*60, discarded plastic*2.]
Looking at the notifications in the game log, Fang Heng’s eyes revealed a hint of excitement.
Forcibly demolishing a shelter was still quite enjoyable!
At first, Fang Heng was still foolishly controlling the zombies one by one remotely.
This caused a lot of mental stress.
Later, Fang Heng had another inspiration.
He simply gave the unified command.
The vine zombies ignored ranged attacks that dealt less than 50 damage per attack!
With that, the vine zombies withstood most of the players’ wooden arrows and forcefully demolished the shelter.
After the shelter was completely destroyed, the remaining system buildings had no defense.
“Cut the weeds and get rid of the roots. Save us the trouble. Tear down the rest!”
Fang Heng continued to give the order to the zombie group.
[Hint: Your zombie group is tearing down the building...]
[Hint: Your zombie is tearing down the brick wall, dealing 30 damage to the brick wall. You have received shrapnel +1.]
{Hint: Your zombie...]
Seeing that the durability of the shelter had been reduced to zero, the players of Captain Company looked desperate.
It was over, it was all over.
It had taken them so long to build the shelter, but it didn’t even take the zombies half an hour to dismantle it!
Faced with this group of unreasonable zombies, Anter felt a deep sense of powerlessness.
Before he got over his despair, he saw that the iron spears in the hands of the zombies had been changed into iron hammers.
What are they doing?!
“Bang! Bang! Bang!”
‘The heavy hammers hit the hearts of the Captain Company players as if they were hammering on their chests.
The zombies started to hit the walls of the system’s initial building again!
Crazy! They even wanted to demolish the remaining system buildings?!
Were they really going to leave nothing behind?
‘The Captain Company players felt humiliated.
Black Tiger was also stunned.
He had played the game for half of his life, but this was the first time he had seen such a phenomenon.
What was the situation with these zombies? Why didn’t they follow the routine at all?
A mercenary came over and whispered something into Black Tiger’s ear.
Black Tiger was surprised and asked him, “Are you sure? You didn’t get any experience points?”
“Yes, so did fourth brother. He killed a zombie before, but he didn’t get any experience points either.”
“And boss, Ihave a gun mastery skill book. I got extra skill experience points after I killed the zombie.”
Extra skill experience points?
This was a hidden reward that only players could get during a battle!
Combined with all the weird things that he had encountered before, a terrifying thought arose in Black Tiger’s mind.
Could it be...
That someone was controlling these zombies from behind?
At this stage, there was actually a player who could control such a powerful force?
Who could it be?
Almost subconsciously, Black Tiger thought of the prison that had brought him extreme fear the night before last!
Just thinking about it made Black Tiger’s back break out in cold sweat.
‘The shelter had been destroyed, and most of the remaining Captain Company players were still attacking these zombies with bows and arrows.
Even though the effect was very limited.
Black Tiger walked to the disappointed Anter.
“Anter, have you offended anyone recently?”
Anter’s heart skipped a beat.
He turned around, like a cat whose tail had been guessed, and said angrily, “What do you mean?”
“Tmean, do you know there’s a prison nearby?”
Anter’s pupils shrank, from anger to guilt, and even a hint of regret.
Before Anter could reply, Black Tiger had already gotten a definite answer from his expression.
Black Tiger carried out the mercenary group’s routine expressionlessly.
“Tm sorry, the strength of the vine zombie crowd is beyond our expectations. You didn’t state in advance in the mission, so our team can’t complete this mission.”
“Someone will contact your company to refund the money later. According to the agreement, we will evacuate now.”
“Hey, you guys! Are you leaving just like that? Do you know how much damage you’ve caused us by failing the mission?”
Anter pointed angrily at the Blackthorn mercenary group that was quickly retreating and running away. “I’ll complain to your mercenary group! This matter won’t end so easily!”
Mira put her hand on Anter’s shoulder. “It’s no use. Stop talking. Even if we pull them back, it’s too late. Let’s report this to the company, retreat and leave the forest.”
“I don’t need you to tell me what to do!”
Anter clenched his teeth.
(Hint: Zombies are tearing down brick walls...]
(Hint: Zombies are tearing down brick walls...]
(Hint: Zombies are tearing down brick walls...]
Allgone?
No more struggle?
‘The game log did not display any more zombie damage.
For a time, Fang Heng was dull.
“Boring.”
Fang Heng whispered and turned over the character attributes.
After a tough fight, his block and dodge skills have been upgraded to Level 10.
He was still a little short of the expected Level 13.
“Forget it, let’s continue to dismantle it...”
Two days later, early in the morning.
In the newly renovated combat conference room of the prison.
All13 members, including Fang Heng, were gathered here.
Ever since they left Phoenix Sound Gaming Company, Jimmy, Liu Lin and Fang Heng had signed an agreement. They would provide Fang Heng with 100,000 yuan per month as rent to stay in the prison.
Fang Heng would provide full protection and food.
Liao Bufan chose to work in the game for his pay. Fang Heng would pay him 30,000 yuan per month.
The studio recruited six more people besides Liu Yi and the other five newcomers.
They were all college students that Pei Anan thought were really reliable after screening.
At this time, a private survival radio was placed in front of each player.
‘The survival radio was connected to a power amplifier in the center.
The amplifier allowed the survival radio to receive and send communications over a longer distance.
Fang Heng looked around, his gaze sweeping across the excited faces in front of the table.
“Fishing plan phase two, start!”
Liao Bufan raised his hand excitedly. “Boss! I’ll do it! This time, I’ll start first!”
“Okay, let’s begin!”
Liao Bufan typed a line into the survival radio.
‘A few seconds later, all the players saw the message on the survival radio.
[Liao Bufan: Zombie attack! What should we do? My shelter has been attacked! Why are there so many zombies attacking my base? It’s over, it’s all over!]
“How is it?”
After sending the message, Liao Bufan looked at everyone.
Everyone was silent.
“Brother Fan,” Liu Yi carefully rephrased his words, “Isn’t your acting a little exaggerated?”
“Exaggerated? I don’t think s
Liao Bufan touched his cheek awkwardly.
“Then you do it.”
Liu Yi rubbed his hands and quickly sent a message.
[Liu Yi: There’s a group of zombies surrounding the entrance of my base. What should we do? It’s urgent. Please help! Please spread this around.)
“How is it?”
Everyone fell into silence again.
“Ahem, let’s give it a try.”
Fang Heng coughed lightly. No matter if it was awkward or not, he stood up straight.
“If you don’t run now, don’t blame me..”

chapters.title: Chapter 140 - Expansion? Full House!
paragraphs: {Yan Lei: You guys are under attack too? D*mn it, what’s going on? My base was attacked by a wave of zombies this morning! ]
[Liu Yi: God! The one upstairs, me too! Why did these zombies suddenly appear?)

Uiang Fei: I can’t live anymore. The zombies I encounter every day are enough to annoy me. What’s there to live for? I’ve already moved. Everyone, hurry up and move. While we’re moving, we can still go to the prison to get some materials. ]
[Li Chao: The blood moon hasn’t arrived yet, and this is happening? How can I live? It’s not easy to survive in the forest.]
[Sun Rongyue: Recently, a large number of zombies have appeared in the forest. Have you noticed that? There are more and more zombies in the vicinity.)
An unfamiliar ID appeared in the group chat.
{Sun Feihu: Were they vine zombies? Were you all attacked too?]
Everyone in the conference room was overjoyed. They looked at each other.
They had taken the bait!
Liu Yi quickly compared the list and said, “Found it! It’s one of the nail households in the North District!”
[Liao Bufan: I can’t take it anymore. I’ll move tomorrow. D*mn it, it’s hard to stay in the forest! My friends are all enjoying themselves outside. It’s meaningless for me to suffer here.]
Fang Heng looked at the players’ acting skills and nodded to himself.
In these two days, Fang Heng had conducted a preliminary search of the entire forest area.
The forest area was too big!

Fang Heng directly bought motorcycles and bicycles from Vettel. He had the work studio members enter the forest area and spend survival points to conduct a range search to see if there was a player shelter.
Once they encountered a player shelter, they would immediately register and try to contact them to ask if they were willing to move.
It was beyond Fang Heng’s expectations.
There were more than 80 player shelters in the entire forest area!
In the end, there were still more than 20 nail households that were unwilling to move!
The good news was that these were all small and medium-sized buildings, and there were no large-scale player unions among them.
Most of the buildings were far from the prison, so it would be too troublesome for the zombies to demolish them one by one.
It would be best if they could spend some effort to persuade them to leave.
Fang Heng was going to spread the news that there were Tier 2 mutated zombies in the forest.
This would prevent players from running into the forest.
[Han Song: What are you afraid of? Just kill the zombies. I spent so much time building a shelter. Run away just because of one or two zombies?]
[Yan Lei: Brother, don’t say that. You can live a good life. Who wants to fight to the death? It’s better to move as soon as possible. These zombies are different.]
[Han Song: Bullsh*t. Ask them to find me if they have the ability! I’ll stay here. Do you want me to tell them the coordinates?)
[Su Qianxiao: Boss, you’re awesome! I think it’s strange too. Why are there so many unfamiliar IDs all of a sudden? I think they’re all fake, right? Where did the zombie attack come from?]
“Boss, it’s him. That kid was the one who clamoured yesterday!”
It was happening again! He didn’t expect that there were people who were not afraid of death.
Fang Heng sighed in his heart.
“This is what you asked for...”
Fang Heng murmured.
To make these people take the initiative to leave, it was not enough to just ‘lie’ to them, but also to intimidate them with zombies.
Yesterday, he met a few players who were talking nonsense. Fang Heng had already sent three batches of zombies to the nearest nail households to wait for orders.
He ordered the zombies to attack the shelter from afar.
(Hint: Your zombie group has begun to attack the player’s shelter.]
(Hint: Your zombies have caused damage to the shelter...]
‘The game log started to flood again.
Ten minutes later.
Three notifications appeared on the survival radio.
(Hint: A player in your area has died.]
(Hint: A player in your area has died.]
(Hint: A player in your area has died.]
Three people had died.
[Yan Lei: Han Song, it can’t be you, right? If you’re still alive, just say the word.]
The survival radio was silent.
[Yan Lei: Whether you move or not, I’m moving tomorrow. I can’t stay in this d*mn place for another day.]
[Su Qianxiao: Guys, I made a mistake. My shelter was almost torn down.]
[Zhang Yu: This place can’t hold any more people. All my hard work these past few days has been for nothing.)
Fang Heng patted Yan Lei on the shoulder.
“Well done. Keep up the good work! I’m going to do some missions in the next two days. I’ll be relying on you guys to persuade the other players to leave. Keep up the publicity.”
“No problem! Boss!”
Yan Lei and the new players nodded one after another and continued to work hard.
After this period of contact, although they did not say it explicitly, the new players had guessed that Fang Heng might have the ability to control the zombie crowd.
Before the players entered the work studio to sign the contract, they had already signed a confidentiality agreement, so they would not tell anyone about Fang Heng’s talent.

chapters.title: Chapter 141 - Attraction
paragraphs: Rows of game notifications refreshed, and Fang Heng noticed that some of the materials in the shelter had disappeared.
The underground shelter expanded again.
After the renovation, Fang Heng had gained twice as much extra space as before!
“It’s enough for now!”
Fang Heng checked the two new functions of the shelter after the upgrade.
One was the recruitment of NPCs.
Now, the shelter could attract survivors up to C-level.
It was not bad. After all, survivors below C-level had almost no special skills.
Only C rank survivors had the potential to become lab workers.
The other was the increase in the shelter’s defense value.
Unlike ordinary buildings, after players built a shelter, it would be considered an entire building. Any attack on it would reduce its overall durability.
When its overall durability was reduced to a certain extent, the shelter would be deemed destroyed. Only intruders could destroy the walls of the shelter.
In addition, by consuming additional materials, the player could replace the wooden walls of the shelter with stone walls, which would increase the basic defense and durability of the shelter.
There was no shortage of basic materials like stones. Fang Heng planned to let the zombies use stones to level up the shelter after this mission.

[Hint: As the first player in the server to reach Level 25, your reputation among the survivors has been slightly spread. You have received an additional reward: C-level NPC survivor*5, please receive the operation in the survival radio.]
[Hint: As your shelter has reached Level 25, as the owner of the shelter, you have received an exclusive skill-super large backpack.]
Skill-Super-large backpack.
Skill description: You have obtained an additional 20 kg of backpack capacity for your current character’s level.
“Eh? There’s such a good thing?”
The super large backpack skill was the icing on the cake, and the C-level NPCs were relatively more powerful.
Fang Heng turned on the survival radio to observe.
[Hint: You can choose the type of C-level NPC survivor.]
Fang Heng took a look.
There were many types of NPCs, such as machinery maintenance, cooking, combat, gathering, research, farming, tailoring, machinery research, construction and so on.
At this stage, Fang Heng did not lack survival-type materials. Farming NPCs could be considered later.
He directly chose research!
[Hint: You have chosen a survivor with research attributes. The survivors will gather outside your shelter within 30 minutes.]
After upgrading the shelter, Fang Heng rubbed his chin and continued to think.
Now, the expansion of the shelter was on the right track.
First of all, the demolition plan was still going smoothly.
With the prison as the center, all the buildings within a three-kilometer radius had been cleared.
The next step was to clear out all the players in the forest area, set up a restricted area and then expand again.
After that was research.
Most of the basic equipment in the lab had been repaired. The rest were limited by skill levels or missing high-level materials and could not be repaired.
In short, after getting a secret lab for free, the shelter’s research and development speed had greatly increased!
After all, two S-level researchers contributed to a huge boost in research!
Finally, there was the material aspect.
The development was the most gratifying!
All the zombies were already equipped with iron weapons and iron tools, and the iron nuggets forged had already accumulated to several thousand.
It was officially announced that they have entered the Iron Age!
Fang Heng began to think about the next step of his plan.
Reinforcement!
Expansion!

Strengthening the shelter, upgrading all the stone walls and transforming the outer buildings of the prison into barbed wire, so that they could be ready for the arrival of the first blood moon zombie wave.
At the same time, he would continue to expand and harvest resources, until they occupied this forest area!
To increase speed, he needed more and stronger zombie clones!
Research was a must!
In addition, the current level increase of his character had become urgent.
Fang Heng opened the page and looked at the player’s attributes.
The player’s level had risen to Level 13.
To continue to level up, he needed more Tier 1 evolution crystals.
Tier 1 evolution crystals were extremely difficult to produce.
Only by killing a Tier 2 zombie would there be a chance for them to drop evolution crystals.
There were almost no missions related to Tier 2 zombies on the apocalypse merchant Vettel’s side.
There were also very few related missions within the Dark Knights.
To upgrade from Level 13 to Level 14, nearly 60 to 70 Tier 1 evolution crystals were required. One or two ordinary missions were simply not enough to fill this gap.
He had to consider other aspects.
For example...
Pine City.
There should be high-level mutated zombies in that dangerous area!
He would be going to Pine City the next day. If there was an opportunity, Fang Heng did not mind thinking of ways to dig a large-scale corpse pit there to farm survival points and evolution crystals.
Just as he was thinking, an NPC knocked on the door.
“Boss, Mr David from the Dark Knights is here. I’ve brought him to the reception room.”
“Okay, I’ll be there right away!”
In the reception room, David paced back and forth, looking restless.
“Welcome to my shelter, David. How is it here?”
“Very good.”
Seeing Fang Heng, David smiled. “Fang Heng, long time no see. How are you?”
“Tm fine. Come, sit down and talk.”
“No, something happened. I have to rush to another gathering point later.”
David brought Fang Heng to the table and said seriously, “I’m here to explain to you about the operation in Pine City tomorrow.”
“This time, we have a total of twelve teams going to Pine City together. Each team has six people.”
“A total of 72 people? That many?”
Fang Heng was shocked.
“Not only that, including the command team, we have a total of nearly 80 people.”
“Based on our current investigation, Meteorite Company has built a super large company park in Pine City. At that time, our 12 teams will spread out in the company park and gradually search.”
While speaking, David took out a map and spread it out on the round table in the reception room.

“The specific search task will be assigned by the team leader after the field inspection. This is gathering point No. 8 which is closest to you. The helicopter will depart at 11 o’clock tomorrow. It is expected to arrive in Pine City at 3 o’clock in the afternoon.”
“If it goes well, we will stay in Pine City for one night. The helicopter will arrive at noon the next day to pick us up and evacuate from Pine City.”
Fang Heng looked at the location of the gathering point on the map.
It was a little far, about two hours by car.
With this calculation, they would have to set off early the next morning.
“also, when I came here, I received very bad news.”

David said in a deep voice, “Our original plan was to prepare fifteen teams to enter Pine City together, but this morning, eight of the surviving points were attacked from unknown sources. Three of them were completely destroyed.”
Destroyed? Someone was interfering with this mission?
Fang Heng’s eyelids twitched.
The first thing he thought of was Old Black.
“Tm not sure, but one thing is certain. Our operation this time is very likely to have been leaked. Someone doesn’t want us to enter Pine City to investigate.”
“Later, I’ll rush to the scene to conduct a detailed on-site investigation. I hope we can find something.”
“Be careful.” David patted Fang Heng’s shoulder. “This is the first large-scale operation since the founding of our Dark Knights. We can’t afford to make any mistakes.”

chapters.title: Chapter 142 - I Did It!
paragraphs: After bidding farewell to David, Fang Heng’s mind was still a little muddled.
He turned on the survival radio and sent a message to Old Black.
Fang Heng wanted to test Old Black to see if the attack at the gathering point of the Dark Knights had anything to do with him.
Seeing that Old Black did not reply, for the time being, Fang Heng put away the radio and ran outside the shelter to welcome the new NPCs.
The five survivors were sallow and emaciated. It was obvious that they had suffered a lot outside.
Fang Heng led them to the restaurant to get some food, changed into protective clothing, and returned to the underground laboratory of the shelter.
Qiu Yaokang was discussing something with Li Bo.
‘When they saw Fang Heng’s arrival, they all stopped discussing.
“Who are these people?”
Fang Heng noticed that Qiu Yaokang’s eyes were bloodshot, and he looked like he had not slept for a long time.
“This guy is pretty good.” Fang Heng thought.
“Aren’t you short of manpower? I found you some odd-job labourers.”
Qiu Yaokang looked at the people behind Fang Heng.
He didn’t think that these people were very smart. In the past, he wouldn’t have cared about them at all.
However, it was the zombie apocalypse outside. It was already good enough to have a living person to use.
He had to make do.
Qiu Yaokang nodded at Li Bo.
Li Bo understood and said to the NPCs, “Come, follow me to register. I’ll teach you some basic laboratory rules first.
After Li Bo and the others left, Qiu Yaokang took out a small medicine box from the freezer beside the test bench.
“Lwas just about to look for you. This is our latest research and development. Take a look.”
Amazing!
One box at one shot!
As expected of an S-level character!
Fang Heng was delighted. He opened the medicine box to take a look.
{Hint: Your shelter’s basic research G-virus research has been upgraded to Level 5.]
[Hint: You have obtained a potion-powerful anti-infection potion*10, basic T-virus infection vaccine*10, G-virus anti-infection potion*1.]
Fang Heng took out three different potions from the box and looked at them. He felt like he had made a fortune.
D*mn it, he had even developed a basic T-virus vaccine!
It was so cool to have his own research laboratory!
(Modified G-virus anti-infection potion]
‘Type: Potion.

Description 1: Made by modifying the defective G-virus body. After consumption, it can permanently increase the resistance of the player to infection by a small amount, permanently increasing 3 physique attributes (the enhancement effect can only be increased once).
Description 2: Made by Qiu Yaokang. Production requires a G-virus body*1.
[Powerful anti-infection potion}
‘Type: Potion.
Description: After use, the anti-infection ability of the player will be greatly increased within 12 hours (the effect will gradually decrease as the number of uses increases).
[Basic T-virus infection vaccine]
‘Type: Potion.

Description 1: A low-efficiency vaccine developed by the G-virus is only effective within 5 hours of being infected with the T-virus, and only effective against infections below the intermediate level.
Description 2: There is a 20% chance that it will be ineffective after use.
“Gulp, gulp, gulp...”
Fang Heng swallowed a bottle of the purple modified potion.
[Hint: You have used the modified G-virus anti-infection medicine, your resistance to infection has increased slightly, your basic physique +3.]
He earned another 3 physique points for free.
“And this.”
Qiu Yaokang bent down as he spoke, searching for something under the experimental table.
“What?”
“Based on the imitation developed by Meteorite Company’s live sample collector, I’ve been working on it overnight for the past two days.”
Qiu Yaokang had a serious look on his face. He lifted the heavy boxes from his feet to the experiment table.
“I don’t know why either. You seem to be able to meet some super strong mutated zombies. You’ll probably meet them on your trip to Pine City.”
“In short, if you meet them, you can collect more live samples. Don’t waste them.”
[Hint: You have obtained a box of live sample collector (48 pieces)*3.]
“Um... Thank you...”
So that’s why he stayed up all night for the past two days?
Fang Heng silently chose to accept the kindness.
The live sample collector was really a good thing.
It was also known as the ‘greedy collector’...
Fang Heng had inquired about it several times before. This kind of live sample collector was not sold in the apocalypse merchant camp or at the Dark Knights.
Only an $+ level NPC like Qiu Yaokang could replicate it.
The mission in Pine City was so big that it would be unreasonable if there were no Tier 4 mutated zombies.
If there was a chance, he had to collect more samples.
After all the preparations were done, Fang Heng calculated the time for the zombies to revive and the estimated time for them to arrive in Pine City tomorrow.
‘The number of zombies was enough, Fang Heng decided to let them stab each other to death every 20 minutes.
This way, the risk could be controlled, and it wouldn’t cause the zombies to revive in a dangerous place.
After arranging the suicide line, Fang Heng went offline early to rest and prepare for the battle tomorrow.
Return to reality.
Fang Heng had moved out of the rented room two days ago.
He was used to the comfortable life in Phoenix Sound Gaming Company, so he wasn’t happy to stay in the small rented room.
Fang Heng booked a room in a hotel not far from the company and stayed there for a long time.
Just as he was about to wash up, his phone rang.
He took his phone and looked at it.
There were hundreds of missed calls.
Chen Yu had been calling him since noon, every few minutes.
“Hello?”
“Hello, Mr Fang Heng. Please wait a moment. Captain Chen will come to answer the call right away.”
After waiting for more than half a minute, Chen Yu rushed over.
“Fang Heng, I’ve finally contacted you. I’ve already sent people to the prison to look for you.”
Chen Yu heaved a huge sigh of relief.
He had finally found him.
“So urgent? What’s the matter?”
“It’s about Pine City.”
“Actually, this mission was personally assigned by the higher-ups. They asked me to contact you.”
“We learned that you’ve joined the mission in Pine City because our people from the Federation will also participate in this mission.”
Chen Yu hesitated for a moment before continuing.

“Fang Heng, I’m very sorry. I’m not at liberty to reveal the specifics, but this mission is extremely important. During the process, we might need your assistance. We’ll try our best to satisfy you in terms of the remuneration.”
Hmm... the people from the Federation aren’t that good...
Fang Heng pondered in his heart.
How long has it been?
Why is the Federation’s intelligence lagging behind Old Black’s by so much?
“No problem.”
On the surface, Fang Heng still readily agreed, while at the same time asking Chen Yu for information.
“Do you know anything about Pine City and the mission?”
“Uh... this...”
“Alright, I understand. I won’t ask anymore.”
Chen Yu explained, “Fang Heng, due to the rules and regulations, it’s not convenient for me to reveal too much.”

“Ican only tell you that this mission is closely related to the main storyline. The Federation places great importance on this mission. The reward for this mission will definitely be generous, but the difficulty of completing it will also be very high.”
“The danger level of Pine City is $level, and all of them are high-tier zombies. To be honest, we don’t know why this mission was triggered so quickly.”
“Sigh!”
While speaking, Chen Yu sighed again.
“Theoretically, the mission should be triggered in half a year, or even longer.”
Hearing Chen Yu’s sigh, Fang Heng thought to himself, “I’m really sorry.”
“I did this!”
“It was me who accidentally triggered the mission by giving the live sample of Erita to the Dark Knights..”

Fang Heng wanted to test Old Black to see if the attack at the gathering point of the Dark Knights had anything to do with him.

The five survivors were sallow and emaciated.

Fang Heng led them to the restaurant to get some food, changed into protective clothing, and returned to the underground laboratory of the shelter.

‘When they saw Fang Heng’s arrival, they all stopped discussing.
“Who are these people?”

I found you some odd-job labourers.”

chapters.title: Chapter 143 - I Did It too!
paragraphs: Chen Yu did not know that this matter was related to Fang Heng. His mood was extremely heavy.

“In short, we were one step behind the anti-federal organization again. This time, the main storyline mission came too suddenly. We were caught off guard and did not prepare well for the initial stage.”
Chen Yu even felt a lingering fear.
“Two players who belong to the Federation just joined the Dark Knights and received this mission. If we were a step later, I’m afraid we wouldn’t even be able to make it in time for this mission.”
Fang Heng asked, “What about the information about the mission? The other servers should have a corresponding strategy, right?”
“No.”
“No?”

“Yes. In the King of Gods’ game, players cannot disclose information about the main storyline mission to the public. Otherwise, they will be punished. In serious cases, they might even be sentenced to death. Oh right, the Federation has not announced this to the public. Don’t tell anyone.”
Fang Heng nodded. “Alright.”
Chen Yu continued to explain.
“So, we can only infer the mission process from some other details.”
“Moreover, we also discovered that the main storyline mission process of each server is different. At least Server 1, 2, 6 and 7 do not have Pine City’s existence.”
“Alright, then is there any information that can be shared?”

“After learning about the mission in Pine City, we immediately launched a related search. We did find a map of the interior of Pine City and the interior map of Meteorite Company Park. I’ll transfer it to you later.”
“Thank you.”
Fang Heng did not want to take Chen Yu’s things for free, so he reminded him.

“According to the information I received, there might be a T-virus leakage in Pine City. If you stay in that place for too long, the infection level will greatly increase, so you need to have some protection.”
“Okay! Your information is very important to us. I’ll report it to my superior right now.”
Chen Yu was very serious.
“Go.”
“Oh right, there’s something else I want to ask you.”
“Go ahead.”

“Recently, we’ve received reports from enthusiastic players that the zombies in the forest area of District 8 have mutated. The zombies have started to possess normal weapons and even attacked the players’ base. In serious cases, they even destroyed their homes.”
“Alright!”
“You guessed it
“This is my doing again!”
A few thoughts went through Fang Heng’s head. He remained silent.
He thought, “Could it be that you’re calling to ‘interrogate me’?”
Chen Yu sighed. He had a terrible headache.
His team was in charge of managing these issues that the territory had encountered recently.
“After some investigation, we think that there might be a new mutation of the zombies, but...”
“But what?”

“But we’ve received a report from the players of Captain Company. They think that the zombie crowd was secretly controlled by people in the prison. They suspect that the prison is related to the anti-federal organization, and they want us to investigate.”
Fang Heng fell into silence.
Those people could actually figure that out.
He had underestimated them!
“Eh, Fang Heng, that’s not what I meant. We still have a lot of confidence in you.”
Seeing that Fang Heng did not reply, Chen Yu, who was on the other end of the phone, scratched his head.
“How could it be you? I heard that the mutated zombies are all Tier 2 vine zombies. How could players have such strong combat abilities? This doesn’t make sense.”

“However, Fang Heng, you have to be careful. Many players have also confirmed that a large number of mutated zombies have appeared in the forest. Although your prison is on the outskirts of the forest, it’s also in a dangerous area.”
“Yes, thank you. However, how is the Federation going to deal with this matter?”
“Sigh, how else can we deal with it? Right now, we can’t even deal with the sudden appearance of the main storyline mission.”
“Moreover, the first blood moon is about to arrive, and the higher-ups can’t send any reinforcements. It is already the limit for us to send another team into the forest to investigate.”
Chen Yu poured out his grievances to Fang Heng.

“For the time being, the Federation will consider issuing mission guidelines in the forum and classify the forest area as a high-risk area. It is recommended that the players in the forest area move out as soon as possible.”
“After all, the current situation is not suitable for ordinary players to survive there.”
Fang Heng heaved a sigh of relief when he heard this.
“Phew, it’s been hard on you, Brother.”
“Hey, serving the people.”
“Alright, I’ll go report the situation to my leader first. I’ll contact you again next time.”
Heh! It was a lucky hit!
Fang Heng was secretly delighted.
In any case, he had to bring his zombie clones to Pine City for a mission in the next two days. If the Federation went to investigate, they would not be able to find anything!
Moreover, with the official propaganda of the crisis, the number of players remaining in the forest was probably decreasing.
After hanging up the phone, Fang Heng stretched his body.
He had an early rest today to ensure that he was full of energy. Tomorrow, he would go to Pine City to have a big battle and reap more benefits.
After washing up.
Fang Heng had just laid down on his bed to get ready for bed when his phone rang again.
The two words ‘Old Black’ appeared on the phone.
Old Black?
Fang Heng thought it was strange.
He did not seem to have added Old Black’s phone number.
Fang Heng picked up the call.
“Hehe, Fang Heng, are you finally offline? I’ve been waiting for you for a long time.”
“How did you know my cell phone number?”
“Fang Heng, this question of yours is very amateurish. As a middleman, this is a basic skill.”
“Alright, keep bragging!”
Fang Heng pursed his lips.
“Don’t be nervous. This call is very special. The Federation cannot trace it, and there will not be any call records.”
“In short, there’s an urgent matter. I hope that you can enter teleportation point No. 9 tomorrow and join Team 9 to enter Pine City. Trust me, this will be good for you.”
“You can go to the nearest Dark Knight’s camp to consult. You can use a few Dark Knight’s honor points to teleport.”
“Alright, I wish you good luck. I look forward to our cooperation.”
Before Fang Heng could reply, Old Black had already hung up.
What the hell?
Fang Heng wanted to call back, but he found that the phone call could not be found. It was as if it did not exist.
What was the situation with Team 9?
Could it be a trap?
Fang Heng noticed that Old Black looked like he had a pearl in his hand. It seemed like he had more information about the mission.
“Whatever, I’ll go ask him tomorrow.”
Fang Heng believed that he wouldn’t be able to beat Old Black if he tried to compete with his intelligence.
He decided not to think too much and went to sleep.
The next day, he got up and log in.
Fang Heng controlled all the remaining zombie clones to stab each other to death.
Before he left, he went to the apocalypse merchant camp to buy some supplies.
Gasoline, small explosives...
These were all necessities.
Fang Heng didn’t drive the truck but chose to use the motorcycle.
Considering that if the Dark Knights were attacked again when they entered Pine City to complete the mission, it would be a huge loss if the truck and the bar were destroyed.
Fang Heng decided to follow Old Black’s instructions and drive the motorcycle to Katarina’s bar first.
“Oh? You want to change the starting point to join Team 9?”
After knowing the reason for Fang Heng’s visit, Katarina could not help but be curious.
“Can you tell me the reason?”
“9 is my lucky number.”
“Humph, you’re not honest. I think you have another purpose.”

Katarina snorted lightly and lowered her head to take out her notebook to check, “There is indeed a vacancy in Team 9. You can join, but it’s a long way from here. When we first assigned teams, it was all done from a regional distance.”
“You have a way, Don’t you?”

“You’re right. After spending 20 honor points, you can activate space teleportation for yourself. It will directly teleport you to the Dark Knights’ contact point nearest to Team 8. It will take about half an hour to reach the meeting point from there.”
“Then follow me.”
Katarina pushed open the side door of the bar counter.
‘Walking into the room through the back door, Fang Heng saw a high-tech metal instrument.
‘There was such a high-tech teleportation device in the Zombie Apocalypse world?
He had never seen a related discussion in the forum.
Was it a hidden device again?
“Let’s begin. Stand in the middle..”

chapters.title: Chapter 144 - Logistics Team
paragraphs: Fang Heng opened his eyes again and arrived at another base of the Dark Knights.
The person in charge of the base was an old man named En.
His hair had already turned white.
“Katarina has already told me about you. The meeting point is just north of the base. It’s about a 30-minute walk. I can lend you a bicycle.”
“Thank you, I brought my own.”
Fang Heng opened the map.
This was a desert area.
The most valuable resource in the desert was oil.
‘There were many oil mines here.
In the later stages of the game, the player’s shelter would start to use a lot of electricity.
Oil was one of the main sources.
Fang Heng rode the bicycle and walked through the desert.
By the time Fang Heng arrived at the meeting point, it was already past 10:30.
After explaining the purpose of his visit, Fang Heng was brought into a temporary tent by two soldiers of the Dark Knights.
“You are Fang Heng?”
In the tent, Colonel Barker stood up.

“T’ve heard of your name, Fang Heng. You managed to obtain a live sample of Erita from the Meteorite Company, allowing us to obtain a lot of valuable information. On behalf of the Dark Knights, we thank you for your efforts.”
{Hint: Barker’s favorability towards you has increased slightly.]
“Tam Colonel Barker, the commander-in-chief for this operation in Pine City.”
Fang Heng raised his head and looked at Barker.
So he was the commander-in-chief of the operation!
Barker looked very rough. He had thick eyebrows and big eyes. He was also bald.
But he was very enthusiastic.
“Unfortunately, since my team is full, I can not provide you with any position.”
“If you don’t mind, you can temporarily follow the logistics team. When we arrive in Pine City, I’ll direct the operations of the logistics team.”
There’s a logistics team?
Fang Heng muttered in his heart.
Could this be Old Black’s plan?
Since he was already here...
‘As long as he could enter Pine City, it wouldn’t be a problem for him to act alone.
It wouldn’t be a big problem to join the logistics team.
Fang Heng nodded and said, “Alright, I’ll follow your arrangements.”
Barker walked forward and patted Fang Heng’s shoulder.
“Come, I’ll bring you to the logistics team’s meeting point.”
At another meeting point in the tent.
Everyone looked at Fang Heng.
“Hello, I’m Fang Heng.”
Fang Heng nodded at these people. At the same time, he did not forget to observe and try to determine whether they were players or NPCs.
Then, he saw a tall blonde girl in the crowd.
She had a tall nose and a sturdy figure.
“Let me introduce you. This is Lucia, the leader of the logistics team.”
Barker turned around and looked at Fang Heng. He whispered, “She’s very beautiful, right?”
Lucia seemed to have heard him and revealed a displeased expression.
Fang Heng nodded awkwardly.
“Young man, you have good taste. But I advise you not to have any feelings for her. You’re too weak. You’re not strong enough for her to beat you up.”
Fang Heng coughed lightly.
ahem, I don’t believe...”
“Hahaha, alright, it’s just a joke. The helicopter will take off in an hour and a half.”
Barker’s expression became serious. He pointed at the helicopter that was parked on one side and a few large boxes on the other side.
“Since this helicopter is used to carry materials, there are strict restrictions on the load of the passengers.”
“We need to streamline our backpacks. Each person can carry a maximum of 100 kg of items. You can store items that you don’t need temporarily there.”
Only 100 kg?
This was troublesome.
Fang Heng revealed a distressed expression.
His backpack was filled to the brim.
player’s weight-bearing was related to their vitality and character level.
Normally, players could put small and medium-sized props, items, materials, food and so on into their backpacks.
However, resource-type items, such as wooden planks, would not be able to keep in the backpack once it exceeds more than ten pieces.
Fang Heng’s backpack was much larger than the average player’s. In addition, he had just learned the super-large backpack skill.
Its capacity far exceeded that of a normal player’s.
Before coming here, Fang Heng had packed a bunch of miscellaneous items in his backpack for safety reasons.
He walked to the box and hesitated for a while.
The zombie clone also had a small amount of weight, and it had also inherited Fang Heng’s super-large backpack skill.
However, the problem was that after the zombie clone died and was resurrected, all the items in the backpack, except for the weapons, tools, and clothes, would be emptied.
It was unrealistic to use the zombie clone to transport the materials remotely.
“This is a bit troublesome
Fang Heng muttered and took out a bag of biscuits and a bottle of coffee and milk, slowly eating and drinking.
First of all, he needed a sample collector!
He couldn’t let Qiu Yaokang down after staying up for two nights.
‘There were also weapons and ammunition, small explosive packs, gasoline...
In addition, there was a small number of survival materials, water and food...
The necessary anti-infection potions, medical bandages, blood recovery packs, healing spray...
The backup survival items, such as ropes, flashlights, coffee...
“Alright, start emptying.”
Fang Heng sighed and kept taking things out of his backpack.
Since Fang Heng arrived, the player Mo Jiawei had been observing Fang Heng.
‘When he saw Fang Heng struggling in front of the box for a while, he realized that Fang Heng might be a player.
Fang Heng began to throw things into the box.
Pistols, bullet boxes*21...
Torches, flashlights, high-efficiency batteries, ropes, nylon rope, flower pots...
Luncheon meat, cooking bags, yoghurt, canned food, coffee, high-efficiency nutrient solution, honey...
Fang Heng dug for a full five minutes.
He still didn’t stop?
Was his backpack so big?
Mo Jiawei and the others were dumbfounded.
At first, it was food.
Biscuits, honey, meat...
He dug for a full two minutes.
Then it was all kinds of sundries.
There were rope, firewood, lighter, flashlight, crowbar...
He dug for another three minutes or more.
‘Then it was all kinds of high-level weapons, equipment and recovery items.
Focused flamethrower?!
Healing spray?
Dozens of boxes of handgun bullets?
Most of them were food...
Even a barbecue grill?
What’s going on?
Even a bicycle? Was he not afraid of being overloaded?
Furnace??
D*mn, why would he carry a furnace with him?!
‘Mo Jiawei saw many high-priced items being thrown into the box by Fang Heng.
Without a doubt!
This player was a big shot!
How could an ordinary player have such a large backpack?
How could he have such high-value items?
Fang Heng finally cleared out the backpack with great difficulty,
He turned around and happened to notice Mo Jiawei’s expression.
The other NPCs’ expressions were very calm, but he looked like he had not seen the world.
It seemed that there was only one player in this team, Mo Jiawei.
Fang Heng made a rough judgment.
After finishing organizing, Fang Heng walked to the back of the team and stood at the back.
‘Mo Jiawei greeted Fang Heng in a low voice.
“Hey, friend, you’re a player, right? My name is Mo Jiawei. I live in the snowfield area. Where are you from?”
“Sucheng, Fang Heng.”
“Nice to meet you. God, take me with you.”
“No problem. We’ll work together then..”

chapters.title: Chapter 145 - Take off
paragraphs: “After the helicopter has finished loading the goods, you can set off ahead of time.”
Barker interrupted the conversation between Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei and nodded to the soldier beside him.
At the side, the soldier began to distribute an inhalant and a black communicator the size of a palm to each member.
[Hint: You have obtained an inhalation anti-infection potion*1, communicator*1.]
Unhalation anti-infection potion]
Description: The anti-infection potion developed using the latest formula, can reduce the player’s current infection level by 10-20% after inhalation.
{Communicator]
Description: The special communicator of the Dark Knights can only be used within the range covered by the base station.
“We have detected the spread of the low concentration T-virus in the air of Pine City. Long-term exposure to this environment will result in the risk of infection.”
“This inhalant can effectively reduce infection, but the production capacity is very limited. Each person only has one dose. It should be no problem to last more than 30 hours.”
“The other thing is the communicator. There is a special magnetic field inside Pine City that blocks ordinary communicators.”

“The logistics team is expected to install a base station on the top of Meteorite Company’s building in Area D after entering Pine City. After the base station is completed, the communicator can be used for internal communication.”
“Any other questions?”
“No, Sir!”
Barker nodded and looked at Fang Heng.
“When I’m not around, Fang Heng will be the team leader and lead you all to complete this mission.”
Mo Jiawei turned his head and looked at his teammate beside him in surprise.
He.
Team leader?!
“Do your best, Captain Fang Heng. Lucia will assist you as the vice-captain.”
Captain?!
‘Mo Jiawei looked at Fang Heng in shock.
How did he do it?
He had spent tens of millions of dollars just to become a Level 2 private.
He was a God!
[Hint: Since your honor level is the highest in the team, you have been assigned as the Captain and Lucia as the vice-captain.]
Fang Heng saw a gaze looking at him from the side.
When he turned around, Lucia was also looking at him with an unconvinced look.
(Hint: Lucia’s friendliness towards you has decreased.]
Two hours later, Fang Heng put on his emergency parachute bag and boarded the helicopter with the team.
The helicopter filled with goods slowly took off.
Fang Heng had never been interested in being the team leader.
The position of team leader was meaningless.
Once the plane arrived in Pine City, Barker would immediately take over the entire team.
He had reduced the friendliness of a young lady for nothing. Fang Heng felt that it was a loss.
Including the pilot, there were seven members within the team.
Lucia sat in the co-pilot’s seat. She turned around and looked at the crowd.
“We are now officially heading to Pine City. The entire journey will take about four hours. Everyone can take a break to ensure that your energy is up.”
How could they rest?
Fang Heng felt that the ability of the pilot was worrisome.
He was shaking uncomfortably on the plane.
‘Mo Jiawei had already made up his mind to hug his thigh.
He was a gaming enthusiast. His gaming talent was not bad.
At the same time, he was also the eldest son of his family.
The heir of Mo Qiyuan real estate company.
‘A second-generation rich kid!
Mo Jiawei was already the chosen one right from the start, the heir of the family business. As soon as he entered the game, he drew an S-level talent.
After joining the new server, he was also born in a farm area with abundant resources.
Relying on his early days in the game, he had accumulated a lot of resources.
He was also very lucky to trigger the Dark Knights’ mission.
After that, he spent a lot of money to hire two mercenary groups to help him complete the mission!
He was very lucky.
After experiencing a narrow escape, Mo Jiawei completed the Dark Knights’ mission.
The reward was also very generous.
Mo Jiawei became a member of the Dark Knights.
However, the mission was different this time.
‘Mo Jiawei could not recruit mercenaries to participate.
He had no powerful weapon, so he was a little flustered.
‘Mo Jiawei noticed that Fang Heng was not nervous at all.
“Fang Heng, aren’t you nervous at all?”
“Nervous? Is this your first time flying in a helicopter? Are you afraid of heights?”
“It’s okay, just get used to it.”
Fang Heng took out his sleeping bag from his backpack.
He winked at Mo Jiawei.
“Tll go offline and take a nap first. I’ll come back in about three and a half hours. Kick my sleeping bag if you need to call me.”
Before Mo Jiawei could react, Fang Heng had already gone offline.
He had wanted to discuss the next battle plan with Fang Heng to understand their respective skills and reduce the distance between them.
But...
‘Mo Jiawei looked at the sleeping bag Fang Heng left behind.
Was this the way God did things?
After logging off, Fang Heng lay back on his bed.
He took out the map of Pine City that Chen Yu sent last night and looked at it.
There were two maps in total.
One was a map of Pine City, and the other was a map of the Meteorite Company’s interior.
The Meteorite Company’s interior was divided into five areas: A, B, C, D and E.
There was also the Central Area S.
From the description on the side, it was believed that Area $ had been destroyed due to an accident during the biochemical crisis.
The other areas more or less had some written records, indicating the basic situation of each area.
For example, the living area in Area A, the activity area in Area B, the experimental area in Area C and D, and the office area in Area E.
However, Area $ was only marked with one name.
“Is it possible that the secret is hidden in the destroyed Area $?”
However, according to the intelligence provided by Old Black, the target this time was the experimental area in Area D.
That was the experimental area to study the T-virus.
After entering Pine City, he would think of a way to go there first and get the modified Licker T-virus as soon as possible.
It had been three and a half hours since Fang Heng went online again.
He noticed that Mo Jiawei was still very nervous.
It was strange...
Fang Heng muttered to himself. At first, he thought that Mo Jiawei was a member of the anti-federal organization.
Now, it didn’t seem like it.
He was too nervous.
His performance was at best a decent rookie player.
Then why did Old Black ask him to come to Team 9?
The blonde beauty leader Lucia turned around from the co-pilot’s seat.
“Everyone, we have entered Pine City. According to the scheduled plan, we will dock above Area E’s Science and Technology Building in the Meteorite Company Park. Please get ready.”
Here it comes! Pine City!
The helicopter quickly flew toward the Meteorite Company in Pine City.
Fang Heng looked out of the window.
He saw many Dark Knights’ helicopters belonging to this operation outside the window.
More than ten helicopters entered Pine City together.
“Thi:
Through the helicopter window, he looked at the ruined city below.
Mo Jiawei felt his scalp go numb.
It was too scary.
Was this place really for people?
In his opinion, the place where he had completed his mission to join the Dark Knights was like hell on earth.
But now he realized that there were many levels of hell.
This place was deeper..

chapters.title: Chapter 146 - Crash
paragraphs: The streets of the city were filled with wandering zombies. At first glance, half of them were Tier 1 mutated zombies!
There were also Tier 2 mutated zombies everywhere.
‘There were even a few red shadows darting about in the alley.
Tier 2 Lickers!
‘Mo Jiawei’s face turned pale.
He somewhat regretted participating in this mission.
It was clearly labelled as an SSS-level mission. Why was there such a big difference?
‘Mo Jiawei took a deep breath and adjusted his emotions.
It was too late to retreat now.
He glanced at Fang Heng.
This time, Mo Jiawei was even more confused.
What the hell!
Why did God look so excited?
Fang Heng was indeed very excited. He also looked down from the helicopter.
This was great!
This city was simply a land of fortune!
How could you believe that there were so many Tier 1 mutated zombies?
‘There were also a large number of Tier 2 mutated zombies among them!
Amazing, amazing!
Fang Heng clenched his fists in excitement.
‘Those were all survival points!
They were all evolution crystals!
This was a rare opportunity!
Joining the Dark Knights was indeed the right choice!
‘Mo Jiawei was increasingly unable to fathom this God.
“Fang Heng, this mission is too terrifying.”
“Yes, indeed.”
Fang Heng looked out of the window and replied, “Risk also means opportunity.”
“Fang Heng, my talent ability is to assist in tracking the weakness of the target. It can obtain information about the target as well as their weaknesses.”
“Other than that, it can also be set to track a target for a short period.”
“also, I’m not good at combat.”
Fang Heng glanced at Mo Jiawei.
“Not bad, it’s an S-level talent, right?”
In just a few sentences, Fang Heng immediately determined that Mo Jiawei’’s skills were very valuable!
His support-type ability was extremely strong!
“Yeah.”
‘Mo Jiawei nodded, “Fang Heng, are you a combat-type?”
“Ican be considered half a combat-type. I’m a support-type like you. I’m especially good at collecting resources.”
In the game, some players chose to keep their talent skills confidential, but when it came to combat ability, most players were willing to share relevant information.
After all, it was a PVE game. In most cases, the risk was lower and the benefits were greater.
“Ah... I’m going to suffer...”
Mo Jiawei held his forehead, feeling even more distressed.
He had thought that Fang Heng was a God with combat-type talent.
In such a dangerous environment and with such a difficult mission, it had to be two support-type players...
How was this game supposed to be played!
‘Mo Jiawei couldn’t play anymore.
Fang Heng knew what Mo Jiawei was worried about. He chuckled in his heart, and the corner of his mouth twitched. He pointed to a helicopter outside the window.
Fang Heng recognized this helicopter. It was the Team 9 helicopter that Barker was riding on, Serial No. 009.

“Don’t be afraid. Look, I think our regiment commander is very powerful. He has the rank of Colonel and can fight very well. We just need to follow behind him. When the time comes, it will be as easy as playing catch-up...”
“Boom!
While Fang Heng was speaking, a sound of an explosion resounded throughout the cabin.
Then, the helicopter shook violently!
“What on earth?”
“What happened?”
The members of the Dark Knights were also affected.
Everyone immediately looked out of the window to observe the situation.
Not far in front of Fang Heng’s helicopter.
The No. 009 plane that Fang Heng pointed at had completely lost control!
‘The tail of the plane was on fire as it spun rapidly and fell into the city below.
‘The damage to the tail was not caused by mechanical failure!
“Brother!!!”
Lucia, who was in the co-pilot’s seat, shouted at the crashed plane and watched it fall into the city below.
“This...”
Fang Heng opened his mouth and quickly poked his head out to look below the helicopter.
At the intersection in the centre of the city, there was a human-shaped monster that was over two meters tall.
He was carrying a large rocket launcher on his shoulder.
Tyrant?!”
Fang Heng was shocked.
Tier 4 mutated creature-Tyrant!
‘Mo Jiawei also followed Fang Heng’s gaze and looked down at the street.
His face instantly turned pale.
“It’s not Tyrant.”
Mo Jiawei reached out a hand to cover his left eye.
The detailed information of Tyrant immediately appeared in his right eye.
“Nemesis T-type.”
“The product of implanting ne-a cells into Tyrant T103 (mass-produced type).”
“When ne-a grows into an adult, it will take over Tyrant T103’s brain and destroy its prefrontal lobe to form a second brain.”
“ne-a will transform Tyrant’s body internally and rearrange its neural circuits.”
“The parasite has given Tyrant a stronger body, reaction and regeneration ability that far surpasses the T103. It has also given it the intelligence of an ordinary person.”
“The nemesis can operate rocket launchers, revolving machine guns and other heavy weapons in battle.”
“Apart from the powerful regeneration ability and the parasite’s enhanced tentacle attacks, the nemesis does not have any other special enhancements.”
‘Mo Jiawei put down his hand that was covering his left eye and turned to look at Fang Heng with a bitter expression.
“This is troublesome. It’s a Tier 4 mutated zombie!”
“Wait a minute, what’s the ‘ne-a’ you mentioned just now?”
Fang Heng was confused.
He didn’t have any information related to the ‘‘ne-a’ in his memory.
From Mo Jiawei’s description, it looked like a parasite?
‘Was it a parasite similar to a vine zombie?
It sounded like a very powerful thing.
Could he modify his zombie clone as well?
“I don’t know, it’s information provided by the skill...”
“Boom!!!”
‘Mo Jiawei had just finished speaking when his feet shook violently again!
Not far away from their helicopter, a second helicopter exploded in the air!
The blast from the explosion at close range caused the helicopter to shake!
Mo Jiawei’s face was pale.
He was so nervous that he was trembling.
“Don’t panic.”
Fang Heng was not panicking. He felt that according to the game’s settings, it should not be necessary for the mission to give him the death penalty right from the start.
He remained calm and patted Mo Jiawei’s shoulder to comfort his teammate. He even joked.
“At least we’re lucky. Think about it, if we took those two helicopters, won’t we be screwed?”
‘Mo Jiawei didn’t say anything. He looked down, his eyes full of fear.
He pointed down with a trembling finger.
“Fang Heng, I beg you, don’t try to console me.”
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat. He subconsciously looked down.
‘Tyrant was carrying a rocket launcher on his shoulder, and he aimed it at the helicopter Fang Heng was riding on.
“F*ck!”
Fang Heng wanted to give himself two slaps.
He felt like he had talked too much today.
How could it be so vicious?
“Quick! Rise! Rise!”
Seeing Tyrant’s strange movements, the NPCs in the helicopter shouted one after another, directing the helicopter to dodge upwards, hoping to escape Tyrant’s rocket launcher’s range.
No matter what, it could still affect his accuracy!
“Shoosh!”
A rocket flew out from the rocket launcher on Tyrant’s shoulder.
“Boom!!!”
