chapters.title: Chapter 147 - Base Station
paragraphs: The helicopter’s flank was grazed by the rocket launcher.
The entire cabin shook violently!
The helicopter shook uncontrollably.
The pilot was sweating profusely as he shouted, “Quick! Bail out! Now! 20 seconds at most!”
Bail out just like that?
At this critical moment, several thoughts flashed through Fang Heng’s mind.
His gaze quickly swept across the city below.
“That white building! Listen to my command! Choose to drop off and gather on top of that white building!!”
Fang Heng shouted.
At this moment, he could not care about anyone else. He conveniently pulled his teammate, Mo Jiawei, who was beside him.
“Jump!”
After saying that, Fang Heng directly jumped out of the helicopter.
Behind him, the members of the Dark Knights also followed Fang Heng and jumped down.
“Wait for me!”
Mo Jiawei gritted his teeth and also jumped down with Fang Heng.
“Chil”
The emergency parachute opened in the air.
Fang Heng tried his best to maintain his balance in the air.
Although it was only his first time parachuting, the high attributes of his body allowed Fang Heng to quickly master the technique.
After a moment, Fang Heng landed steadily on the rooftop of the white high-rise building.
(Hint: You have entered a low-risk infected area. Your infection index will continue to increase. When it reaches 50%, there is a probability of entering an infected state. Please be careful! ]
“Boom!!!”
‘As soon as he landed, Fang Heng heard an explosion.
Another helicopter was hit by the nemesis’s rocket launcher and was directly blown into pieces in the air.
A few zombies on the roof smelled the scent of living people, and pounced on Fang Heng and the others who had landed on the roof.
After landing on the ground, the Dark Knights’ NPCs took out their submachine guns to fight.
Fang Heng took out his machete and cut down two swaying zombies as if he was chopping vegetables. Then, he approached his teammate, Mo Jiawei, who had landed not far away.
“are you alright?”
“Hiss, I’m fine.”
Mo Jiawei’s attributes were not high. When he landed on the ground, he lost his balance and fell, losing some of his blood. However, it was not a big problem.
He quickly stood up, took out his pistol and hid behind the elite Dark Knights.
After a short while, the gunfire stopped. The zombies on the rooftop had been cleaned up.
Lucia looked anxious. She quickly walked to the fence and lowered her head to search for the direction where the helicopter had crashed.
‘Why was she crying?
Tears welled up in her eyes.
Fang Heng also walked to Lucia and also lowered his head to observe the city below.
The helicopter the team had taken before had landed at a street intersection not far away.
The helicopter had fallen into several pieces. Some of them were still burning and were emitting thick black smoke.
More than a dozen silver-white boxes were scattered around the landing spot of the helicopter.
The pilot had been sacrificed.
Lucia realized that there was someone next to her. She wiped her tears with the back of her hand and turned to Fang Heng. “Fang Heng, we’re in trouble.”
“Yes.”
Fang Heng’s expression was solemn, and he thought to himself, “I know.”
And the trouble they were in was not small.
“Fang Heng, we need to establish the base station before we can operate the communication device in our hands.”
“all the components needed to build the base station are on the helicopter we are in. We have to retrieve those boxes as soon as possible so that we can contact my brother as soon as possible.”
“Your brother?”
“Colonel Barker.”
Fang Heng was surprised.
He could not connect the bald Colonel Barker and Lucia no matter what.
Lucia looked down at the time again as she spoke.
“There are still two hours left before sunset. We have to retrieve the base station components and assemble them as soon as possible...”
[Hint: Player has completed the fifth mission-Explore Pine City, triggering the sixth mission-Desperation.]
Mission name: Desperation.
Mission Difficulty: SSS.

Mission description: Your team was attacked by an unknown source during the process of entering the city. On the way, the helicopter you were riding on was damaged. You lost contact with the other members of the Dark Knights.
Optional mission branch 1: Establish the base station.
Mission requirement: Find all the metal boxes containing the base station components (0/3).
Optional mission branch 2: Wait for rescue.
Mission requirement: Find a safe place and wait for rescue.
Very good! Old Black!
Was this part of your plan?
Fang Heng thought that if he took another helicopter to Pine City, it wouldn’t be such a mess.
Not necessarily.
Acrisis was also an opportunity.
Fang Heng roughly analyzed the current situation.
The second option for this mission was to wait for death.
To proactively respond and find the boxes!
Lucia was concerned about her brother’s safety. She turned to the Dark Knights’ NPCs.
“We need to immediately head to the crash site and look for the boxes containing the base station components. Any questions?”
“Um...” Fang Heng raised his hand and asked, “Do you have a plan?”
“Plan?”
Lucia frowned and showed a puzzled expression.
“Rush over, seize the materials and evacuate quickly.”
Fang Heng didn’t know how to answer for a moment.
Lucia’s plan was summed up in one word.
Reckless!
“Well done, charging into the street in the midst of so many mutated zombies, then finding a way to grab the metal boxes and then running back.”
“You’re courageous!” Fang Heng thought.
“No!”
Fang Heng immediately shook his head to stop her.
“This is too risky, we might be wiped out.”
[Hint: Your friendship with Lucia has slightly decreased.)
“Then what do you think we should do?”
Lucia’s sounded upset.
“Do you want to stay here and wait?”
“That’s not necessary, let’s go downstairs and check the situation first.”
Fang Heng thought for a moment and quickly added, “Don’t go to the first floor. Go to the second floor and find a room by the window.”
Lucia immediately turned around and gave the order to the team.
“Go! Go to the second floor!”
A Dark Knight who was at the forefront kicked the iron door of the rooftop open.
The members of the team behind entered in a file.
“Let’s hide behind.”
Fang Heng whispered to Mo Jiawei and followed behind the team.
The teams that entered Pine City were all top elites of the Dark Knights!
Their combat ability was abnormally terrifying.
Especially after being equipped with high-level guns.
They used the high firepower of submachine guns to directly make their way through!
Asingle bullet from them could instantly kill an ordinary zombie.
Fang Heng had seen through some tricks.
The weapons of the Dark Knights had been modified.
In order to prevent the noise from attracting more zombies, a silencer had been added.
The bullets were also specially made bullets, which enhanced their power.
Even if they encountered a Tier 1 mutated zombie, the dense bullets could still easily shatter it.
Fang Heng estimated that most of these soldiers had brought their submachine guns and bullets with them.
He and Mo Jiawei, the two ‘supporters’, followed at the back of the group.
‘The team quickly arrived at the second floor of the jewelry shop.
Fang Heng roughly identified the direction and pointed at the tightly shut jewelry exhibition hall.
“That room! Quick! Go in!”
The lock of the door was broken by a bullet.
The team broke in and cleared out the remaining zombies in the room.
Two NPC soldiers brought a cabinet from the side and blocked the door.
Lucia walked to the window.
Through the window, she looked out anxiously.

chapters.title: Chapter 148 - The Plan to Pick up Boxes
paragraphs: “Fang Heng, what should we do next?”
‘Mo Jiawei was also very uneasy.
Even in the jewelry shop, the number and strength of zombies far exceeded his expectations.
“Wait a minute.”
Fang Heng pulled out the system log and looked at the map that he had imported from outside the game.
The largest luxury jewelry shop in the city...
Here...
Fang Heng looked at the map to find the location of his team.
Lucia was burning with anxiety.
She could not wait any longer.
“Fang Heng! We have to rush out immediately. It’s going to be dark soon.”
“The Dark Knights’ combat ability is top-notch. We can rush out!”
Fang Heng looked at Lucia.
He did not deny the strength of the Dark Knights.
‘With powerful guns, they could even fight against a Tier 2 mutated zombie.
However, the biggest threat now was not the Tier 2 mutated zombie.
There was a huge zombie crowd outside!
The density of the zombie crowd on the streets of the city was very high.
The smell of living people and the noise caused by the battle would cause more zombies to gather.
Once they were dragged into the swamp by the zombie wave, they would be easily exhausted to death!
“Is that so? Think about it carefully.”
Fang Heng’s face was cold as he turned to look at Lucia.
“Once we leave the building, the zombies will follow our scent and come over. More and more zombies will swallow us like a tide.”
“Ladmit that the Dark Knights are powerful, but our bullets are limited. Everyone only has a minimum load before taking the plane.”
“Tell me, how long can our ammunition last?”
Lucia fell silent.
She clenched her fists.
She knew that Fang Heng was right, but she did not want to just sit there and do nothing.
“Not to mention that we have to spend a lot of time to collect the lost boxes.”
Lucia gritted her teeth. “I won’t drag you down. I’ll go alone! I’ll come back with materials!”
“No, I don’t agree.”
Fang Heng walked past Lucia and came to the window.
He stuck his head out and looked out the window.
“Tm the highest commander of the team now. I request you to stay here and keep watch.”
“Everyone stay put and keep watch!”
Fang Heng said and waved his hand, indicating for the team members to stay put and wait for orders.
Lucia clenched her fists.
Feeling powerless, she punched the wall heavily as if she was venting her anger.
“Bang!”
A muffled sound was heard.
A fist print was left on the wall.
“So violent?”
‘Mo Jiawei was shocked. He whispered and quickly hid to the side.
He was afraid that Lucia would touch him.
Fang Heng was also a little surprised. He turned to look at Lucia.
‘Was the power of one punch so great?
Was Lucia’s body modified by the virus as well?
‘That was not important.
Her ability was still limited when facing a zombie crowd.
Fang Heng slowly withdrew his gaze from Lucia.
The problem now was how to solve the problem.
A headache!
He could not fight head-on.
The risk was too great, and the corresponding benefits were too small.
It was not worth the risk.
If only Sister Li was here.
Once the perception barrier was opened, she could break through the crowd and pick up the boxes.
Now, he could only rely on his zombie clones to fight.
Unfortunately, the zombie clones would be resurrected in about half an hour.
Fang Heng could only wait silently.
He waited for more than half an hour.
The sky was getting dark.
Lucia couldn’t help but ask again, “Fang Heng? It’s going to be dark soon. Do you still want to wait?”
“Almost.”
Fang Heng stood by the window.
From this position, he could see the wreckage of the helicopter at the intersection ahead.
Fang Heng counted in his heart.
“Three, two, one...”
‘Time was up!
“Chi! Chi! Chi
At the moment when the countdown for the resurrection of the zombie clones ended, weak magic arrays appeared under Fang Heng’s feet.
‘The Dark Knights reacted quickly and stepped back, pointing their guns at Fang Heng’s feet.
Fang Heng raised his hand to signal the NPCs to calm down.
“Let me introduce you. This is my talent skill, zombie control.”
Awithered green palm reached out from the magic array.
Five zombies struggled to climb out of the magic array.
‘Mo Jiawei opened his mouth and saw with his own eyes the summoned creatures that crawled out of the magic array.
He was shocked.
It was a summoned zombie?!
So the God was a summoner? !
However, wasn’t the preparation time a little too long?
Hearing Fang Heng’s words, the NPCs put away their guns that were aimed at the zombies.
Lucia’s bright eyes flashed with surprise. She was also very surprised by Fang Heng’s skill.
However, she doubted the abilities of these zombies even more.
“You spent so much time just to summon them? Are they very strong?”
“They’re alright, but they’re better at disguising themselves.”
“The ordinary zombies outside won’t be hostile to them. They’re more suitable to do ‘bad things’.”
‘The God’s summoning spell had such an effect?
It could protect them from the attacks of the same kind of zombies?!
Mo Jiawei looked like he had seen the world and continued to observe God’s operation.
Fang Heng turned around and explained the next battle plan to the Dark Knights.
“Wait for them to leave the building and run out to retrieve the boxes scattered around the wreckage of the helicopter.”
“During the process, there might be a Tier 2 mutated zombie attack. At this time, I need you to protect these zombies from afar and kill the danger directly.”
“Yes, Captain!”
Hearing that, the four elite soldiers immediately put away the submachine guns in their backpacks. One by one, they leaned against the window and adjusted the angle of their sniper rifles.
Considering the problem of the sound, the sniper rifles were equipped with silencers.
Fang Heng stood by the window and activated his remote control, giving orders to the five zombies.
‘The zombies opened the window on the second floor unsteadily and climbed down the emergency stairs on the side of the building.
Until they reached the main street.
The main street was full of wandering zombies.
Except for a few predators like Lickers, most Tier 1 and Tier 2 zombies would not attack.
‘The zombie clones slowly ran towards the wreckage of the helicopter.
It did not seem to be a problem.
Lucia was holding a sniper rifle and observing the zombies through the scope.
Her heart was still in the air.
Her palms were sweaty from nervousness.
The zombies couldn’t run. They moved very slowly, slowly moving forward.
‘They didn’t encounter any danger along the way.
The zombies that passed by treated them as their kind and didn’t take the initiative to attack.
But just as they passed by an alley, a red shadow suddenly darted out from the alley.
It was the Licker!
“Chil!!”
The Licker was too fast.
Oh no!
Lucia’s heart pounded fiercely.
Even though she had made ample preparations, the red shadow was too fast!
It flashed past the scope!
By the time Lucia caught its trajectory, its sharp claws had already cut a huge gash on the zombie’s body.
The impact sent the zombie clone flying far away..

sentences.text: “Fang Heng, what should we do next?”
‘Mo Jiawei was also very uneasy.
Even in the jewelry shop, the number and strength of zombies far exceeded his expectations.
“Wait a minute.”
Fang Heng pulled out the system log and looked at the map that he had imported from outside the game.
The largest luxury jewelry shop in the city...
Here...
Fang Heng looked at the map to find the location of his team.
Lucia was burning with anxiety.
She could not wait any longer.
“Fang Heng!
We have to rush out immediately.
It’s going to be dark soon.”
“The Dark Knights’ combat ability is top-notch.
We can rush out!”
Fang Heng looked at Lucia.
He did not deny the strength of the Dark Knights.
‘With powerful guns, they could even fight against a Tier 2 mutated zombie.
However, the biggest threat now was not the Tier 2 mutated zombie.
There was a huge zombie crowd outside!
The density of the zombie crowd on the streets of the city was very high.
The smell of living people and the noise caused by the battle would cause more zombies to gather.
Once they were dragged into the swamp by the zombie wave, they would be easily exhausted to death!
“Is that so?
Think about it carefully.”
Fang Heng’s face was cold as he turned to look at Lucia.
“Once we leave the building, the zombies will follow our scent and come over.
More and more zombies will swallow us like a tide.”
“Ladmit that the Dark Knights are powerful, but our bullets are limited.
Everyone only has a minimum load before taking the plane.”
“Tell me, how long can our ammunition last?”
Lucia fell silent.
She clenched her fists.
She knew that Fang Heng was right, but she did not want to just sit there and do nothing.
“Not to mention that we have to spend a lot of time to collect the lost boxes.”
Lucia gritted her teeth.
“I won’t drag you down.
I’ll go alone!
I’ll come back with materials!”
“No, I don’t agree.”
Fang Heng walked past Lucia and came to the window.
He stuck his head out and looked out the window.
“Tm the highest commander of the team now.
I request you to stay here and keep watch.”
“Everyone stay put and keep watch!”
Fang Heng said and waved his hand, indicating for the team members to stay put and wait for orders.
Lucia clenched her fists.
Feeling powerless, she punched the wall heavily as if she was venting her anger.
“Bang!”
A muffled sound was heard.
A fist print was left on the wall.
“So violent?”
‘Mo Jiawei was shocked.
He whispered and quickly hid to the side.
He was afraid that Lucia would touch him.
Fang Heng was also a little surprised.
He turned to look at Lucia.
‘Was the power of one punch so great?
Was Lucia’s body modified by the virus as well?
‘That was not important.
Her ability was still limited when facing a zombie crowd.
Fang Heng slowly withdrew his gaze from Lucia.
The problem now was how to solve the problem.
A headache!
He could not fight head-on.
The risk was too great, and the corresponding benefits were too small.
It was not worth the risk.
If only Sister Li was here.
Once the perception barrier was opened, she could break through the crowd and pick up the boxes.
Now, he could only rely on his zombie clones to fight.
Unfortunately, the zombie clones would be resurrected in about half an hour.
Fang Heng could only wait silently.
He waited for more than half an hour.
The sky was getting dark.
Lucia couldn’t help but ask again, “Fang Heng?
It’s going to be dark soon.
Do you still want to wait?”
“Almost.”
Fang Heng stood by the window.
From this position, he could see the wreckage of the helicopter at the intersection ahead.
Fang Heng counted in his heart.
“Three, two, one...”
‘Time was up!
“Chi!
Chi!
Chi
At the moment when the countdown for the resurrection of the zombie clones ended, weak magic arrays appeared under Fang Heng’s feet.
‘The Dark Knights reacted quickly and stepped back, pointing their guns at Fang Heng’s feet.
Fang Heng raised his hand to signal the NPCs to calm down.
“Let me introduce you.
This is my talent skill, zombie control.”

chapters.title: Chapter 149 - Taking a Beating
paragraphs: “Bang! Bang! Bang!!”
Even with the silencer installed, Fang Heng could still hear several gunshots.
The Licker’s brief pause after its attack gave Lucia and the other elite soldiers a chance to aim!
It was hit by the sniper rifle and flew backwards. After landing, it quickly returned to the inside of the alley.
Everyone aimed their scopes at the entrance of the alley.
“Swoosh!”
“Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!”
Then, a series of red shadows flew out from the entrance of the alley.
This was bad!!
Lucia’s expression changed drastically as she pulled the trigger.
“Bang Bang! Bang!”
Five or six Lickers attacked Fang Heng’s zombie clones from the entrance of the alley.
‘They waved their sharp claws and attacked Fang Heng’s zombie clones!
The vine zombies were like lambs waiting to be slaughtered when facing predators like the Lickers.
They still maintained their slow pace and had no way to dodge.
“Chi! Chi! Chi!”
The sharp claws of the Lickers left huge wounds on the body of the vine zombies!
‘The huge impact sent the vine zombies flying one by one.
The elite soldiers of the Dark Knights were not to be trifled with.
‘The sniper bullets landed accurately on the Lickers!
Lucia aimed and fired with all her might!
‘The Licker’s hatred towards the zombie clones was extremely great. They all rushed towards the vine zombies that were sent flying and fell to the ground, launching another attack!
Two minutes!
During these two minutes, Lucia’s mental state was extremely tense!
‘The sniper rifle had consecutively fired several rounds!
After leaving behind four Licker corpses, the remaining three Lickers had completely escaped back into the alley.
Was it over?
Were they all dead?
Lucia couldn’t help but put down her sniper rifle and looked up to check on the situation of the zombie clones.
‘The zombies that were sent out fell to the ground in pieces.
Their bodies were covered with large wounds.
But Lucia was pleasantly surprised that after lying on the ground for a while, the zombie clones slowly stood up one by one.
‘The zombies that were fatally injured by the Lickers, and even knocked away by the Lickers, didn’t die?!
Tiny vines appeared from their torn wounds, and as if nothing had happened, they silently moved forward.
Lucia was pleasantly surprised.
‘Mo Jiawei, who was watching from the side, was even more surprised and exclaimed in a low voice.
“D*mn, they are so fleshy? Are they all wearing bulletproof vests?”
“It’s nothing.”
Fang Heng was very confident in the vine zombie’s defense.
The 600% additional HP was no joke!
Not to mention the additional physical damage reduction.
In emergencies, it could recover 80% of its maximum HP!
Its movement speed was a little slow.
But, it was good at taking hits!
Even the strongest hunter among the Tier 2 mutated zombies could not kill it in a short period.
However, Fang Heng was also shocked by the Lickers that suddenly came out of the alley.
Even though the zombie clones had activated the stealth skill, they were still targeted by the Lickers.
Could it be that the King of Gods’ game was trying to strike a balance in its difficulty?
Fang Heng rubbed his chin as he pondered.
‘Mo Jiawei secretly rejoiced as he stole a glance at the blonde girl beside him.
Luckily, he didn’t follow Lucia out just now. Otherwise, he would be the one facing the berserk Lickers now.
What the hell! What kind of hellish difficulty was this!
After repelling a wave of Lickers, the rest of the journey was calm and peaceful.
‘The zombie clones came to the wreckage of the helicopter without any obstacles.
They picked up the metal boxes that fell to the ground under the watchful eyes of the zombie crowd.
Then, they picked up the boxes one by one and slowly walked back.
Five minutes later, the zombie clones crawled back to the room through the escape passage.
‘They threw the boxes they picked up in front of Fang Heng one by one.
Seeing that Fang Heng’s plan was completed, Lucia finally felt relieved.
She couldn’t wait to check the boxes.
[Hint: Lucia’s favorability with you has increased.]
[Hint: You have obtained ammunition supply box*2. ]
[Hint: You have obtained damaged food supply box*1.]
[Hint: You have obtained damaged communication tower base station accessory box*1.]
(Description: The supply box is a special item. It cannot be put into a backpack.]
Unfortunately, they only found one box of communication tower base station accessories.
‘The good news was that the other boxes were all filled with supplies.
It could be considered as an additional harvest.
Fang Heng opened the ammunition supply box to check. Then, he waved his hand and signalled the zombies to continue searching for the boxes outside.
He opened the supply box.
The ammunition boxes were filled with weapons and ammunition.
Half of the food in the damaged food boxes had been destroyed and couldn’t be eaten.
‘The remaining half of the compressed biscuits were enough for a team to eat for two to three days.
‘There were still so many boxes near the wreckage of the helicopter. If all of them were collected, there should be a lot more supplies.
“I didn’t expect the logistics team to have such an advantage.”
Fang Heng muttered softly.

He conveniently took a few sets of shotgun bullets, a few packs of compressed biscuits and a few bottles of mineral water from the box and put them into his backpack. Then, he called Mo Jiawei over to share them with him.
‘They went back and forth several times. Under the protection of the Dark Knights’ long-range sniping, the zombies picked up all the boxes that had fallen around the wreckage.

[Hint: You have obtained a food supply box (partially damaged)*5, an ammunition supply box*s, a medical supply box*1, an emergency maintenance tool supply box (partially damaged)*1, a communication tower base station accessory box (partially damaged)*2.]
Very good! Now, the team did not lack food and ammunition!
After sealing the exit on the second floor, Fang Heng called for the Dark Knights to carry out the ammunition and food supply.
Lucia hurriedly opened the accessory box of the tower’s base station and began to check the integrity of the base station’s components.
Ohno.
It was damaged!
Lucia’s heart sank.
“How is it?”
Fang Heng chewed on the dry compressed biscuits and walked to Lucia’s side.
“The initial judgment is that the situation is not good. It may be that the plane was hit during the fall.”
“Ican’t confirm whether the base station can continue to be used. I need to assemble it to take a look.”
Lucia was worried. She turned to look at Fang Heng.
“Fang Heng, I need to go to the rooftop as soon as possible to try to build the tower base station. The signal will spread more easily there.”
“Yeah, no problem.”
Fang Heng put down the compressed biscuits in his hand and ordered, “Let’s go back to the rooftop!”
‘The Dark Knights once again escorted the small team back to the rooftop.
Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei were completely reduced to ‘support’.
The two of them carried two boxes in each hand and rushed back to the rooftop together with the zombies.
‘When they arrived at the rooftop, Lucia couldn’t wait to open the boxes and set up the small tower base station on the spot.
While they were resting, Fang Heng handed a pack of compressed biscuits to Mo Jiawei.
“Come, try it. Don’t look at it as a compressed biscuit, it tastes pretty good. You must have never tasted this kind of coffee flavour.”
“Um... thank you.”
‘Mo Jiawei smiled wryly. He couldn’t understand why Fang Heng had the leisure to eat compressed biscuits.

chapters.title: Chapter 150 - Repair
paragraphs: After a long time.
Lucia was still fiddling with the tower’s base station.
She looked anxious.
No!
It’s not working!
No matter how hard she tried, the damaged base station could not receive long-distance signals.
Lucia could not help but be anxious, tears welling up in her eyes.
It’s over, it looks like the situation is bad...
Looking at Lucia’s state, Mo Jiawei panicked.
He no longer had any appetite, so he carefully nudged Fang Heng, who was checking the boxes of materials at the side.
“Fang Heng, Lucia doesn’t look too good, should we go ask her about the situation?”
“Yes, that makes sense, go ask her.”
Seeing that the sky was gradually darkening, Fang Heng followed Mo Jiawei to Lucia’s side.
“The situation is not good?”
“Yes, the parts of the base station are badly damaged. I just barely assembled the base station of the tower, and it’s almost usable.”
Lucia lowered her head and pursed her lips.
She was still adjusting the tower.

“But the effect is very limited now. The receiving and transmitting power of the base station is very low, and the signal interference is very strong. It can only receive signals within a range of 100 meters at most.”
Only a range of 100 meters?
When Mo Jiawei heard what Lucia said, his heart instantly turned cold.
Wasn’t this the end of the world?
A shout could be heard within 100 meters, what’s the use of this base station?
Fortunately, he didn’t foolishly run out to confront the monster earlier on. Otherwise, if he desperately picked up a piece of junk, wouldn’t he be angered to death?
Mechanical maintenance?
Isn’t this a coincidence!?
Fang Heng lamented that the saying “Having many skills doesn’t weigh you down” made some sense. He pointed at himself.
“Why don’t you let me try?”
As he said this, Fang Heng took out a portable wrench from his backpack.
‘Mo Jiawei was pleasantly surprised!
He looked at Fang Heng excitedly.
“God! Do you know mechanical maintenance?”
“Look at what you said, We are all support-type players. Aren’t these all basic skills?”
In this era, being a support-type player had to know many things?
Looking at Mo Jiawei’s shocked expression, Fang Heng became open-minded.
He had finally gotten the reaction that he couldn’t get from Qiu Yaokang!
“Tm just joking with you.”
Fang Heng chuckled, patted Mo Jiawei’s shoulder and walked to the damaged communication base station.
{Hint: You obtained a skill-mechanical maintenance.]
[Hint: The current machinery to be repaired-damaged communication tower base station. Current damage degree: 29% (usable) (repairable).]
[Hint: This repair is expected to reduce the damage by 2%-8%. Required tool: wrench. Required cost: iron nuggets*14, nails*17, basic parts*8, vitality*12.]
(Hint: Current maintenance difficulty: C.]
This was only a C-level maintenance difficulty.
This was going to be easy!
For the past two days, Fang Heng had been controlling the zombie clone to help Qiu Yaokang repair the laboratory equipment at night.
Most of what he encountered was A-S level maintenance difficulty.
Most of the high-difficulty maintenance only had a success rate of 20-40%.
In the later stages, he relied on a large number of materials yet met with failures consecutively!
After a period of torture, Fang Heng’s mechanical maintenance level had long reached the maximum which was at Level 13.
Dealing with this kind of equipment was not a big problem.
Fang Heng took out parts from the emergency maintenance tool supply box at the side.
Along channelling bar appeared above his head.
In less than half a minute, the channelling bar was completed.
[Hint: This maintenance has been judged successful, damage of tower base station reduced by 5%.]
Simple!
Fang Heng continued to repair the tower base station three times until the damage was reduced to 13%.
He raised his head again and looked at Lucia who was waiting anxiously.
“Come and try it.”
“It’s fixed?”
‘Was it that easy?
Lucia could not believe Fang Heng’s words when she saw how easily he fixed the tower base station.
“The initial maintenance is successful. If we want to completely repair it, we need high-level precision instruments.”
“The supply box that we found was mostly damaged. We can’t find any ready-made tools inside.”
Fang Heng raised the wrench in his hand as he spoke.
“If you can find some high-level machinery for me to dismantle, we might be able to find it.”
“Anyway, you try it first. The signal range now is much wider than before.”
Lucia was skeptical.
She walked to the tower and tried to restart the communication tower base station.
“Chi, chi, chi...”
As soon as the base station was turned on, the noisy sound of electricity came from inside the base station.
It really could be done!
Lucia’s face showed a pleasantly surprised expression.
She found that after Fang Heng’s maintenance, the signal strength of the tower was greatly increased!
Fang Heng knew maintenance skills!
Lucia hurriedly contacted Barker’s communicator again.
“The communication connection is successful!”
After a few attempts, there was another electrical noise from the radio.
A familiar voice came from the radio.
“Lucia? Lucia! Is that you?!”
“Brother? Are you okay? Where are you now?”
“Tm fine, Lucia. Our team is fine. I’m in the Whitechapel area now. After the plane crashed, we occupied this area and are still safe for the time being. How are you guys doing?”
“We’re also safe now. I’m so worried about you.
“I’s okay, Lucia. You have to be strong. Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei are by your side, right? Help me get through to them. I have something to say to them.”
Lucia nodded and opened Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei’s communicator settings.
Fang Heng immediately took out his communicator.
“Fang Heng, Mo Jiawei, it’s so good to know that you’re safe.”
“We were barely lucky, but Captain Barker, you’re not in a good situation right now, are you?”
Fang Heng had already guessed a thing or two.
He had just vaguely heard gunshots and the screams of zombies from the radio.
This meant that Barker’s team was still threatened by the zombie horde.
Secondly, Barker asked for a private chat to avoid Lucia.
If Lucia knew that Barker was still in danger, she would probably lead her team to rescue him.
It was late at night, and this kind of action was no different from seeking death.
“Well, the situation is not good,” Barker said in a deep voice, “There is a group of zombies outside the church, and they are still attacking the church.”
“We can still hold on for a while. How’s your team?”
“The overall situation is still alright. The zombies in the city are too many. We can’t get out, so we’re hiding in a jewellery shop for the time being.”
“We just found a way to collect the materials left around the wreckage of the plane and build the base station for the communication tower.”
Fang Heng made a rough estimate and continued, “It is expected that we can only try to leave tomorrow morning at the earliest to seek help.”
“You did well, Fang Heng.”
“This time, we were attacked halfway through the operation. This is indeed beyond our expectations.”
“We suffered heavy losses. Considering the risk, I think this mission has ended here.”
“The mission has changed. I need you to try your best to find the members of the Dark Knights and confirm whether they are safe. Try your best to lead all the survivors out of Pine City safely..”

Lucia was still fiddling with the tower’s base station.
She looked anxious.
No!
It’s not working!
No matter how hard she tried, the damaged base station could not receive long-distance signals.
Lucia could not help but be anxious, tears welling up in her eyes.
It’s over, it looks like the situation is bad...
Looking at Lucia’s state, Mo Jiawei panicked.
He no longer had any appetite, so he carefully nudged Fang Heng, who was checking the boxes of materials at the side.
“Fang Heng, Lucia doesn’t look too good, should we go ask her about the situation?”
“Yes, that makes sense, go ask her.”
Seeing that the sky was gradually darkening, Fang Heng followed Mo Jiawei to Lucia’s side.
“The situation is not good?”
“Yes, the parts of the base station are badly damaged.
I just barely assembled the base station of the tower, and it’s almost usable.”
Lucia lowered her head and pursed her lips.
She was still adjusting the tower.
“But the effect is very limited now.
The receiving and transmitting power of the base station is very low, and the signal interference is very strong.
It can only receive signals within a range of 100 meters at most.”
Only a range of 100 meters?
When Mo Jiawei heard what Lucia said, his heart instantly turned cold.
Wasn’t this the end of the world?
A shout could be heard within 100 meters, what’s the use of this base station?
Fortunately, he didn’t foolishly run out to confront the monster earlier on.
Otherwise, if he desperately picked up a piece of junk, wouldn’t he be angered to death?
Mechanical maintenance?
Isn’t this a coincidence!?
Fang Heng lamented that the saying “Having many skills doesn’t weigh you down” made some sense.
He pointed at himself.
“Why don’t you let me try?”
As he said this, Fang Heng took out a portable wrench from his backpack.
‘Mo Jiawei was pleasantly surprised!
He looked at Fang Heng excitedly.
“God!
Do you know mechanical maintenance?”
“Look at what you said, We are all support-type players.
Aren’t these all basic skills?”
In this era, being a support-type player had to know many things?
Looking at Mo Jiawei’s shocked expression, Fang Heng became open-minded.
He had finally gotten the reaction that he couldn’t get from Qiu Yaokang!
“Tm just joking with you.”
Fang Heng chuckled, patted Mo Jiawei’s shoulder and walked to the damaged communication base station.

[Hint: The current machinery to be repaired-damaged communication tower base station.

[Hint: This repair is expected to reduce the damage by 2%-8%.
Required tool: wrench.
Required cost: iron nuggets*14, nails*17, basic parts*8, vitality*12.]
(Hint: Current maintenance difficulty: C.]
This was only a C-level maintenance difficulty.
This was going to be easy!
For the past two days, Fang Heng had been controlling the zombie clone to help Qiu Yaokang repair the laboratory equipment at night.
Most of what he encountered was A-S level maintenance difficulty.
Most of the high-difficulty maintenance only had a success rate of 20-40%.
In the later stages, he relied on a large number of materials yet met with failures consecutively!
After a period of torture, Fang Heng’s mechanical maintenance level had long reached the maximum which was at Level 13.
Dealing with this kind of equipment was not a big problem.
Fang Heng took out parts from the emergency maintenance tool supply box at the side.
Along channelling bar appeared above his head.
In less than half a minute, the channelling bar was completed.
[Hint: This maintenance has been judged successful, damage of tower base station reduced by 5%.]
Simple!
Fang Heng continued to repair the tower base station three times until the damage was reduced to 13%.
He raised his head again and looked at Lucia who was waiting anxiously.
“Come and try it.”
“It’s fixed?”
‘Was it that easy?
Lucia could not believe Fang Heng’s words when she saw how easily he fixed the tower base station.
“The initial maintenance is successful.
If we want to completely repair it, we need high-level precision instruments.”
“The supply box that we found was mostly damaged.
We can’t find any ready-made tools inside.”
Fang Heng raised the wrench in his hand as he spoke.
“If you can find some high-level machinery for me to dismantle, we might be able to find it.”
“Anyway, you try it first.
The signal range now is much wider than before.”
Lucia was skeptical.
She walked to the tower and tried to restart the communication tower base station.
“Chi, chi, chi...”

It really could be done!
Lucia’s face showed a pleasantly surprised expression.
She found that after Fang Heng’s maintenance, the signal strength of the tower was greatly increased!
Fang Heng knew maintenance skills!

“The communication connection is successful!”

Lucia!
Is that you?!”

Are you okay?
Where are you now?”

Our team is fine.
I’m in the Whitechapel area now.

How are you guys doing?”
